title: Condition for Existence of Hamiltonian Paths
snippet: == Open Question == Does there exist a simple necessary and sufficient condition for a graph to have a Hamiltonian path? There is no known criterion for testing whether or not a graph is semi-Hamiltonian or not. Category:Semi-Hamiltonian Graphs Category:Open Questions

title: Condition for Existence of Third Number Proportional to Two Numbers
snippet: Let $a, b, c \in \Z$ be integers. Let $\tuple {a, b, c}$ be a geometric sequence. In order for this to be possible, both of these conditions must be true: $(1): \quad a$ and $b$ cannot be coprime $(2): \quad a \divides b^2$ where $\divides$ denotes divisibility.

title: Condition for Expectation of Non-Negative Random Variable to be Zero
snippet: Let $X$ be a random variable. Let: $\map \Pr {X \ge 0} = 1$ Then $\expect X = 0$ $\map \Pr {X = 0} = 1$.

title: Condition for Factoring of Quotient Mapping between Modulo Addition Groups
snippet: Let $m, n \in \Z_{>0}$ be strictly positive integers. Let $\struct {\Z, +}$ denote the additive group of integers. Let $\struct {\Z_m, +_m}$ and $\struct {\Z_n, +_n}$ denote the additive groups of integers modulo $m$ and $n$ respectively. Let $f: \Z \to \Z_n$ be the quotient epimorphism from $\struct {\Z, +}$ to $\struct {\Z_n, +_n}$. Let $q: \Z \to \Z_m$ be the quotient epimorphism from $\struct {\Z, +}$ to $\struct {\Z_m, +_m}$. Then: there exists a group homomorphism $\psi: \struct {\Z_m, +_m} \to \struct {\Z_n, +_n}$ $m \divides n$ where $\divides$ denotes divisibility.

title: Condition for Fixed Point to be Attracting
snippet: Let $x_{n + 1} = \map \phi {x_n}$ be a direct iteration for the purpose of finding a solution to the equation: $x = \map \phi x$ for some real function $\phi: \R \to \R$. Let $\alpha$ be such that $\alpha = \map \phi \alpha$. Let $\sequence {\map \phi {x_n} }$ converge to $\alpha$ for $\size {x_0 - \alpha}$ sufficiently small. That is, let $\alpha$ be an attracting fixed point of $\phi$. Then: $\size {\map {g'} \alpha} < 1$ where: $\size {\, \cdot \,}$ denotes the absolute value function $\map {g'} \alpha$ denotes the derivative of $\phi$ $x$.

title: Condition for Group Endomorphism to Commute with All Inner Automorphisms
snippet: Let $G$ be a group. Let $\phi: G \to G$ be an endomorphism on $G$. Let $\phi$ be such that: $\forall a \in G: \kappa_a \circ \phi = \phi \circ \kappa_a$ where: $\kappa_a$ denotes the inner automorphism of $G$ given by $a$ $\circ$ denotes composition of mappings. Then: $H = \set {x \in G: \map \phi {\map \phi x} = \map \phi x}$ is a normal subgroup of $G$. Also, the quotient group $G / H$ is an abelian group.

title: Condition for Group given Semigroup with Idempotent Element
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \circ}$ be a semigroup. Let there exist an idempotent element $e$ of $S$ such that for all $a \in S$: there exists at least one element $x$ of $S$ satisfying $x \circ a = e$ there exists at most one element $y$ of $S$ satisfying $a \circ y = e$. Then $\struct {S, \circ}$ is a group.

title: Condition for Group to Act Effectively on Left Coset Space
snippet: Let $G$ be a group whose identity is $e$. Let $H$ be a subgroup of $G$. Then $G$ acts effectively on the left coset space $G / H$ : $\ds \bigcap_{a \mathop \in G} H^a = \set e$ where $H^a$ denotes the conjugate of $H$ by $a$.

title: Condition for Group to be Solvable
snippet: Let $G$ be a group. Let $G$ be such that: $G$ has a normal subgroup $H$ which is solvable the quotient group $G / H$ is cyclic. Then $G$ is a solvable group.

title: Condition for Homogeneous Quadratic Equation to describe Perpendicular Straight Lines
snippet: Let $\LL_1$ and $\LL_2$ represent $2$ straight lines in the Cartesian plane which are represented by a homogeneous quadratic equation $E$ in two variables. Let $\LL_1$ and $\LL_2$ be perpendicular. Then $E$ is of the form: $a x^2 + 2 h x y - a y^2$

title: Condition for Ideal to be Total Ring
snippet: Let $\struct {A, +, \circ}$ be a commutative ring with unity. Let $I$ be an ideal of $A$ such that the quotient ring $A / I$ is a field. Let $J$ be an ideal of $A$ such that $I \subsetneq J$. Then: $A = J$

title: Condition for Ideals of Ring of Integers to be Coprime
snippet: Let $A$ be a commutative ring with unity. Let $a \Z$ and $b \Z$ be ideals of the ring of integers $\Z$. Then $a \Z$ and $b \Z$ are coprime $a$ and $b$ are coprime integers.

title: Condition for Incommensurability of Roots of Quadratic Equation
snippet: Consider the quadratic equation: $(1): \quad a x - x^2 = \dfrac {b^2} 4$ Then $x$ and $a - x$ are incommensurable $\sqrt {a^2 - b^2}$ and $a$ are incommensurable.

title: Condition for Increasing Binomial Coefficients
snippet: Let $n \in \Z_{> 0}$ be a (strictly) positive integer. Let $\dbinom n k$ denote a binomial coefficient for $k \in \N$. Then: $\dbinom n k < \dbinom n {k + 1} \iff 0 \le k < \dfrac {n - 1} 2$

title: Condition for Independence from Product of Expectations
snippet: Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a probability space. Let $X$ and $Y$ be discrete random variables on $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$. Let $\expect X$ denote the expectation of $X$. Then $X$ and $Y$ are independent : $\expect {\map g x \map h y} = \expect {\map g x} \expect {\map h y}$ for all functions $g, h: \R \to \R$ for which the latter two expectations exist.

title: Condition for Independence of Discrete Random Variables
snippet: Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a probability space. Let $X$ and $Y$ be discrete random variables on $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$. Then $X$ and $Y$ are independent there exist functions $f, g: \R \to \R$ such that the joint mass function of $X$ and $Y$ satisfies: $\forall x, y \in \R: \map {p_{X, Y} } {x, y} = \map f x \map g y$

title: Condition for Infimum of Subset to equal Infimum of Set
snippet: == Lemma == Let $S$ be a real set. Let $T$ be a subset of $S$. Let $S$ and $T$ admit infima. Then: $\inf S = \inf T \iff \forall \epsilon \in \R_{>0}: \forall s \in S: \exists t \in T: s + \epsilon > t$

title: Condition for Injective Mapping on Ordinals
snippet: Let $F$ be a mapping satisfying the following properties: $(1): \quad$ The domain of $F$ is $\On$, the class of all ordinals $(2): \quad$ For all ordinals $x$, $\map F x = \map G {F \restriction x}$ $(3): \quad$ For all ordinals $x$, $\map G {F \restriction x} \in \paren {A \setminus \Img x}$ where $\Img x$ is the image of $x$ under $F$. Let $\Img F$ denote the image of $F$. Then the following properties hold: $(1): \quad \Img F \subseteq A$ $(2): \quad F$ is injective $(3): \quad A$ is a proper class. Note that only the third property of $F$ is the most important.

title: Condition for Invertibility in Power Structure on Associative or Cancellable Operation
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \circ}$ be a unital magma. Let $\struct {\powerset S, \circ_\PP}$ denote the power structure of $\struct {S, \circ}$. Let identity element $e \in S$ be an identity element of $\struct {S, \circ}$. Let $\circ$ be either: an associative operation a cancellable operation. Let $X \subseteq S$ be a subset of $S$. Then: $X$ is invertible for $\circ_PP$ there exists an element $x \in S$ which is invertible for $\circ$ such that $X = \set x$.

title: Condition for Isomorphism between Structures Induced by Permutations
snippet: Let $S$ be a set. Let $\oplus$ and $\otimes$ be closed operations on $S$ such that both $\oplus$ and $\otimes$ have the same identity. Let $\sigma$ and $\tau$ be permutations on $S$. Let $\oplus_\sigma$ and $\otimes_\tau$ be the operations on $S$ induced on $\oplus$ by $\sigma$ and on $\otimes$ by $\tau$ respectively: $\forall x, y \in S: x \oplus_\sigma y := \map \sigma {x \oplus y}$ $\forall x, y \in S: x \otimes_\tau y := \map \tau {x \otimes y}$ Let $f: S \to S$ be a mapping.

title: Condition for Limits of Computable Real Sequences to be Computable
snippet: Let $\sequence {x_k}_{k \in \N}$ be a computable real sequence. Let $\sequence {y_n}_{n \in \N}$ be a real sequence. If there exists total recursive function $\phi : \N^2 \to \N$ such that: $\forall n, p \in \N: \size {x_{\map \phi {n, p}} - y_n} < \dfrac 1 {p + 1}$ then: $\sequence {y_n}_{n \in \N}$ is a computable real sequence.

title: Condition for Linear Dependence of Linear Functionals in terms of Kernel
snippet: Let $V$ be a vector space over a field $\GF$. Let $f, f_1, \ldots, f_n: V \to \GF$ be linear functionals. Suppose that: $\ds \bigcap_{i \mathop = 1}^n \ker f_i \subseteq \ker f$ where $\ker f$ denotes the kernel of $f$. Then there exist $\alpha_1, \ldots, \alpha_n \in \GF$ such that: $\ds \forall v \in V: \map f v = \sum_{i \mathop = 1}^n \alpha_i \map {f_i} v$ That is: $f \in \span \set {f_1, \ldots, f_n}$

title: Condition for Linear Divisor of Polynomial
snippet: Let $\map P x$ be a polynomial in $x$. Let $a$ be a constant. Then $x - a$ is a divisor of $\map P x$ $a$ is a root of $P$.

title: Condition for Linear Operation on Complex Numbers to be of Finite Order
snippet: Let $A$ be the operation on the complex numbers $\C$ defined as: $\map A x = \alpha x + \beta$ Then $A$ is of finite order greater than $1$ $\alpha$ is a root of unity other than $1$.

title: Condition for Linear Operator to be Equiareal
snippet: Let $f: \R^2 \to \R^2$ be a linear operator on the Cartesian plane $\R^2$. Then: $f$ is an equiareal mapping the determinant of $f$ has a value equal to $\pm 1$.

title: Condition for Linear Transformation
snippet: Let $G$ be a unitary $R$-module. Let $H$ be an $R$-module. Let $\phi: G \to H$ be a mapping. Then $\phi$ is a linear transformation : $\forall x, y \in G: \forall \lambda, \mu \in R: \map \phi {\lambda x + \mu y} = \lambda \map \phi x + \mu \map \phi y$

title: Condition for Lines to be Conjugate
snippet: Let $\CC$ be a circle of radius $r$ whose center is at the origin of a Cartesian plane. Let $\PP$ and $\QQ$ be conjugate lines with respect to $\CC$: Then: $l_1 l_2 + m_1 m_2 = \dfrac {n_1 n_2} {r^2}$

title: Condition for Lipschitz Condition to be Satisfied
snippet: Let $\phi$ be a real function. Then $\phi$ satisfies the Lipschitz condition on a closed real interval $\closedint a b$ if: $\forall y \in \closedint a b: \exists A \in \R: \size {\map {\phi'} y} \le A$

title: Condition for Mapping between Structure and Cartesian Product of Substructures to be Bijection
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \circ}$ be an algebraic structure with $1$ operation. Let $\struct {A, \circ {\restriction_A} }$ and $\struct {B, \circ {\restriction_B} }$ be closed algebraic substructures of $\struct {S, \circ}$, where $\circ {\restriction_A}$ and $\circ {\restriction_B}$ are the operations induced by the restrictions of $\circ$ to $A$ and $B$ respectively. Let the mapping $\phi: A \times B \to S$ be defined as: $\forall \tuple {a, b} \in A \times B: \map \phi {a, b} = a \circ b$ where $A \times B$ denotes the Cartesian product of $A$ and $B$.

title: Condition for Mapping between Structures to be Homomorphism
snippet: Let $\struct {A, \odot}$ and $\struct {B, \circledast}$ be magmas. Let $\struct {A \times B, \otimes}$ be the external direct product of $\struct {A, \odot}$ and $\struct {B, \circledast}$. Let $\phi: A \to B$ be a mapping. Let $\phi$ be considered as a subset of the Cartesian product $A \times B$. Then: $\phi$ is a homomorphism the algebraic structure $\struct {\phi, \otimes_\phi}$ is a submagma of $\struct {A \times B, \otimes}$.

title: Condition for Mapping from Quotient Set to be Injection
snippet: Let $S$ and $T$ be sets. Let $\RR$ be an equivalence relation on $S$. Let $f: S \to T$ be a mapping from $S$ to $T$. Let $S / \RR$ be the quotient set of $S$ induced by $\RR$. Let $q_\RR: S \to S / \RR$ be the quotient mapping induced by $\RR$. Let the mapping $\phi: S / \RR \to T$ defined as: $\phi \circ q_\RR = f$ be well-defined. Then: $\phi$ is an injection $\forall x, y \in S: \tuple {x, y} \in \RR \iff \map f x = \map f y$

title: Condition for Mapping from Quotient Set to be Surjection
snippet: Let $S$ and $T$ be sets. Let $\RR$ be an equivalence relation on $S$. Let $f: S \to T$ be a mapping from $S$ to $T$. Let $S / \RR$ be the quotient set of $S$ induced by $\RR$. Let $q_\RR: S \to S / \RR$ be the quotient mapping induced by $\RR$. Let the mapping $\phi: S / \RR \to T$ defined as: $\phi \circ q_\RR = f$ be well-defined. Then: $\phi$ is a surjection $f$ is a surjection.

title: Condition for Mapping from Quotient Set to be Well-Defined
snippet: Let $S$ and $T$ be sets. Let $\RR$ be an equivalence relation on $S$. Let $f: S \to T$ be a mapping from $S$ to $T$. Let $S / \RR$ be the quotient set of $S$ induced by $\RR$. Let $q_\RR: S \to S / \RR$ be the quotient mapping induced by $\RR$. Then: there exists a mapping $\phi: S / \RR \to T$ such that $\phi \circ q_\RR = f$ $\forall x, y \in S: \tuple {x, y} \in \RR \implies \map f x = \map f y$ $\begin {xy} \xymatrix@L + 2mu@ + 1em { S \ar[r]^*{f} \ar[d]_*{q_\RR} & T \\ S / \RR \ar@{-->}[ur]_*{\phi} } \end {xy}$

title: Condition for Mapping from Quotient Vector Space to be Well-Defined
snippet: Let $V, W$ be vector spaces. Let $T: V \to W$ be a linear transformation. Let $M$ be a subspace of $V$. Let $V / M$ be the quotient vector space of $V$ by $M$. Let $Q_M: V \to V / M$ be the associated quotient mapping. Then: there exists a linear transformation $L: V / M \to W$ such that $L \circ Q_M = T$ $M \subseteq \ker T$ $\begin {xy} \xymatrix@L + 2mu@ + 1em {V \ar[r]^*{T} \ar[d]_*{Q_M} & W \\ V / M \ar@{-->}[ur]_*{L} } \end {xy}$

title: Condition for Membership is Right Compatible with Ordinal Exponentiation
snippet: Let $x, y, z$ be ordinals. Let $z$ be the successor of some ordinal $w$. Then: $x < y \iff x^z < y^z$

title: Condition for Membership of Equivalence Class
snippet: Let $\RR$ be an equivalence relation on a set $S$. Let $\eqclass x \RR$ denote the $\RR$-equivalence class of $x$. Then: $\forall y \in S: y \in \eqclass x \RR \iff \tuple {x, y} \in \RR$

title: Condition for Method of Least Squares to match Maximum Likelihood Estimation
snippet: Let $X_n$ and $Y_n$ be sets of $n$ paired observations of random variables $X$ and $Y$. For the paired observations $\tuple {x_i, y_i}$: let $x_i$ be error-free let the errors in $y_i$ be identical and normally distributed with expectation $0$. Then the method of least squares yields a result equivalent to the maximum likelihood estimator.

title: Condition for Nonzero Eigenvalue of Compact Operator
snippet:
Let $H$ be a Hilbert space over $\Bbb F \in \set {\R, \C}$. Let $T \in \map {B_0} H$ be a compact operator. Let $\lambda \in \Bbb F, \lambda 
e 0$ be a nonzero scalar. Suppose that the following holds: $\inf \set {
orm {\paren {T - \lambda I} h}_H: 
orm h_H = 1} = 0$ Then $\lambda \in \map {\sigma_p} T$, that is, $\lambda$ is an eigenvalue for $T$.

title: Condition for Nu Function to be 1
snippet: Let: $n = \ds \prod_{i \mathop = 1}^s p_i^{m_i}$ where $p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_s$ are distinct primes. Then: $(1): \quad m_1, m_2, \ldots, m_s = 1$, that is, $n$ is square-free $(2): \quad \forall i, j \in \set {1, 2, \ldots, s}: p_i \not \equiv 1 \pmod {p_j}$ every group $G$ of order $n$ is cyclic and so $\map \nu n = 1$.

title: Condition for Open Extension Space to be First-Countable
snippet: Let $T = \struct {S, \tau}$ be a topological space. Let $T^*_{\bar p} = \struct {S^*_p, \tau^*_{\bar p} }$ be the open extension space of $T$. Then $T^*_{\bar p}$ is a first-countable space $T$ is.

title: Condition for Open Extension Space to be Second-Countable
snippet: Let $T = \struct {S, \tau}$ be a topological space. Let $T^*_{\bar p} = \struct {S^*_p, \tau^*_{\bar p} }$ be the open extension space of $T$. Then $T^*_{\bar p}$ is a second-countable space $T$ is.

title: Condition for Open Extension Space to be Separable
snippet: Let $T = \struct {S, \tau}$ be a topological space. Let $T^*_{\bar p} = \struct {S^*_p, \tau^*_{\bar p} }$ be the open extension space of $T$. Then $T^*_{\bar p}$ is a separable space $T$ is.

title: Condition for Open Extension Space to be T0
snippet: Let $T = \struct {S, \tau}$ be a topological space. Let $T^*_{\bar p} = \struct {S^*_p, \tau^*_{\bar p} }$ be the open extension space of $T$. Then $T^*_{\bar p}$ is a $T_0$ space $T$ is.

title: Condition for Open Extension Space to be T5
snippet: Let $T = \struct {S, \tau}$ be a topological space. Let $T^*_{\bar p} = \struct {S^*_p, \tau^*_{\bar p} }$ be the open extension space of $T$. Then $T^*_{\bar p}$ is a $T_5$ space $T$ is a $T_5$ space.

title: Condition for Operation to be Left Distributive over Constant Operation
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \circ}$ be an algebraic structure. Let $\sqbrk c$ be the constant operation for some $c \in S$. Then: $\circ$ is left distributive over $\sqbrk c$ $\forall x \in S: x \circ c = c$

title: Condition for Operation to be Right Distributive over Constant Operation
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \circ}$ be an algebraic structure. Let $\sqbrk c$ be the constant operation for some $c \in S$. Then: $\circ$ is right distributive over $\sqbrk c$ $\forall x \in S: c \circ x = c$

title: Condition for Ordered Set of All Mappings to be Total Ordering
snippet: Let $S$ be a set. Let $\struct {T, \preccurlyeq}$ be an ordered set. Let $\struct {T^S, \preccurlyeq}$ denote the ordered set of all mappings from $S$ to $T$. Then: $\struct {T^S, \preccurlyeq}$ is a totally ordered set $\card S \le 1$ or: $\card T \le 1$

title: Condition for Pairs of Lines through Origin to be Harmonic Conjugates
snippet: Consider $4$ lines $\LL_1$, $\LL_2$, $\LL_3$ and $\LL_4$ through the origin $O$ whose equations embedded in the Cartesian plane are as follows: Then the pairs of lines $\set {\LL_1, \LL_2}$ and $\set {\LL_3, \LL_4}$ are harmonic conjugates : $\dfrac {\lambda - \lambda'} {\lambda - \mu'} / \dfrac {\mu - \lambda'} {\mu - \mu'} = -1$

title: Condition for Particle on Elastic String to perform Simple Harmonic Motion
snippet: Let $P$ be a particle bouncing up and down on the end of an elastic string which obeys Hooke's Law. Then $P$ performs simple harmonic motion the amplitude of the oscillations is sufficiently small so as to make sure the string does not go slack.

title: Condition for Partition between Invertible and Non-Invertible Elements to induce Congruence Relation on Monoid
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \circ}$ be a monoid whose identity element is $e$ such that $\struct {S, \circ}$ is specifically not a group. Let $\struct {H, \circ}$ be the subgroup of $\struct {S, \circ}$ consisting of its invertible elements. Let $N$ be the set of non-invertible elements of $\struct {S, \circ}$. Let $\RR$ be the equivalence relation induced by the partition $\set {N \mid H}$. Let either: $\circ$ be a cancellable operation or: $\circ$ be a commutative operation.

title: Condition for Planes to be Parallel
snippet: Let $P: \alpha_1 x_1 + \alpha_2 x_2 + \alpha_3 x_3 = \gamma$ be a plane in $\R^3$. Then the plane $P'$ is parallel to $P$ there is a $\gamma' \in \R$ such that: $P' = \set {\tuple {x_1, x_2, x_3} \in \R^3 : \alpha_1 x_1 + \alpha_2 x_2 + \alpha_3 x_3 = \gamma'}$

title: Condition for Point being in Closure
snippet: Let $T = \struct {S, \tau}$ be a topological space. Let $H \subseteq S$. Let $H^-$ denote the closure of $H$ in $T$. Let $x \in S$. Then $x \in H^-$ every open neighborhood of $x$ contains a point in $H$.

title: Condition for Point to be Center of Circle
Condition for Points in Complex Plane to form Isosceles Triangle
snippet: Let $A = z_1 = x_1 + i y_1$, $B = z_2 = x_2 + i y_2$ and $C = z_3 = x_3 + i y_3$ represent on the complex plane the vertices of a triangle. Then $\triangle ABC$ is isosceles, where $A$ is the apex, : ${x_2}^2 + {y_2}^2 - 2 \paren {x_1 x_2 + y_1 y_2} = {x_3}^2 + {y_3}^2 - 2 \paren {x_1 x_3 + y_1 y_3}$

title: Condition for Points in Complex Plane to form Parallelogram
snippet: Let $A = z_1$, $B = z_2$, $C = z_3$ and $D = z_4$ represent on the complex plane the vertices of a quadrilateral. Then $ABCD$ is a parallelogram : $z_1 - z_2 + z_3 - z_4 = 0$

title: Condition for Power Set to be Totally Ordered
snippet: Let $\powerset S$ be the power set of a set $S$. Let $\struct {\powerset S, \subseteq}$ be the set $\powerset S$ ordered by $\subseteq$. Then $\struct {\powerset S, \subseteq}$ is totally ordered $S$ is either the empty set or a singleton.

title: Condition for Power of Element of Quotient Group to be Identity
snippet: Let $G$ be a group whose identity is $e$. Let $N$ be a normal subgroup of $G$. Let $a \in G$. Then: $\paren {a N}^n$ is the identity of the quotient group $G / N$ $a^n \in N$

title: Condition for Quadratic Equation to describe Perpendicular Straight Lines
snippet: Let $\LL_1$ and $\LL_2$ represent $2$ straight lines in the Cartesian plane which are represented by a quadratic equation $E$ in two variables: $a x^2 + b y^2 + 2 h x y + 2 g x + 2 f y + c = 0$ Let $\LL_1$ and $\LL_2$ be perpendicular. Then: $a + b = 0$ That is, $E$ is of the form: $a \paren {x^2 - y^2} + 2 h x y + 2 g x + 2 f y + c = 0$

title: Condition for Quadratic Function to be Positive
snippet: Let $\map f x = a x^2 + b x + c$ be a quadratic function over the real numbers $\R$. Let $\map f x > 0$ for all $x \in \R$. Then:

title: Condition for Quartic with Real Coefficients to have Wholly Imaginary Root
snippet: Let $Q$ be the quartic equation: $(1): \quad z^4 + a_1 z^3 + a_2 z^2 + a_3 z + a_4 = 0$ such that all of $a_1, a_2, a_3, a_4$ are real numbers. Then $Q$ has a root which is wholly imaginary : $\text {(a)}: \quad a_3^2 + a_1^2 a_4 = a_1 a_2 a_3$ $\text {(b)}: \quad a_1 a_3 > 0$

title: Condition for Rational Cut to be Less than Given Cut
snippet: Let $\alpha$ be a cut. Let $p^*$ be the rational cut associated with a rational number $p$. Then: $p \in \alpha$ $p^* < \alpha$ where $<$ denotes the strict ordering on cuts.

title: Condition for Rational Number to be Square of Rational Number
snippet: Let $m$ and $n$ be (strictly) positive integers which are coprime. Then: $\dfrac m n$ is the square of a rational number both $m$ and $n$ are square numbers.

title: Condition for Rational to be Convergent
snippet: Let $x$ be an irrational number. Let the rational number $\dfrac a b$ satisfy the inequality: $\size {x - \dfrac a b} < \dfrac 1 {2 b^2}$ Then $\dfrac a b$ is a convergent of $x$.

title: Condition for Real Value of Quotient of Quadratics
snippet: Let $f: \R \to \R$ be a real function of the form: $\forall x \in \R: \map f x = \dfrac {a x^2 + b x + c} {A x^2 + B x + C}$ Then $x$ has real values when: $y^2 \paren {B^2 - 4 A C} + 2 y \paren {2 A c + 2 a C - B b} + \paren {b^2 - 4 a c} \ge 0$ where: $y = \dfrac {a x^2 + b x + c} {A x^2 + B x + C}$

title: Condition for Relation to be Transitive and Antitransitive
snippet: Let $S$ be a set. Let $\RR \subseteq S \times S$ be a relation in $S$. Then: $\RR$ is both transitive and antitransitive $\neg \paren {\exists x, y, z \in S: x \mathrel \RR y \land y \mathrel \RR z}$

title: Condition for Repunits to be Coprime
snippet: Let $R_p$ and $R_q$ be repunit numbers with $p$ and $q$ digits respectively. Then $R_p$ and $R_q$ are coprime $p$ and $q$ are coprime.

title: Condition for Resonance in Forced Vibration of Underdamped System
snippet: Consider a physical system $S$ whose behaviour is defined by the second order ODE: $(1): \quad \dfrac {\d^2 y} {\d x^2} + 2 b \dfrac {\d y} {\d x} + a^2 x = K \cos \omega x$ where: $K \in \R: k > 0$ $a, b \in \R_{>0}: b 0$.

title: Condition for Semigroup to be Internal Direct Product of Subgroup and Subsemigroup with Right Operation
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \odot}$ be a semigroup. Then: $\struct {S, \odot}$ is the internal direct product of a subgroup $\struct {G, \odot_G}$ and subsemigroup $\struct {H, \odot_H}$ such that $\odot_H$ is the right operation for all $x \in S$ there exists a left identity $a$ such that $x \odot a = x$, and element $y$ such that $y \odot x = a$.

title: Condition for Sequence to be Schauder Basis in terms of Coordinate Functionals
snippet: Let $\GF \in \set {\R, \C}$. Let $\struct {X, \norm {\, \cdot \,} }$ be an infinite-dimensional normed vector space over $\GF$. Let $\sequence {e_n}_{n \mathop \in \N}$ be a sequence in $X$ such that there exists bounded linear functionals $\sequence {e_n^\ast}_{n \mathop \in \N}$ on $X$ such that: $(1) \quad$ $\map {e_n^\ast} {e_j} = \delta_{n j}$ for each $i, j \in \N$ $(2) \quad$ $\ds x = \sum_{n \mathop = 1}^\infty \map {e_n^\ast} x e_n$ for each $x \in X$ where $\delta$ denotes the Kronecker $\delta$. Then $\sequence {e_n}_{n \mathop \in \N}$ is a Schauder basis.

title: Condition for Set Equivalent to Cardinal Number
snippet: Let $S$ be a set. Let $\card S$ denote the cardinality of $S$. That is, let $\card S$ be the intersection of all ordinals equivalent to $S$. Note that in the absence of the Axiom of Choice, $\card S$ may be the class of all sets. {{item|(3):|$\exists x \in \On: \exists y: \paren {y \subseteq x \land S \sim y}$}} where $A \sim B$ means that there is a bijection from $A$ onto $B$, and the quantification over $y$ is unbounded (so $y$ may be any set).

title: Condition for Set Union Equivalent to Associated Cardinal Number
snippet: Let $S$ and $T$ be sets. Let $\card S$ denote the cardinal number of $S$. Let $\sim$ denote set equivalence. Then: $S \cup T \sim \card {S \cup T} \iff S \sim \card S \land T \sim \card T$

title: Condition for Solubility of Galois Group of Polynomial
snippet: Let $P$ be a polynomial. Let $G$ be the Galois group of $P$. Then $G$ is soluble the roots of $P$ can be obtained from the coefficients of $P$ using just the arithmetic operations and raising to powers of the form $\dfrac 1 n$ for a natural number $n$.

title: Condition for Solutions to Constant Coefficient Homogeneous LSOODE to tend to Zero
snippet: Let: $(1): \quad y' ' + p y' + q y = 0$ be a constant coefficient homogeneous linear second order ODE. Let the general solution to $(1)$ be $\map y {x, C_1, C_2}$. Then: $\ds \lim_{x \mathop \to \infty} \map y {x, C_1, C_2} = 0$ $p$ and $q$ are both strictly positive.

title: Condition for Straight Lines in Plane to be Parallel
Condition for Straight Lines in Plane to be Perpendicular
Condition for Subgroup of Monoid to be Normal
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \circ}$ be a monoid whose identity element is $e$. Let $\struct {H, \circ}$ be a subgroup of $\struct {S, \circ}$. Then: the set of left cosets of $\struct {H, \circ}$ in $\struct {S, \circ}$ form a partition of $S$ and: the set of right cosets of $\struct {H, \circ}$ in $\struct {S, \circ}$ form a partition of $S$ such that the equivalence relations induced by those partitions are congruence relations for $\circ$ $\struct {H, \circ}$ is a normal subgroup of $\struct {S, \circ}$.

title: Condition for Subgroup of Power Set of Group to be Quotient Group
snippet: Let $\struct {G, \circ}$ be a group. Let $\circ_\PP$ be the operation induced by $\circ$ on $\powerset G$, the power set of $G$. Let $\struct {\LL, \circ_\PP}$ be a subgroup of the algebraic structure $\struct {\powerset G, \circ_\PP}$. Then: there exists a subgroup $H$ of $G$ and a normal subgroup $K$ of $H$ such that $\struct {\LL, \circ_\PP}$ is the quotient group $H / K$ the identity element of $\struct {\LL, \circ_\PP}$ is a subgroup of $\struct {G, \circ}$.

title: Condition for Subset of Group to be Right Transversal
snippet: Let $G$ be a group. Let $H$ be a subgroup of $G$ whose index in $G$ is $n$: $\index G H = n$ Let $S \subseteq G$ be a subset of $G$ of cardinality $n$. Then $S$ is a right transversal for $H$ in $G$ : $\forall x, y \in S: x \ne y \implies x y^{-1} \notin H$

title: Condition for Supremum of Subset to equal Supremum of Set
snippet: == Lemma == Let $S$ be a real set. Let $T$ be a subset of $S$. Let $S$ and $T$ admit suprema. Then: $\sup S = \sup T \iff \forall \epsilon \in \R_{>0}: \forall s \in S: \exists t \in T: s < t + \epsilon$

title: Condition for Total Ordering to be Well-Ordering
snippet: Let $A$ be a non-empty class under a total ordering $\preccurlyeq$. Then $\preccurlyeq$ is a well-ordering on $A$ the following $3$ conditions are fulfilled: $(1): \quad A$ has a smallest element $x_0$ $(2): \quad$ Every element of $A$ except the greatest (if there is one) has an immediate successor $(3): \quad$ For every proper lower section $L$ of $A$, if $L$ has no greatest element, then there is a smallest element of $A$ which is not in $L$.

title: Condition for Trivial Relation to be Mapping
snippet: Let $S$ and $T$ be sets. Let $\RR = S \times T$ be the trivial relation in $S$ to $T$. Then $\RR$ is a mapping either: $(2): \card S = 0$ or: $(1): \card T = 1$ where $\card {\, \cdot \,}$ denotes cardinality.

title: Condition for Uniqueness of Increasing Mappings between Tosets
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \preceq}$ and $\struct {T, \preccurlyeq}$ be tosets. Let $f: S \to T$ and $g: S \to T$ be increasing mappings from $S$ to $T$. Let $H \subseteq S$ be a subset of $S$. Let $f$ and $g$ agree on $H$. Let $K = f \sqbrk H$ be the image set of $H$ under $f$. Let the intersection of $K$ with every set of the form: $\set {y \in T: u < y < v: u, v \in T, u < v}$ be non-empty. Then $f = g$.

title: Condition for Valid Time Indication
snippet: Consider an analog clock $C$ with an hour hand $H$ and a minute hand $M$. Let $\theta \degrees$ be the angle made by the minute hand with respect to twelve o'clock. Let $\phi \degrees$ be the angle made by the hour hand with respect to twelve o'clock. Then $C$ displays a valid time indication : $12 \phi \mod 360 = \theta$

title: Condition for Variance Ratio to have Snedecor's F-Distribution
snippet: Let $V$ be the variance ratio obtained as the result of an analysis of variance exercise. Suppose that the errors are: independently normally distributed with zero expectation with equal variances. Under the null hypothesis of no difference between treatment means, $V$ has Snedecor's F-distribution. High values of variance ratio indicate rejection of the null hypothesis.

title: Condition for Vector Field to satisfy Laplace's Equation
snippet: Let $\mathbf V$ be a vector field over a region of space $R$. Then: $\mathbf V$ is both solenoidal and conservative $\mathbf V$ is the gradient of a scalar field $F$ over $R$ which satisfies Laplace's equation: $\nabla^2 F \equiv 0$

title: Condition for Vector Field to satisfy Poisson's Equation
snippet: Let $\mathbf V$ be a vector field over a region of space $R$. Then: $\mathbf V$ is conservative but not solenoidal $\mathbf V$ is the gradient of a scalar field $F$ over $R$ which satisfies Poisson's equation over $R$: $\nabla^2 F = \phi$ where $\phi$ is a function which is not identically zero.

title: Condition for Vectors to have Same Syndrome
snippet: Let $C$ be a linear $\tuple {n, k}$-code whose master code is $\map V {n, p}$ Let $G$ be a (standard) generator matrix for $C$. Let $P$ be a standard parity check matrix for $C$. Let $u, v \in \map V {n, p}$. Then $u$ and $v$ have the same syndrome they are in the same coset of $C$.

title: Condition for Woset to be Isomorphic to Ordinal
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \preceq}$ be a woset. Let $\struct {S, \preceq}$ be such that $\forall a \in S$, the initial segment $S_a$ of $S$ determined by $a$ is order isomorphic to some ordinal. Then $\struct {S, \preceq}$ itself is order isomorphic to an ordinal.

title: Condition for Zero Discriminant of Quadratic Equation
snippet: Let $a x^2 + b x + c = 0$ be a quadratic equation. Let its discriminant $b^2 - 4 a c$ equal zero. Then $\paren {a x^2 + b x + c}$ is a square.

title: Condition of Tangency to Circle whose Center is Origin
snippet: Let $\CC$ be a circle embedded in the Cartesian plane of radius $r$ with its center located at the origin. Let $\LL$ be a straight line in the plane of $\CC$ whose equation is given by: $(1): \quad l x + m y + n = 0$ such that $l \ne 0$. Then $\LL$ is tangent to $\CC$ : $\paren {l^2 + m^2} r^2 = n^2$

title: Condition on Coefficient of Determination for Total Dependence
snippet: Let $X$ and $Y$ be random variables. The coefficient of determination of $Y$ upon $X$ is equal to $1$ $Y$ is totally dependent upon $X$.

title: Condition on Congruence Relations for Cancellable Monoid to be Group
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \circ}$ be a cancellable monoid whose identity element is $e$. Then: $\struct {S, \circ}$ is a group every non-trivial congruence relation on $\struct {S, \circ}$ is induced by a normal subgroup of $\struct {S, \circ}$.

title: Condition on Conjugate from Real Product of Complex Numbers
snippet: Let $z_1, z_2 \in \C$ be complex numbers such that $z_1 z_2 \in \R_{\ne 0}$. Then: $\exists p \in \R: z_1 = p \overline {z_2}$ where $\overline {z_2}$ denotes the complex conjugate of $z_2$.

title: Condition on Equality of Generated Sigma-Algebras
snippet: Let $X$ be a set. Let $\GG$, $\HH$ be sets of subsets of $X$. Suppose that: $\GG \subseteq \HH \subseteq \map \sigma \GG$ where $\sigma$ denotes generated $\sigma$-algebra. Then: $\map \sigma \GG = \map \sigma \HH$

title: Condition on Lower Coefficient for Binomial Coefficient to be Maximum
snippet: Let $n, k \in \Z_{\ge 0}$ be positive integers. Let $\dbinom n k$ denote the binomial coefficient of $n$ choose $k$. Then for a given value of $n$, the value of $k$ for which $\dbinom n k$ is a maximum is: $k_\max = \floor {\dfrac n 2}$ and also: $k_\max = \ceiling {\dfrac n 2}$

title: Condition on Proper Lower Sections for Total Ordering to be Well-Ordering/Mistake
snippet: == Source Work == Chapter $4$: Superinduction, Well Ordering and Choice: Part $\text I$ -- Superinduction and Well Ordering: $\S 1$ Introduction to well ordering: Exercise $1.2$

title: Conditional/Examples
snippet: == Examples of Conditionals ==

title: Conditional Dominated Convergence Theorem
snippet: Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a probability space. Let $X$ be an integrable random variable. Let $\sequence {X_n}_{n \in \N}$ be an sequence of non-negative integrable random variables converging almost surely to $X$, such that: there exists an integrable random variable $Y$ such that: $\size {X_n} \le Y$ almost surely. Let $\GG \subseteq \Sigma$ be a sub-$\sigma$-algebra. For each $n \in \N$, let $\expect {X_n \mid \GG}$ be a version of the conditional expectation of $X_n$ conditioned on $\GG$.

title: Conditional Entropy Decreases if More Given
snippet: Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a probability space. Let $\AA, \CC, \DD \subseteq \Sigma$ be finite sub-$\sigma$-algebras. Then: $\CC \subseteq \DD \implies \map H {\AA \mid \CC} \ge \map H {\AA \mid \DD}$ where: $\map H {\cdot \mid \cdot}$ denotes the conditional entropy

title: Conditional Entropy Given Trivial Sigma-Algebra is Entropy
snippet: Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a probability space. Let $\AA \subseteq \Sigma$ be a finite sub-$\sigma$-algebra. Let $\NN := \set {\O, \Omega}$ be the trivial $\sigma$-algebra. Then: $\ds \map H {\AA \mid \NN} = \map H \AA$ where: $\map H {\cdot \mid \cdot}$ denotes the conditional entropy $\map H {\, \cdot \,}$ denotes the entropy

title: Conditional Entropy of Join as Sum
snippet: Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a probability space. Let $\AA, \CC, \DD \subseteq \Sigma$ be finite sub-$\sigma$-algebras. Then: $\ds \map H {\AA \vee \CC \mid \DD} = \map H {\AA \mid \DD} + \map H {\CC \mid \AA \vee \DD} $ where: $\map H {\cdot \mid \cdot}$ denotes the conditional entropy $\vee$ denotes the join

title: Conditional Equation/Examples
snippet: == Examples of Conditional Equations ==

title: Conditional Expectation Conditioned on Event of Non-Zero Probability
snippet: Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a probability space. Let $X$ be an integrable random variable on $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$. Let $B \in \Sigma$ be an event with: $\map \Pr B > 0$ Let: $\GG = \map \sigma B = \set {\O, B, B^c, \Omega}$ where $\map \sigma B$ is the $\sigma$-algebra generated by $B$. Let: $\ds \alpha = \frac {\expect {X \cdot 1_B} } {\map \Pr B}$ and: $\ds \beta = \frac {\expect {X \cdot 1_{B^c} } } {\map \Pr {B^c} }$ Let $\expect {X \mid \GG}$ be a version of the conditional expectation of $X$ given $\GG$.

title: Conditional Expectation Conditioned on Trivial Sigma-Algebra
snippet: Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a probability space. Let $X$ be an integrable random variable. Let $\expect {X \mid \set {\O, \Omega} }$ be a version of the conditional expectation of $X$ given $\set {\O, \Omega}$. Then: $\expect {X \mid \set {\O, \Omega} } = \expect X$ almost everywhere.

title: Conditional Expectation Unchanged on Conditioning on Independent Sigma-Algebra
snippet: Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a probability space. Let $\GG \subseteq \Sigma$ be a sub-$\sigma$-algebra. Let $X$ be a integrable random variable. Let $\map \sigma X$ be the $\sigma$-algebra generated by $X$. Let $\HH \subseteq \Sigma$ be a sub-$\sigma$-algebra that is independent of $\map \sigma {\map \sigma X, \GG}$, the $\sigma$-algebra generated by $\map \sigma X \cup \GG$. Let $\map \sigma {\GG, \HH}$ be the $\sigma$-algebra generated by $\GG \cup \HH$. Let $\expect {X \mid \GG}$ be a version of the conditional expectation of $X$ given $\GG$.

title: Conditional Expectation is Linear
snippet: Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a probability space. Let $\GG \subseteq \Sigma$ be a sub-$\sigma$-algebra. Let $X$ and $Y$ be integrable random variables. Let $\alpha, \beta \in \R$. Let $\expect {X \mid \GG}$ be a version of the conditional expectation of $X$ given $\GG$. Let $\expect {Y \mid \GG}$ be a version of the conditional expectation of $Y$ given $\GG$. Let $\expect {\alpha X + \beta Y \mid \GG}$ be a version of the conditional expectation of $\alpha x + \beta Y$ given $\GG$.

title: Conditional Expectation is Monotone
snippet: Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a probability space. Let $X$ and $Y$ be integrable random variables on $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ such that: $X \le Y$ almost everywhere. Let $\GG \subseteq \Sigma$ be a sub-$\sigma$-algebra of $\Sigma$. Let $\expect {X \mid \GG}$ be a version of the conditional expectation of $X$ given $\GG$. Let $\expect {Y \mid \GG}$ be a version of the conditional expectation of $Y$ given $\GG$. Then we have: $\expect {X \mid \GG} \le \expect {Y \mid \GG}$ almost everywhere.

title: Conditional Expectation of Constant
snippet: Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a probability space. Let $\GG \subseteq \Sigma$ be a sub-$\sigma$-algebra. Let $c \in \R$. Define $X : \Omega \to \R$ by $\map X \omega = c$ for each $\omega \in \Omega$. Let $\expect {X \mid \GG}$ be a version of the conditional expectation of $X$ given $\GG$. Then: $\expect {X \mid \GG} = c$ almost everywhere.

title: Conditional Expectation of Measurable Random Variable
snippet: Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a probability space. Let $\GG \subseteq \Sigma$ be a sub-$\sigma$-algebra. Let $X$ be a integrable random variable that is $\GG$-measurable. Let $\expect {X \mid \GG}$ be a version of the conditional expectation of $X$ given $\GG$. Then: $\expect {X \mid \GG} = X$ almost everywhere.

title: Conditional Expectation of Non-Negative Random Variable is Non-Negative
snippet: Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a probability space. Let $\GG \subseteq \Sigma$ be a sub-$\sigma$-algebra. Let $X$ be an integrable random variable such that: $X \ge 0$ almost everywhere. Let $\expect {X \mid \GG}$ be a version of the conditional expectation of $X$ given $\GG$. Then: $\expect {X \mid \GG} \ge 0$ almost everywhere.

title: Conditional Expectation of Sum of Squared Increments of Square-Integrable Martingale
snippet: Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \sequence {\FF_t}_{t \ge 0}, \Pr}$ be a continuous-time filtered probability space. Let $\sequence {X_t}_{t \ge 0}$ be a continuous-time martingale such that $\size {X_t}^2$ is integrable for each $t \in \hointr 0 \infty$. Let $s, t \in \hointr 0 \infty$ be such that $0 \le s < t$. Let: $s = t_0 < t_1 < \ldots < t_n = t$ be a finite subdivision of $\closedint s t$. Then: $\ds \expect {\sum_{i \mathop = 1}^n \paren {X_{t_i} - X_{t_{i - 1} } }^2 \mid \FF_s} = \expect {X_t^2 - X_s^2 \mid \FF_s} = \expect {\paren {X_t - X_s}^2 \mid \FF_s}$ almost surely.

title: Conditional Expectations of Integrable Random Variable with respect to Filtration forms Martingale
Conditional Fatou's Lemma
snippet: Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a probability space. Let $X$ be an non-negative integrable random variable. Let $\sequence {X_n}_{n \in \N}$ be an sequence of non-negative integrable random variables. Let $\GG \subseteq \Sigma$ be a sub-$\sigma$-algebra. For each $n \in \N$, let $\expect {X_n \mid \GG}$ be a version of the conditional expectation of $X_n$ conditioned on $\GG$. Let $\ds \expect {\liminf_{n \mathop \to \infty} X_n \mid \GG}$ be a version of the conditional expectation of $X$ conditioned on $\GG$.

title: Conditional Inequality/Examples
snippet: == Examples of Conditional Inequalities ==

title: Conditional Jensen's Inequality
snippet: Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a probability space. Let $\GG$ be a sub-$\sigma$-algebra of $\Sigma$. Let $X$ be an integrable random variable. Let $\expect {X \mid \GG}$ be a version of the conditional expectation of $X$ given $\GG$. Let $f : \R \to \R$ be a convex function such that $\map f X$ is integrable. Let $\expect {\map f X \mid \GG}$ be a version of the conditional expectation of $\map f X$ given $\GG$. Then: $\map f {\expect {X \mid \GG} } \le \expect {\map f X \mid \GG}$

title: Conditional Monotone Convergence Theorem
snippet: Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a probability space. Let $X$ be an non-negative integrable random variable. Let $\sequence {X_n}_{n \in \N}$ be an sequence of non-negative integrable random variables converging almost surely to $X$, such that: $X_n \le X_{n + 1}$ almost everywhere for each $n \in \N$. Let $\GG \subseteq \Sigma$ be a sub-$\sigma$-algebra. For each $n \in \N$, let $\expect {X_n \mid \GG}$ be a version of the conditional expectation of $X_n$ conditioned on $\GG$. Let $\expect {X \mid \GG}$ be a version of the conditional expectation of $X$ conditioned on $\GG$.

title: Conditional Probability Defines Probability Space
snippet: Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a measure space. Let $B \in \Sigma$ such that $\map \Pr B > 0$. Let $Q: \Sigma \to \R$ be the real-valued function defined as: $\map Q A = \condprob A B$ where: $\condprob A B = \dfrac {\map \Pr {A \cap B} }{\map \Pr B}$ is the conditional probability of $A$ given $B$. Then $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, Q}$ is a probability space.

title: Conditional Reverse Fatou's Lemma
snippet: Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a probability space. Let $X$ be an integrable random variable. Let $\sequence {X_n}_{n \mathop \in \N}$ be an sequence of non-negative integrable random variables such that: there exists an integrable random variable $Y$ such that: $\size {X_n} \le Y$ almost surely. Let $\GG \subseteq \Sigma$ be a sub-$\sigma$-algebra. For each $n \in \N$, let $\expect {X_n \mid \GG}$ be a version of the conditional expectation of $X_n$ conditioned on $\GG$. Let $\expect {X_n \mid \GG}$ be a version of the conditional expectation of $X_n$ conditioned on $\GG$.

title: Conditional and Converse are not Equivalent
snippet: A conditional statement: $p \implies q$ is not logically equivalent to its converse: $q \implies p$

title: Conditional and Inverse are not Equivalent
snippet: A conditional statement: $p \implies q$ is not logically equivalent to its inverse: $\lnot p \implies \lnot q$

title: Conditional iff Biconditional of Antecedent with Conjunction
snippet: $p \implies q \dashv \vdash p \iff \paren {p \land q}$

title: Conditional iff Biconditional of Consequent with Disjunction
snippet: $p \implies q \dashv \vdash q \iff \paren {p \lor q}$

title: Conditional in terms of NAND
snippet: $p \implies q \dashv \vdash p \uparrow \paren {q \uparrow q}$ where $\implies$ denotes the conditional and $\uparrow$ denotes the logical NAND.

title: Conditional is Equivalent to Negation of Conjunction with Negative
Conditional is Left Distributive over Conjunction
snippet: The implication operator is left distributive over the conjunction operator:

title: Conditional is Left Distributive over Disjunction
Conditional is not Associative
snippet: There exist propositions $p, q, r$ such that: $p \implies \paren {q \implies r} \not \vdash \paren {p \implies q} \implies r$ That is, the conditional is not associative.

title: Conditionally Convergent Series has Infinitely Many Positive and Negative Terms
snippet: Let $S = \sequence {s_n}$ be a real infinite series which is conditionally convergent. Then it has infinitely many strictly positive and negative terms.

title: Conditions Satisfied by Linear Code
snippet: Let $p$ be a prime number. Let $\Z_p$ be the set of residue classes modulo $p$. Let $C := \tuple {n, k}$ be a linear code of a master code $\map V {n, p}$. Then $C$ satisfies the following conditions: $(C \, 1): \quad \forall \mathbf x, \mathbf y \in C: \mathbf x + \paren {-\mathbf y} \in C$ $(C \, 2): \quad \forall \mathbf x \in C, m \in \Z_p: m \times \mathbf x \in C$ where $+$ and $\times$ are the operations of codeword addition and codeword multiplication respectively.

title: Conditions for C^1 Smooth Solution of Euler's Equation to have Second Derivative
snippet: Let $\map y x:\R \to \R$ be a real function. Let $\map F {x, y, y'}:\R^3 \to \R$ be a real function. Suppose $\map F {x, y, y'}$ has continuous first and second derivatives all its arguments. Suppose $y$ has a continuous first derivative and satisfies Euler's equation: $F_y - \dfrac \d {\d x} F_{y'} = 0$ Suppose: $\map {F_{y' y'} } {x, \map y x, \map y x'} \ne 0$ Then $\map y x$ has continuous second derivatives.

title: Conditions for Commutative Diagram on Quotient Mappings between Mappings
snippet: Let $A$ and $B$ be sets. Let $\RR_S$ and $\RR_T$ be equivalence relations on $S$ and $T$ respectively. Let $f: S \to T$ be a mapping from $S$ to $T$. Let $S / \RR_S$ and $T / \RR_T$ be the quotient sets of $S$ and $T$ induced by $\RR_S$ and $\RR_T$ respectively. Let $q_S: S \to S / \RR_S$ and $q_T: T \to T / \RR_T$ be the quotient mappings induced by $\RR_S$ and $\RR_T$ respectively.

title: Conditions for Connected Riemannian Manifold to be Isometric to Quotient of Connected Riemannian Manifold by Covering Automorphism Group
snippet: Let $\struct {M, g}$ and $\struct {\tilde M, \tilde g}$ be connected Riemannian manifolds. Let $\pi : \tilde M \to M$ be a normal Riemannian covering map. Let $\Gamma = \map {\operatorname {Aut}_\pi} {\tilde M}$ be the covering automorphism group. Then $M$ is isometric to $\tilde M ~/~\Gamma$.

title: Conditions for Constant Speed
snippet: Let $B$ be a body moving at constant speed. Then the velocity of $B$ is not necessarily constant.

title: Conditions for Diameter to be Perpendicular Bisector
snippet: If in a circle a diameter bisects a chord (which is itself not a diameter), then it cuts it at right angles, and if it cuts it at right angles then it bisects it.

title: Conditions for Extremal Embedding in Field of Functional
snippet: Let $J$ be a functional such that: $\ds J \sqbrk {\mathbf y} = \int_a^b \map F {x, \mathbf y, \mathbf y'} \rd x$ Let $\gamma$ be an extremal of $J$, defined by $\mathbf y = \map {\mathbf y} x$ for $x \in \closedint a b$. Suppose: $\forall x \in \closedint a b: \map \det {F_{\mathbf y' \mathbf y'} } \ne 0$ Suppose no points conjugate to $\paren {a, \map {\mathbf y} a}$ lie on $\gamma$. Then $\gamma$ can be embedded in a field.

title: Conditions for Floor of Log base b of x to equal Floor of Log base b of Floor of x
snippet: Let $b \in \R$ be a real number. $\forall x \in \R_{\ge 1}: \floor {\log_b x} = \floor {\log_b \floor x} \iff b \in \Z_{> 1}$ where $\floor x$ denotes the floor of $x$.

title: Conditions for Function to be First Integral of Euler's Equations for Vanishing Variation
snippet: Let $\Phi = \map {\Phi} {x, \family {y_i}_{1 \mathop \le i \mathop \le n}, \family {p_i}_{1 \mathop \le i \mathop \le n} }$ be a real function. Let $H$ be Hamiltonian. Then a necessary and sufficient condition for $\Phi$ to be the first integral of Euler's Equations is $\dfrac {\partial \Phi} {\partial x} + \sqbrk{\Phi, H} = 0$

title: Conditions for Function to be Maximum of its Legendre Transform Two-variable Equivalent
snippet: Let $x, p \in \R$. Let $\map f x$ be a strictly convex real function. Let $f^*$ be a Legendre transformed $f$. Let $\map g {x, p} = - \map {f^*} p + x p$ Then: $\ds \map f x = \max_p \paren {-\map {f^*} p + x p}$ where $\ds \max_p$ maximises the function with respect to a variable $p$.

title: Conditions for Functional to be Extremum of Two-variable Functional over Canonical Variable p
snippet: Let $y = \map y x$ and $\map F {x, y, y'}$ be real functions. Let $\dfrac {\partial^2 F} {\partial {y'}^2} \ne 0$. Let $\ds J \sqbrk y = \int_a^b \map F {x, y, y'} \rd x$ Let $\ds J \sqbrk {y, p} = \int_a^b \paren {-\map H {x, y, p} + p y'} \rd x$, where $H$ is the Hamiltonian of $J \sqbrk y$. Then $\ds J \sqbrk y = \bigvalueat {J \sqbrk {y, p} } {\frac {\delta J \sqbrk{y, p} } {\delta p} \mathop = 0}$

title: Conditions for Integer to have Primitive Root
snippet: Let $n \in \Z: n > 1$. Then $n$ has a primitive root one of the following holds: $n = 2$ $n = 4$ $n = p^k$ $n = 2 p^k$ where $p > 2$ is prime and $k \ge 1$.

title: Conditions for Integral Functionals to have same Euler's Equations
snippet: Let $\mathbf y$ be a real $n$-dimensional vector-valued function. Let $\map F {x, \mathbf y, \mathbf y'}$, $\map \Phi {x, \mathbf y}$ be real functions. Let $\Phi$ be twice differentiable. Let: {{eqn | l = \Psi | r = \frac {\d \Phi} {\d x} }} {{eqn | r = \frac {\partial \Phi} {\partial x} + \sum_{i \mathop = 1}^n \frac {\partial \Phi} {\partial y_i} y_i' }} Let $J_1$, $J_2$ be functionals such that: $\ds J_1 \sqbrk {\mathbf y} = \int_a^b \map F {x, \mathbf y, \mathbf y'} \rd x$ $\ds J_2 \sqbrk {\mathbf y} = \int_a^b \paren {\map F {x, \mathbf y, \mathbf y'} + \map \Psi {x, \mathbf y, \mathbf…

title: Conditions for Internal Group Direct Product
snippet: Let $\struct {G, \circ}$ be a group whose identity is $e$. Let $H$ and $K$ be subgroups of $G$. Let the mapping $\phi: H \times K \to G$ defined as: $\forall h \in H, k \in K: \map \phi {h, k} = h \circ k$ be a group isomorphism from the cartesian product $\struct {H, \circ {\restriction_H} } \times \struct {K, \circ {\restriction_K} }$ onto $\struct {G, \circ}$. Then $G$ is the internal group direct product of $H$ and $K$ : $(1): \quad \forall h \in H, k \in K: h \circ k = k \circ h$ $(2): \quad G = H \circ K$ $(3): \quad H \cap K = \set e$

title: Conditions for Internal Ring Direct Sum
snippet: Let $\struct {R, +, \circ}$ be a ring. Let $\sequence {\struct {S_k, +, \circ} }$ be a sequence of subrings of $R$. Then $R$ is the ring direct sum of $\sequence {S_k}_{1 \mathop \le k \mathop \le n}$ : $(1): \quad R = S_1 + S_2 + \cdots + S_n$ $(2): \quad \sequence {\struct {S_k, +} }_{1 \mathop \le k \mathop \le n}$ is a sequence of independent subgroups of $\struct {R, +}$ $(3): \quad \forall k \in \closedint 1 n: S_k$ is an ideal of $R$.

title: Conditions for Lexicographic Order on Pair of Ordered Sets to be Lattice
snippet: Let $\struct {S_1, \preccurlyeq_1}$ and $\struct {S_2, \preccurlyeq_2}$ be ordered sets. Let $\preccurlyeq_l$ denote the lexicographic order on $S_1 \times S_2$: $\tuple {x_1, x_2} \preccurlyeq_l \tuple {y_1, y_2} \iff \tuple {x_1 \prec_1 y_1} \lor \tuple {x_1 = y_1 \land x_2 \preccurlyeq_2 y_2}$ Then: $\struct {S_1 \times S_2, \preccurlyeq_l}$ is a lattice all of the following conditions hold: $(1): \quad \struct {S_1, \preccurlyeq_1}$ is a lattice $(2): \quad$ Either $\preccurlyeq_1$ is a total ordering, or $\struct {S_2, \preccurlyeq_2}$ has a greatest element and a smallest element $(3):…

title: Conditions for Limit Function to be Limit Minimizing Function of Functional
snippet: Let $y$ be a real function. Let $J \sqbrk y$ be a functional. Let $\sequence {y_n}$ be a minimizing sequence of $J$. Let: $\ds \lim_{n \mathop \to \infty} y_n = \hat y$ Suppose $J$ is lower semicontinuous at $y = \hat y$. Then: $\ds J \sqbrk {\hat y} = \lim_{n \mathop \to \infty} J \sqbrk {y_n}$

title: Conditions for Ordering in Ordered Group to be Directed
snippet: Let $\struct {G, \odot, \preccurlyeq}$ be an ordered group whose identity element is $e$. Then: $\preccurlyeq$ is a directed ordering for every $x \in G$ there exist $y, z \in G$ such that $e \preccurlyeq y$, $e \preccurlyeq z$ and $x = y \odot z^{-1}$.

title: Conditions for Preservation of Covergence in Test Function Space under Differentiation
snippet: For all $n \in \N$ let $\Phi_n, \phi_n \in \map \DD \R$ be test functions. Let $\mathbf 0 : \R \to 0$ be the zero mapping. Let $\phi_n$ be such that: $\ds \int_{-\infty}^\infty \map {\phi_n} x \rd x = 0$ Let $\Phi_n$ be such that $\Phi_n' = \phi_n$. Let $\sequence {\Phi_n}_{n \mathop \in \N}$ and $\sequence {\phi_n}_{n \mathop \in \N}$ be sequences in $\map \DD \R$. Suppose $\sequence {\phi_n}_{n \mathop \in \N}$ converges to $\mathbf 0$ in $\map \DD \R$. Then $\sequence {\Phi_n}_{n \mathop \in \N}$ converges to $\mathbf 0$ in $\map \DD \R$ as well.

title: Conditions for Pullback of Pseudo-Riemannian Metric to be Nondegenerate
snippet: Let $\struct {\tilde M, \tilde g}$ be a pseudo-Riemannian manifold of signature $\tuple {r, s}$. Let $M$ be a smooth hypersurface in $\tilde M$. Let $\iota : M \to \tilde M$ be the inclusion mapping. Let $N_p M$ be the normal space at $p \in M$. Then the pullback tensor field $\iota^* \tilde g$ is nondegenerate $\forall p \in M : \forall v \in N_p M : v \ne 0 : \map {\tilde g} {v, v} \ne 0$

title: Conditions for Quotient Map from Riemannian Manifold to its Quotient by Discrete Lie Group to be Normal Riemannian Covering
snippet: Let $\struct {\tilde M, \tilde g}$ be a Riemannian manifold. Let $\Gamma$ be a discrete Lie group. Let $\pi : \tilde M \to \tilde M ~/~ \Gamma$ be a quotient map. Suppose the action of $\Gamma$ is smooth, free, proper, and isometric. Then $\tilde M ~/~ \Gamma$ has a unique Riemannian metric $g$ such that $\pi$ is a normal Riemannian covering.

title: Conditions for Relation to be Well-Ordering
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \RR}$ be a relational structure. $\RR$ is a well-ordering : $(1): \quad$ For all $x, y \in S$, either $x \mathrel \RR y$ or $y \mathrel \RR x$ $(2): \quad$ For every non-empty subset $T$ of $S$, there exists $z \in T$ such that: $\forall x \in T: \paren {x \mathrel \RR z \iff x = z}$

title: Conditions for Smooth Normal Covering Map to be Riemannian Covering
snippet: Let $\struct {\tilde M, \tilde g}$, $\struct {M, g}$ be Riemannian manifolds. Let $\pi : \tilde M \to M$ be a smooth normal covering map. Let $\tilde g$ be invariant under all covering automorphisms. Then there exists a unique $g$ such that $\pi$ is a Riemannian covering.

title: Conditions for Strong Minimum of Functional
snippet: Let $\mathbf y$ be an $n$-dimensional vector such that: $\map {\mathbf y} a = A$ and $\map {\mathbf y} b = B$ Let $J$ be a functional such that: $\ds J \sqbrk {\mathbf y} = \int_a^b \map F {x, \mathbf y, \mathbf y'} \rd x$ Let $\gamma$ be an extremal curve of $J$. Let the following be the field of the functional $J$: $\mathbf y' = \map {\boldsymbol \psi} {x, \mathbf y}$ Let $R$ be an open region containing $\gamma$ and have the field $\boldsymbol \psi$ defined as $\forall \paren {x, \mathbf y} \in R$. Let $\mathbf w$ be a finite vector.

title: Conditions for Subjective Smooth Submersion from Riemannian Manifold to its Orbit Space to be Riemannian Submersion
snippet: Let $\struct {\tilde M, \tilde g}$ be a Riemannian manifold. Let $\pi : \tilde M \to M$ be a surjective smooth submersion. Let $G$ be a Lie group acting on $\tilde M$. Suppose the action of $G$ is smooth, free, proper, and isometric. Let $M = \tilde M \setminus G$ be the orbit space. Then $M$ has a unique smooth manifold structure and Riemannian metric $g$ such that $\pi$ is a Riemannian submersion.

title: Conditions for Subjective Smooth Submersion to be Riemannian Submersion
snippet: Let $\struct {\tilde M, \tilde g}$ and $\struct {M, g}$ be Riemannian manifolds. Let $\pi : \tilde M \to M$ be a surjective smooth submersion. Let $G$ be a group acting on $\tilde M$. Suppose the action of $G$ is isometric, vertical, and transitive on fibers. Then there exists a unique Riemannian metric $g$ such that $\pi$ is a Riemannian submersion.

title: Conditions for Transformation to be Canonical
snippet: Let: $\ds J_1 \sqbrk {\sequence {y_i}_{1 \mathop \le i \mathop \le n}, \sequence {p_i}_{1 \mathop \le i \mathop \le n} } = \int_a^b \paren {\sum_{i \mathop = 1}^n p_i y_i'-H} \rd x$ $\ds J_2 \sqbrk {\sequence {Y_i}_{1 \mathop \le i \mathop \le n}, \sequence {P_i}_{1 \mathop \le i \mathop \le n} } = \int_a^b \paren {\sum_{i \mathop = 1}^n P_i Y_i'-H^*} \rd x$ be functionals.

title: Conditions for Uniqueness of Left Inverse Mapping
snippet: Let $S$ and $T$ be sets such that $S \ne \O$. Let $f: S \to T$ be an injection. Then a left inverse mapping of $f$ is in general not unique. Uniqueness occurs under either of two circumstances: $(1): \quad S$ is a singleton $(2): \quad f$ is a bijection.

title: Conditions on Rational Solution to Polynomial Equation
snippet: Let $P$ be the polynomial equation: $a_n z^n + a_{n - 1} z^{n - 1} + \cdots + a_1 z + a_0 = 0$ where $a_0, \ldots, a_n$ are integers. Let $\dfrac p q$ be a root of $P$ expressed in canonical form. Then $p$ is a divisor of $a_0$ and $q$ is a divisor of $a_n$.

title: Conditions under which Commutative Semigroup is Group
snippet: Suppose the following: Then $\struct {S, \circ}$ is a group.

title: Cone on Compact Space is Compact
snippet: Let $A$ be a compact topological space. Let $C A$ denote the cone on $A$. Then, $C A$ is compact.

title: Cones on Homeomorphic Spaces are Homeomorphic
snippet: Let $X, Y$ be topological spaces. Suppose: $X \sim Y$ denoting that $X$ is homeomorphic to $Y$. Then: $C X \sim C Y$ where $C X$ denotes the cone on $X$.

title: Cones or Cylinders are Equal iff Bases are Reciprocally Proportional to Heights
