orm {\, \cdot \,}_E$ is well-defined and a norm on $X$.

title: Norm Induced by Projections Associated with Schauder Basis makes Schauder Basis Monotone
snippet:
Let $\GF \in \set {\R, \C}$. Let $\struct {X, 
orm {\, \cdot \,} }$ be a Banach space over $\GF$. Let $E = \sequence {e_n}_{n \mathop \in \N}$ be a Schauder basis for $X$. Let $\sequence {S_n}_{n \mathop \in \N}$ be the projections associated with $\sequence {e_n}_{n \mathop \in \N}$. Let $
orm {\, \cdot \,}_E$ be the norm induced by $E$. Then $E$ is a monotone basis for $\struct {X, 
orm {\, \cdot \,}_E}$.

title: Norm Preserves Ordering on Positive Elements of C*-Algebra
snippet:
Let $\struct {A, \ast, 
orm {\, \cdot \,} }$ be a $	ext C^\ast$-algebra. Let $\le_A$ be the canonical preordering on $A$. Let $a, b \in A$ be such that: ${\mathbf 0}_A \le_A a \le_A b$ Then: $
orm a \le 
orm b$

title: Norm Sequence of Cauchy Sequence has Limit
Norm Topology Induced by Metric Induced by Norm
snippet:
Let $\GF \in \set {\R, \C}$. Let $\struct {X, 
orm {\, \cdot \,} }$ be a normed vector space over $\GF$. Let $d$ be the metric induced on $X$ by $
orm {\, \cdot \,}$. Then the open sets of $\struct {X, d}$ as a metric space are precisely the open sets of $\struct {X, 
orm {\, \cdot \,} }$ as a normed vector space.

title: Norm in terms of Normed Dual Space
snippet: Let $\GF \in \set {\R, \C}$. Let $\struct {X, \norm {\, \cdot \,} }$ be a normed vector space over $\GF$. Let $X^\ast$ be the normed dual of $X$. Let $B_{X^\ast}^-$ be the closed unit ball of $X^\ast$. Then: $\ds \norm x = \sup_{f \in B_{X^\ast}^-} \cmod {\map f x}$

title: Norm is Complete Iff Equivalent Norm is Complete
snippet:
Let $R$ be a division ring. Let $
orm {\,\cdot\,}_1$ and $
orm {\,\cdot\,}_2$ be equivalent norms on $R$. Then: $\struct {R,
orm {\,\cdot\,}_1}$ is complete $\struct {R,
orm {\,\cdot\,}_2}$ is complete.

title: Norm is Continuous
snippet:
Let $\struct {V, 
orm {\,\cdot\,} }$ be a normed vector space. Then the mapping $x \mapsto 
orm x$ is continuous. Here, the metric used is the metric $d$ induced by $
orm {\,\cdot\,}$.

title: Norm of Adjoint
snippet:
Let $H, K$ be Hilbert spaces. Let $A \in \map B {H, K}$ be a bounded linear transformation. Let $A^* \in \map B {K, H}$ be the adjoint of $A$. Then $A$ and $A^*$ satisfy: $
orm A_{\map B {H, K} }^2 = 
orm {A^*}_{\map B {K, H} }^2 = 
orm {A^* A}_{\map B {H, H} }$ where: $
orm \cdot_{\map B {H, K} }$ denotes the operator norm on $\map B {H, K}$ $
orm \cdot_{\map B {K, H} }$ denotes the operator norm on $\map B {K, H}$ $
orm \cdot_{\map B {H, H} }$ denotes the operator norm on $\map B {H, H}$

title: Norm of Bochner Integral of Simple Function
snippet:
Let $\GF \in \set {\R, \C}$. Let $\struct {X, 
orm {\, \cdot \,}_X}$ be a Banach space over $\GF$. Let $I$ be a real interval. Let $\lambda$ be the Lebesgue measure on $I$. Let $f : I 	o X$ be a simple function. Then: $\ds 
orm {\int f d \lambda}_X \le \int 
orm f_X d \lambda$ where the $\int$ on the denotes the Bochner integral, and the $\int$ on the denotes the Lebesgue integral.

title: Norm of Bochner Measurable Function is Lebesgue Measurable
snippet: Let $\GF \in \set {\R, \C}$. Let $\struct {X, \norm {\, \cdot \,} }$ be a Banach space over $\GF$. Let $I$ be a real interval. Let $f : I \to X$ be a Bochner measurable function. Then $\norm f : I \to \R$ is Lebesgue measurable.

title: Norm of Bounded Linear Transformation in terms of Closed Unit Ball
snippet:
Let $\GF \in \set {\R, \C}$. Let $\struct {X, 
orm {\, \cdot \,}_X}$ and $\struct {Y, 
orm {\, \cdot \,}_Y}$ be normed vector spaces over $\GF$. Let $T : X 	o Y$ be a linear transformation. Let $B_X^-$ and $B_Y^-$ be the closed unit balls of $X$ and $Y$ respectively. Let $M > 0$. Then $T$ is bounded with $
orm T_{\map B {X, Y} } \le M$ : $T \sqbrk {B_X^-} \subseteq M B_Y^-$

title: Norm of Compact Hermitian Operator is Equal to Greatest Modulus of Eigenvalue
snippet: Let $\struct {\HH, \innerprod \cdot \cdot_\HH}$ be a Hilbert space over $\C$. Let $T : \HH \to \HH$ be a compact Hermitian operator. Let $\map {\sigma_p} T$ be the point spectrum of $T$. Then: $\norm T_{\map \BB \HH} = \max \set {\cmod \lambda : \lambda \in \map {\sigma_p} T}$ where $\norm \cdot_{\map \BB \HH}$ is the norm on the space of linear transformations.

title: Norm of Continuous Function is Continuous
snippet:
Let $\GF \in \set {\R, \C}$. Let $\struct {X, 
orm {\, \cdot \,}_X}$ and $\struct {Y, 
orm {\, \cdot \,}_Y}$ be normed vector spaces over $\GF$. Let $f : X 	o Y$ be a continuous mapping. Define $
orm f_Y : X 	o \hointr 0 \infty$ by: $\map {\paren {
orm f_Y} } x = 
orm {\map f x}_Y$ for each $x \in X$. Then $
orm f_Y$ is continuous.

title: Norm of Double Centralizer Generated by Element of C*-Algebra
snippet:
Let $\struct {A, \ast, 
orm {\, \cdot \,} }$ be a $	ext C^\ast$-algebra. Let $c \in A$. Let $	uple {L_c, R_c}$ be the double centralizer generated by $c$. Then: $
orm {L_c}_{\map B A} = 
orm {R_c}_{\map B A} = 
orm c$ where $
orm {L_c}_{\map B A}$ and $
orm {R_c}_{\map B A}$ denotes the norm of a bounded linear transformation.

title: Norm of Eisenstein Integer
snippet: Let $\alpha$ be an Eisenstein integer. That is: $\alpha = a + b \omega$ for some $a, b \in \Z$ where $\omega := e^{2 \pi i /3}$ is a cube root of unity. Then: $\cmod \alpha^2 = a^2 - a b + b^2$ where $\cmod {\, \cdot \,}$ denotes the modulus of a complex number.

title: Norm of Element of Approximate Identity of C*-Algebra is Less Than or equal to One
snippet: Let $\struct {A, \ast, \norm {\, \cdot \,} }$ be a $\text C^\ast$-algebra. Let $\family {e_\lambda}_{\lambda \in \Lambda}$ be an approximate identity of $A$. Then for each $\lambda \in \Lambda$ we have: $\norm {e_\lambda} \le 1$

title: Norm of Element of C*-Algebra as Supremum over Closed Unit Ball
Norm of Hermitian Operator
snippet:
Let $\mathbb F \in \set {\R, \C}$. Let $\struct {\HH, \innerprod \cdot \cdot_\HH}$ be a Hilbert space over $\mathbb F$. Let $A : \HH 	o \HH$ be a bounded Hermitian operator. Let $
orm \cdot_\HH$ be the inner product norm on $\HH$. Then the norm of $A$ satisfies: $
orm A = \sup \set {\size {\innerprod {A h} h_\HH}: h \in \HH, 
orm h_\HH = 1}$

title: Norm of Identity Element in Normed Algebra Lower Bounded by One
snippet:
Let $\struct {R, 
orm {\, \cdot \,}_R}$ be a normed division ring. Let $\struct {A, 
orm {\, \cdot \,} }$ be a normed algebra over $R$ with identity element ${\mathbf 1}_A 
e {\mathbf 0}_A$. Then $1 \le 
orm { {\mathbf 1}_A}$.

title: Norm of Inverse of Sequence of Invertible Elements Converging to Non-Invertible Element in Unital Banach Algebra
snippet: Let $\struct {A, \norm {\, \cdot \,} }$ be a unital Banach algebra. Let $\map G A$ be the group of units of $A$. Let $x \in A \setminus \map G A$. Let $\sequence {x_n}_{n \in \N}$ be a sequence in $\map G A$ such that $x_n \to x$. Then $\norm {x_n^{-1} } \to \infty$ as $n \to \infty$.

title: Norm of Non-Negative Increasing Continuous Function applied to Positive Element of Unital C*-Algebra
snippet:
Let $\struct {A, \ast, 
orm {\, \cdot \,} }$ be a unital $	ext C^\ast$-algebra. Let $x \in A$ be positive. Let $\map {\sigma_A} x \subseteq \hointr 0 \infty$ be the spectrum of $x$ in $A$. Let $f : \map {\sigma_A} x 	o \hointr 0 \infty$ be an increasing continuous function. Let $\map f x$ be obtained from the continuous functional calculus. Then we have: $
orm {\map f x} = \map f {
orm x}$

title: Norm of Positive Element of Unital C*-Algebra in terms of State Space
snippet: Let $\struct {A, \ast, \norm {\, \cdot \,} }$ be a unital $\text C^\ast$-algebra. Let $S_A$ be the set of states on $A$. Let $a \in A$ be positive. Then: $\norm a = \sup \set {\map \phi a : \phi \in S_A}$

title: Norm of Positive Linear Functional on Unital C*-Algebra
snippet:
Let $\struct {A, \ast, 
orm {\, \cdot \,} }$ be a unital $	ext C^\ast$-algebra with identity element ${\mathbf 1}_A$. Let $f : A 	o \C$ be a positive linear functional. Let $
orm {\, \cdot \,}_{A^\ast}$ be the norm of a bounded linear functional. Then $f$ is bounded and: $
orm f_{A^\ast} = \map f { {\mathbf 1}_A}$

title: Norm of Refinement is no Greater than Norm of Subdivision
snippet:
Let $P$ be a finite subdivision of $\closedint a b$. Let $P'$ be a refinement of $P$. Then: $
orm {P'} \le 
orm P$ where $
orm P$ denotes the norm of $P$.

title: Norm of Summation
snippet:
Let $\struct {X, 
orm \cdot}$ be a normed vector space. Let $\sequence {x_n}_{n \mathop \in \N}$ be a sequence in $X$. Then: $\ds 
orm {\sum_{k \mathop = 1}^n x_k} \le \sum_{k \mathop = 1}^n 
orm {x_k}$ for all $n \in \N$.

title: Norm of Unit of Normed Division Algebra
snippet: Let $\struct {A_F, \oplus}$ be a normed division algebra. Let the unit of $\struct {A_F, \oplus}$ be $1_A$. Then: $\norm {1_A} = 1$ where $\norm {1_A}$ denotes the norm of $1_A$.

title: Norm of Vector Cross Product
Norm on Bounded Linear Functional is Finite
snippet:
Let $V$ be a normed vector space. Let $L$ be a bounded linear functional on $V$. Let $
orm L$ denote the norm on $L$ defined as: $
orm L = \inf \set {c > 0:  orall v \in V: \size {L v} \le c 
orm v_V}$ Then: $
orm L < \infty$

title: Norm on Bounded Linear Transformation is Finite
snippet:
Let $\GF \in \set {\R, \C}$. Let $\struct {X, 
orm {\, \cdot \,}_X}$ and $\struct {Y, 
orm {\, \cdot \,}_Y}$ be normed vector spaces over $\GF$. Let $A: X 	o Y$ be a bounded linear transformation. Let $
orm A$ denote the norm of $A$ defined by: $
orm A = \inf \set {c > 0:  orall h \in X : 
orm {A x}_Y \le c 
orm x_X}$ Then: $
orm A < \infty$

title: Norm on Bounded Linear Transformation is Submultiplicative
snippet:
Let $\struct {X, 
orm \cdot_X}$, $\struct {Y, 
orm \cdot_Y}$ and $\struct {Z, 
orm \cdot_Z}$ be normed vector spaces. Let $A : X 	o Y$ and $B : Y 	o Z$ be bounded linear transformations. Let $
orm \cdot _{\map B {X,Y} }$ be the norm for bounded linear transformations $X 	o Y$. Let $
orm \cdot _{\map B {Y,Z} }$ be the norm for bounded linear transformations $Y 	o Z$. Let $
orm \cdot _{\map B {X,Z} }$ be the norm for bounded linear transformations $X 	o Z$.

title: Norm on C*-Algebra is Unique
snippet:
Let $\struct {A, \ast}$ be a $\ast$-algebra over $\C$. Let $
orm {\, \cdot \,}_1$ and $
orm {\, \cdot \,}_2$ be algebra norms on $\struct {A, \ast}$ such that: $\struct {A, \ast, 
orm {\, \cdot \,}_1}$ and $\struct {A, \ast, 
orm {\, \cdot \,}_2}$ are $	ext C^\ast$-algebras. Then: $
orm x_1 = 
orm x_2$ for each $x \in A$.

title: Norm on Space of Bounded Linear Transformations is Norm
snippet:
Let $\GF \in \set {\R, \C}$. Let $\struct {X, 
orm {\, \cdot \,}_X}$ and $\struct {Y, 
orm {\, \cdot \,}_Y}$ be normed vector spaces over $\GF$. Let $\map B {X, Y}$ be the space of bounded linear transformations between $X$ and $Y$. Let $
orm {\, \cdot \,}_{\map B {X, Y} }$ be the norm on the space of bounded linear transformations. Then $
orm {\, \cdot \,}_{\map B {X, Y} }$ is indeed a norm on $\map B {X, Y}$.

title: Norm on Unitization of Normed Algebra is Equivalent to Direct Product Norm
snippet:
Let $\GF \in \set {\R, \C}$. Let $\struct {A, 
orm {\, \cdot \,} }$ be a normed algebra over $\GF$ that is not unital as an algebra. Let $\struct {A_+, 
orm {\, \cdot \,}_1 }$ be the normed unitization of $\struct {A, 
orm {\, \cdot \,} }$. Let $
orm {\, \cdot \,}_2$ be the direct product norm on $A 	imes \GF$. Then $
orm {\, \cdot \,}_1$ and $
orm {\, \cdot \,}_2$ are equivalent norms.

title: Norm on Vector Space is Continuous Function
snippet: Let $V$ be a vector space with norm $\norm {\, \cdot \,}$. The function $\norm {\, \cdot \,}: V \to \R$ is continuous.

title: Norm on Vector Space is Quasinorm
snippet:
Let $\struct {R, +, \circ}$ be a division ring with norm $
orm {\,\cdot\,}_R$. Let $V$ be a vector space over $R$. Let $
orm \cdot$ be a norm on $V$. Then $
orm \cdot$ is a quasinorm on $V$.

title: Norm on Vector Space is Seminorm
snippet: Let $\GF \in \set {\R, \C}$. Let $X$ be a vector space over $\GF$. Let $\norm {\, \cdot \,}$ be a norm on $X$. Then $\norm {\, \cdot \,}$ is a seminorm.

title: Norm satisfying Parallelogram Law induced by Inner Product
Normal Approximation/Examples
snippet: == Examples of Normal Approximation ==

title: Normal Bundle Theorem
snippet: Let $\tilde M$ be an $m$-dimensional Riemannian manifold. Let $M \subseteq \tilde M$ be an immersed or embedded $n$-dimensional submanifold with or without boundary. Let $\valueat {T \tilde M} M$ be the ambient tangent bundle. Let $NM$ be the normal bundle of $M$. Then $NM$ is a rank-$\paren {m - n}$ smooth vector subbundle of $\valueat {T \tilde M} M$.

title: Normal Distribution CDF in terms of Gauss Error Function
snippet: Let $\map \Phi x$ denote the cumulative distribution function of the standard normal distribution. Then: $\ds \map \Phi x = \dfrac 1 2 \paren {1 + \map \erf {\dfrac x {\sqrt 2} } }$ where $\erf$ denotes the Gauss error function.

title: Normal Distribution is Pearson Distribution
snippet: The normal distribution is an example of a Pearson distribution.

title: Normal Element of C*-Algebra is Hermitian iff Spectrum is Real
snippet: Let $\struct {A, \ast, \norm {\, \cdot \,} }$ be a $\text C^\ast$-algebra. Let $x \in A$ be normal. Let $\map {\sigma_A} x$ denote the spectrum of $x$ in $A$. Then $x$ is Hermitian : $\map {\sigma_A} x \subseteq \R$

title: Normal Element of C*-Algebra is Projection iff Spectrum contains only Zero and One
snippet: Let $\struct {A, \ast, \norm {\, \cdot \,} }$ be a unital $\text C^\ast$-algebra. Let $p \in A$ be normal. Let $\map {\sigma_A} p$ denote the spectrum of $p$ in $A$. Then $p$ is a projection : $\map {\sigma_A} p \subseteq \set {0, 1}$

title: Normal Element of Unital C*-Algebra is Unitary iff Spectrum is Subset of Unit Circle
snippet: Let $\struct {A, \ast, \norm {\, \cdot \,} }$ be a unital $\text C^\ast$-algebra. Let $x \in A$ be normal. Let $\map {\sigma_A} x$ denote the spectrum of $x$ in $A$. Then $x$ is unitary : $\map {\sigma_A} x \subseteq \set {z \in \C : \cmod z = 1}$

title: Normal First Order Ordinary Differential Equation/Examples
snippet: == Examples of Normal First Order Ordinary Differential Equations ==

title: Normal Matrix has Orthogonal Eigenspaces
snippet: Let $\mathbf N$ be a normal matrix. Let $\lambda_1, \lambda_2$ be distinct eigenvalues of $\mathbf N$. Then, the eigenspaces of $\lambda_1$ and $\lambda_2$ are orthogonal: $\map \ker {\mathbf N - \lambda_1 \mathbf I} \perp \map \ker {\mathbf N - \lambda_2 \mathbf I}$ where: $\ker$ denotes kernel $\mathbf I$ denotes the unit matrix $\perp$ denotes orthogonality.

title: Normal Matrix is Normal Operator
snippet: A normal matrix is a normal operator.

title: Normal Property is Not Preserved under Expansion
snippet: Let $S$ be a set. Let $T_A = \struct {S, \tau_1}$ and $T_B = \struct {S, \tau_2}$ be topological spaces such that $\tau_2$ is an expansion of $\tau_1$. If $T_A$ is a normal space, then it is not necessarily the case that so is $T_B$.

title: Normal Property is Preserved under Homeomorphism
snippet: Let $T_A = \struct {S_A, \tau_A}$ and $T_B = \struct {S_B, \tau_B}$ be topological spaces. Let $\phi: T_A \to T_B$ be a homeomorphism. If $T_A$ is a normal space, then so is $T_B$.

title: Normal Property is Weakly Hereditary
snippet: Let $T = \struct {S, \tau}$ be a topological space. Let $T_K$ be a subspace of $T$ such that $K$ is closed in $T$. If $T$ is a normal space then $T_K$ is also a normal space. That is, the property of being a normal space is weakly hereditary.

title: Normal Property is not Hereditary
snippet: Let $T = \struct {S, \tau}$ be a topological space which is a normal space. Let $T_H = \struct {H, \tau_H}$, where $\O \subset H \subseteq S$, be a subspace of $T$. Then it does not necessarily follow that $T_H$ is a normal space.

title: Normal Space is Completely Regular
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \tau}$ be a normal space. Then $\struct {S, \tau}$ is also a completely regular space.

title: Normal Space is Pseudocompact iff Countably Compact
snippet: Let $T = \struct {S, \tau}$ be a normal space. Then $T$ is pseudocompact $T$ is countably compact.

title: Normal Space is Regular
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \tau}$ be a normal space. Then $\struct {S, \tau}$ is also a regular space.

title: Normal Space is T3
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \tau}$ be a normal space. Then $\struct {S, \tau}$ is also a $T_3$ space.

title: Normal Space is T3.5
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \tau}$ be a normal space. Then $\struct {S, \tau}$ is also a $T_{3 \frac 1 2}$ space.

title: Normal Space is not necessarily Completely Normal
snippet: A topological space which is a normal space is not necessarily also a completely normal space.

title: Normal Subgroup/Examples
snippet: == Examples of Normal Subgroups ==

title: Normal Subgroup Test
snippet: Let $G$ be a group and $H \le G$. Then $H$ is a normal subgroup (by definition 1) of $G$ : $\forall x \in G: x H x^{-1} \subseteq H$.

title: Normal Subgroup iff Normalizer is Group
snippet: Let $G$ be a group. Let $H$ be a subgroup of $G$. Then $H$ is normal in $G$ the normalizer of $H$ is equal to $G$: $H \lhd G \iff \map {N_G} H = G$

title: Normal Subgroup induced by Congruence Relation defines that Congruence
snippet: Let $\struct {G, \circ}$ be a group whose identity is $e$. Let $\RR$ be a congruence relation for $\circ$. Let $\eqclass e \RR$ be the equivalence class of $e$ under $\RR$. Let $N = \eqclass e \RR$ be the normal subgroup induced by $\RR$. Then $\RR$ is the equivalence relation $\RR_N$ defined by $N$.

title: Normal Subgroup is Kernel of Group Homomorphism
snippet: Let $G$ be a group. Let $N$ be a normal subgroup of $G$. Then there exists a group homomorphism of which $N$ is the kernel.

title: Normal Subgroup of Group of Order 24
snippet: Let $G$ be a group of order $24$. Then $G$ has either: a normal subgroup of order $8$ or: a normal subgroup of order $4$.

title: Normal Subgroup of Order 25 in Group of Order 100
snippet: Let $G$ be a group of order $100$. Then $G$ has a normal subgroup of order $25$.

title: Normal Subgroup of Subset Product of Subgroups
snippet: Let $G$ be a group whose identity is $e$. Let: $H$ be a subgroup of $G$ $N$ be a normal subgroup of $G$. Then: $N \lhd N H$ where: $\lhd$ denotes normal subgroup $N H$ denotes subset product.

title: Normal Subgroup of Symmetric Group on More than 4 Letters is Alternating Group
snippet: Let $n \in \N$ be a natural number such that $n > 4$. Let $S_n$ denote the symmetric group on $n$ letters. Let $A_n$ denote the alternating group on $n$ letters. $A_n$ is the only proper non-trivial normal subgroup of $S_n$.

title: Normal Subgroup of p-Group of Order p is Subset of Center
snippet: Let $p$ be a prime number. Let $G$ be a $p$-group. Let $N$ be a normal subgroup of $G$ of order $p$. Then: $N \subseteq \map Z G$ where $\map Z G$ denotes the center of $G$.

title: Normal Subgroup which is Subset of Normal Subgroup is Normal in Subgroup
snippet: Let $G$ be a group. Let $H$ and $K$ be normal subgroups of $G$. Let $H \subseteq K$. Then $H$ is a normal subgroup of $K$.

title: Normal Sylow p-Subgroups in Group of Order 12
snippet: Let $G$ be of order $12$. Then $G$ has either: a normal Sylow $2$-subgroup or: a normal Sylow $3$-subgroup.

title: Normal Vectors Form Space around Simple Complex Contour
snippet: Let $C$ be a simple contour in the complex plane $\C$ with parameterization $\gamma: \closedint a b \to \C$. Let $t \in \openint a b$ such that $\gamma$ is complex-differentiable at $t$. Then there exists $r, R \in \R_{>0}$ such that: for all $s \in \openint { t-R }{ t+R }$ and for all $\epsilon \in \openint 0 r$: $\map \gamma s + \epsilon i \map {\gamma'} s \notin \Img C$, and $\map \gamma s - \epsilon i \map {\gamma'} s \notin \Img C$ where $\Img C$ denotes the image of $C$.

title: Normal p-Subgroup contained in All Sylow p-Subgroups
snippet: Let $G$ be a finite group. Let $p$ be a prime number. Let $H$ be a normal subgroup of $G$ which is a $p$-group. Then $H$ is a subset of every Sylow $p$-subgroup of $G$.

title: Normal to Circle passes through Center
snippet: A normal $\NN$ to a circle $\CC$ passes through the center of $\CC$.

title: Normal to Curve is Tangent to Evolute
snippet: Let $C$ be a curve defined by a real function which is twice differentiable. Let the curvature of $C$ be non-constant. Let $P$ be a point on $C$. Let $Q$ be the center of curvature of $C$ at $P$. The normal to $C$ at $P$ is tangent to the evolute $E$ of $C$ at $Q$.

title: Normal to Cycloid passes through Bottom of Generating Circle
snippet: Let $C$ be a cycloid generated by the equations: $x = a \paren {\theta - \sin \theta}$ $y = a \paren {1 - \cos \theta}$ Then the normal to $C$ at a point $P$ on $C$ passes through the bottom of the generating circle of $C$.

title: Normality Relation is not Transitive
snippet: Let $G$ be a group. Let $N$ be a normal subgroup of $G$. Let $K$ be a normal subgroup of $N$. Then it is not necessarily the case that $K$ is a normal subgroup of $G$.

title: Normalized Block Basic Sequence of Schauder Basis in P-Sequence Space is Isometrically Equivalent to Schauder Basis
snippet: Let $\GF \in \set {\R, \C}$. Let $p \in \hointr 1 \infty$. Let $\struct {\map {\ell_p} \GF, \norm {\, \cdot \,}_p}$ be the $p$-sequence space. Let $\sequence {e_n}_{n \mathop \in \N}$ be the Schauder basis given by P-Sequence Space admits Schauder Basis. Let $\sequence {y_k}_{k \mathop \in \N}$ be a block basic sequence of $\sequence {e_n}_{n \mathop \in \N}$ with: $\norm {y_k}_p = 1$ for each $k \in \N$. Then $\sequence {y_k}_{k \mathop \in \N}$ is isometrically equivalent to $\sequence {e_n}_{n \mathop \in \N}$.

title: Normalized Block Basic Sequence of Schauder Basis in Space of Zero-Limit Sequences is Isometrically Equivalent to Schauder Basis
snippet: Let $\GF \in \set {\R, \C}$. Let $\struct {\map {c_0} \GF, \norm {\, \cdot \,}_\infty}$ be the space of zero-limit sequences. Let $\sequence {e_n}_{n \mathop \in \N}$ be the Schauder basis given by Space of Zero-Limit Sequences admits Schauder Basis. Let $\sequence {y_k}_{k \mathop \in \N}$ be a block basic sequence of $\sequence {e_n}_{n \mathop \in \N}$ with: $\norm {y_k}_\infty = 1$ for each $k \in \N$. Then $\sequence {y_k}_{k \mathop \in \N}$ is isometrically equivalent to $\sequence {e_n}_{n \mathop \in \N}$.

title: Normalized Sequence in P-Sequence Space which Vanishes Pointwise has Basic Subsequence Equivalent to Schauder Basis
snippet: Let $\GF \in \set {\R, \C}$. Let $p \in \hointr 1 \infty$. Let $\struct {\map {\ell_p} \GF, \norm {\, \cdot \,}_p}$ be the $p$-sequence spaces. Let $\sequence {e_n}_{n \mathop \in \N}$ be the Schauder basis for $\map {\ell_p} \GF$ given by P-Sequence Space admits Schauder Basis. Let $\sequence {x_n}_{n \mathop \in \N}$ be a sequence in $\map {\ell_p} \GF$ such that: $\norm {x_n}_p = 1$ for all $n \in \N$ and: $\map {x_n} j \to 0$ as $n \to \infty$ for each $j \in \N$.

title: Normalized URM Program
snippet: Let $P$ be a URM program. Let $l = \map \lambda P$ be the number of basic instructions in $P$. Let $u = \map \rho P$ be the number of registers used by $P$. Then $P$ can be modified as follows: Every Jump of the form $\map J {m, n, q}$ where $q > l$ may be replaced by $\map J {m, n, l + 1}$ If $u > 0$, a Clear Registers Program $\map Z {2, u}$ can be appended to the end of $P$ at lines $l + 1$ to $l + u - 1$. The new program $P'$ that results from the above modifications produces exactly the same output as $P$ for each input. Note now though that $\map \lambda {P'} = l + u - 1$.

title: Normalizer is Subgroup
snippet: Let $G$ be a group. The normalizer of a subset $S \subseteq G$ is a subgroup of $G$. $S \subseteq G \implies \map {N_G} S \le G$

title: Normalizer of Center is Group
snippet: Let $G$ be a group. Let $\map Z G$ be the center of $G$. Let $x \in G$. Let $\map {N_G} x$ be the normalizer of $x$ in $G$. Then: $\map Z G = \set {x \in G: \map {N_G} x = G}$ That is, the center of a group $G$ is the set of elements $x$ of $G$ such that the normalizer of $x$ is the whole of $G$. Thus: $x \in \map Z G \iff \map {N_G} x = G$ and so: $\index G {\map {N_G} x} = 1$ where $\index G {\map {N_G} x}$ is the index of $\map {N_G} x$ in $G$.

title: Normalizer of Conjugate is Conjugate of Normalizer
snippet: Let $G$ be a group. Let $a \mathop \in G$. Let $S$ be a subset of $G$. Let $S^a$ denote the conjugate of $S$ by $a$. Let $\map {N_G} S$ denote the normalizer of $S$ in $G$. Then: $\map {N_G} {S^a} = \paren {\map {N_G} S}^a$ That is, the normalizer of a conjugate is the conjugate of the normalizer:

title: Normalizer of Reflection in Dihedral Group
snippet: Let $n \in \N$ be a natural number such that $n \ge 3$. Let $D_n$ be the dihedral group of order $2 n$, given by: $D_n = \gen {\alpha, \beta: \alpha^n = \beta^2 = e, \beta \alpha \beta = \alpha^{−1} }$ Let $\map {N_{D_n} } {\set \beta}$ denote the normalizer of the singleton containing the reflection element $\beta$. Then: $\map {N_{D_n} } {\set \beta} = \begin{cases} \set {e, \beta} & : n \text { odd} \\ \set {e, \beta, \alpha^{n / 2}, \alpha^{n / 2} \beta} & : n \text { even} \end{cases}$

title: Normalizer of Rotation in Dihedral Group
snippet: Let $n \in \N$ be a natural number such that $n \ge 3$. Let $D_n$ be the dihedral group of order $2 n$, given by: $D_n = \gen {\alpha, \beta: \alpha^n = \beta^2 = e, \beta \alpha \beta = \alpha^{−1} }$ Let $\map {N_{D_n} } {\set \alpha}$ denote the normalizer of the singleton containing the rotation element $\alpha$. Then: $\map {N_{D_n} } {\set \alpha} = \gen \alpha$ where $\gen \alpha$ is the subgroup generated by $\alpha$.

title: Normalizer of Subgroup is Largest Subgroup containing that Subgroup as Normal Subgroup
snippet: Let $G$ be a group. Let $H$ be a subgroup of $G$. Then $\map {N_G} H$, the normalizer of $H$ in $G$, is the largest subgroup of $G$ containing $H$ as a normal subgroup.

title: Normalizer of Subgroup of Symmetric Group that Fixes n
snippet: Let $S_n$ denote the symmetric group on $n$ letters. Let $H$ denote the subgroup of $S_n$ which consists of all $\pi \in S_n$ such that: $\map \pi n = n$ The normalizer of $H$ is given by: $\map {N_{S_n} } H = \map {N_{S_n} } {S_{n - 1} } = S_{n - 1}$

title: Normalizer of Sylow p-Subgroup
snippet: Let $P$ be a Sylow $p$-subgroup of a finite group $G$. Let $\map {N_G} P$ be the normalizer of $P$. Then any $p$-subgroup of $\map {N_G} P$ is contained in $P$. In particular, $P$ is the unique Sylow $p$-subgroup of $\map {N_G} P$.

snippet: Let $A = \struct {A_F, \oplus}$ be a normed divison algebra over a field $F$. Let the unit of $A$ be $1_A$, and the zero of $A$ be $0_A$. Then $A$ is a unitary division algebra. Also: $\norm {1_A} = 1$ where $\norm {1_A}$ denotes the norm of $1_A$.

title: Normed Dual Space Separates Points
snippet: Let $\struct {X, \norm \cdot_X}$ be a normed vector space. Let $\struct {X^\ast, \norm \cdot_{X^\ast} }$ be the normed dual space of $X$. Then $X^\ast$ separates points. That is, suppose that $x, y \in X$ are such that: $\map f x = \map f y$ for each $f \in X^\ast$. Then $x = y$.

title: Normed Dual Space of Finite Dimensional Normed Vector Space is Linearly Isomorphic to Original Space
snippet:
Let $\GF \in \set {\R, \C}$. Let $\struct {X, 
orm {\, \cdot \,}_X}$ be a finite-dimensional normed vector space over $\GF$. Let $\struct {X^\ast, 
orm {\, \cdot \,}_{X^\ast} }$ be the normed dual of $\struct {X, 
orm {\, \cdot \,}_X}$. Then $\struct {X^\ast, 
orm {\, \cdot \,}_{X^\ast} }$ is linearly isomorphic to $\struct {X,

title: Normed Dual Space of Infinite-Dimensional Normed Vector Space is Infinite-Dimensional
snippet: Let $\GF \in \set {\R, \C}$. Let $\struct {X, \norm {\, \cdot \,} }$ be an infinite dimensional normed vector space. Let $X^\ast$ be the normed dual space of $X$. Then $X^\ast$ is infinite dimensional.

title: Normed Dual Space of Normed Quotient Vector Space is Isometrically Isomorphic to Annihilator
snippet: Let $\GF \in \set {\R, \C}$. Let $\struct {X, \norm {\, \cdot \,} }$ be a normed vector space over $\GF$. Let $X^\ast$ be the normed dual space of $X$. Let $Y$ be a closed linear subspace of $X$. Let $\paren {X/Y}^\ast$ be the normed dual space of the normed quotient vector space $X/Y$. Then: $\paren {X/Y}^\ast$ is isometrically isomorphic to $Y^\bot$ where $Y^\bot$ is the annihilator of $Y$.

title: Normed Dual Space of Separable Normed Vector Space is Weak-* Separable
snippet: Let $X$ be a separable normed vector space. Let $X^\ast$ be the normed dual space of $X$. Let $w^\ast$ be the weak-$\ast$ topology on $X^\ast$. Then $\struct {X^\ast, w^\ast}$ is separable.

title: Normed Dual Space of Space of Zero-Limit Sequences is Isometrically Isomorphic to 1-Sequence Space

title: Normed Dual Spaces of Linearly Isomorphic Normed Vector Space are Linearly Isomorphic
snippet:

orm {\, \cdot \,}_X}$ and $\struct {Y,

title: Normed Dual of Normed Vector Space is Separable iff Closed Unit Ball is Metrizable
snippet: Let $\GF \in \set {\R, \C}$. Let $X$ be a normed vector space over $\GF$. Let $w$ be the weak topology on $X$. Let $X^\ast$ be the normed dual space of $X$. Let $B_X^-$ be the closed unit ball of $X$. Then $X^\ast$ is separable $\struct {B_X^-, w}$ is metrizable.

title: Normed Vector Space is Closed in Itself
snippet: Let $M = \struct {X, \norm {\, \cdot \,}}$ be a normed vector space. Then $X$ is closed in $M$.

title: Normed Vector Space is Finite Dimensional iff Unit Sphere is Compact
snippet: Let $X$ be a normed vector space. Let $\Bbb S = \map {\Bbb S_1} 0$ be the unit sphere centred at $0$ in $X$. Then $X$ is finite dimensional $\Bbb S$ is compact.

title: Normed Vector Space is Hausdorff
snippet: Let $\struct {X, \norm {\, \cdot \,}_X }$ be a normed vector space. Let $\tau$ be the topology on $X$ that consists of all open sets in $X$. That is, $U \in \tau$ : $\forall x \in U: \exists \epsilon \in \R_{>0}: \map {B_\epsilon} x \subseteq U$ where $\map {B_\epsilon} x$ is the open $\epsilon$-ball of $x$. Then $\struct {X, \tau}$ is a $T_2$ (Hausdorff) space.

title: Normed Vector Space is Hausdorff Locally Convex Space
snippet: Let $\GF \in \set {\R, \C}$. Let $\struct {X, \norm {\, \cdot \,} }$ be a normed vector space. Then $\struct {X, \norm {\, \cdot \,} }$ is a Hausdorff locally convex space.

title: Normed Vector Space is Hausdorff Topological Vector Space
snippet: Let $\struct { K, +_K, \circ_K }$ be a valued field with norm $\norm {\,\cdot\,}_K$. Let $\struct {X, \norm {\, \cdot \,}_X }$ be a normed vector space over $K$. Let $\tau$ be the topology on $X$ that consists of all open sets in $X$. That is, $U \in \tau$ : $\forall x \in U: \exists \epsilon \in \R_{>0}: \map {B_\epsilon} x \subseteq U$ where $\map {B_\epsilon} x$ is the open $\epsilon$-ball of $x$. Then $\struct { X, \tau }$ is a Hausdorff topological vector space.

title: Normed Vector Space is Locally Connected
snippet: Let $\GF \in \set {\R, \C}$. Let $\struct {X, \norm {\, \cdot \,} }$ be a normed vector space over $\GF$. Then $\struct {X, \norm {\, \cdot \,} }$ is locally connected.

title: Normed Vector Space is Open in Itself
snippet: Let $M = \struct {X, \norm {\, \cdot \,}}$ be a normed vector space. Then the set $X$ is an open set of $M$.

title: Normed Vector Space is Reflexive iff Closed Unit Ball in Original Space is Mapped to Closed Unit Ball in Second Dual
snippet: Let $X$ be a normed vector space. Let $X^\ast$ be the normed dual of $X$. Let $X^{\ast \ast}$ be the second norm dual. Let $\iota : X \to X^{\ast \ast}$ be the evaluation linear transformation. Let $B_X^-$ be the closed unit ball of $X$. Let $B_{X^{\ast \ast} }^-$ be the closed unit ball of $X^{\ast \ast}$. Then $X$ is reflexive $\iota B_X^- = B_{X^{\ast \ast} }^-$.

orm \cdot_X}$. Let $\iota : X 	o X^{\ast \ast}$ be the evaluation linear transformation. Then $X$ is reflexive : $\iota$ is surjective. That is: $\iota X = X^{\ast \ast}$.

title: Normed Vector Space is Reflexive iff Weak and Weak-* Topologies on Normed Dual coincide
snippet: Let $X$ be a normed vector space. Let $X^\ast$ be the normed dual of $X$. Let $w$ be the weak topology on $X^\ast$. Let $w^\ast$ be the weak-$\ast$ topology on $X^\ast$. Then $X$ is reflexive $\struct {X^\ast, w} = \struct {X^\ast, w^\ast}$.

title: Normed Vector Space is Separable iff Weakly Separable
snippet: Let $\GF \in \set {\R, \C}$. Let $\struct {X, \norm {\, \cdot \,} }$ be a normed vector space over $\GF$. Let $w$ be the weak topology on $X$. Then $\struct {X, \norm {\, \cdot \,} }$ is separable $\struct {X, w}$ is separable.

snippet: Let $\struct {\ell^\infty, \norm {\, \cdot \,}_\infty}$ be the normed vector space of bounded sequences. $\struct {\ell^\infty, \norm {\, \cdot \,}_\infty}$ is not separable.

snippet: Let $\struct {\Q, \size {\, \cdot \,}}$ be the normed vector space of rational numbers. Then $\struct {\Q, \size {\, \cdot \,}}$ is not a Banach space.

title: Normed Vector Space over Complex Numbers with Schauder Basis is Separable
snippet: Let $\struct {X, \norm {\, \cdot \,}}$ be a normed vector space over $\C$. Suppose $X$ admits a Schauder basis. Then $X$ is separable.

title: Normed Vector Space with Schauder Basis is Separable
snippet: Let $\struct {X, \norm {\, \cdot \,}}$ be a normed vector space over $\R$. Suppose $X$ admits a Schauder basis. Then $X$ is separable.

snippet: Not all matroids are base-orderable.

snippet: Not all functions $f: \N \to \N$ are primitive recursive.

snippet: There exist URM computable functions which are not primitive recursive.

title: Not Coprime means Common Prime Factor
snippet: Let $a, b \in \Z$. If $d \divides a$ and $d \divides b$ such that $d > 1$, then $a$ and $b$ have a common divisor which is prime.

title: Not Every Class is a Set
snippet: Let $A$ be a class. Then it is not necessarily the case that $A$ is also a set.

title: Not Every Horizontal Vector Field is Horizontal Lift
snippet: Let $\pi : \R^2 \to \R$ be the projection map such that: $\map \pi {x, y} = x$ Let $W = y \partial_x$ be a smooth vector field on $\R^2$. Then $W$ is horizontal, but there is no smooth vector field whose horizontal lift is equal to $W$.

title: Not Every Number is the Sum or Difference of Two Prime Powers
snippet: Not every positive integer can be expressed in the form $p^m \pm q^n$ where $p, q$ are prime and $m, n$ are positive integers.

title: Not Every Two-Person Zero-Sum Game has Saddle Point
snippet: Not every two-person zero-sum game has a saddle point.

snippet: Let $L = \struct {S, \vee, \wedge, \preceq}$ be a complete lattice. Let $x, y \in S$ such that $x \npreceq y$ Let $\RR$ be an approximating relation on $S$. Then $\exists u \in S: \tuple {u, x} \in \RR \land u \npreceq y$

snippet: Let $L = \struct {S, \vee, \wedge, \preceq}$ be a bounded below algebraic lattice. Let $x, y \in S$ such that $y \npreceq x$ Then $\exists p \in S: p$ is completely irreducible $\mathop \land x \preceq p \land y \npreceq p$

title: Not every Algebraic Number is Constructible
snippet: There exist algebraic numbers which are not constructible.

title: Not every Closed Set is G-Delta Set
snippet: Let $T = \struct {S, \tau}$ be a topological space. Let $V$ be a closed set of $T$. Then it is not necessarily the case that $V$ is a $G_\delta$ set of $T$.

title: Not every Non-Empty Subset of Natural Numbers has Greatest Element
snippet: Let $S \subseteq \N_{>0}$. Then, despite Non-Empty Subset of Initial Segment of Natural Numbers has Greatest Element, it is not necessarily the case that $S$ has a greatest element.
