title: Powers of Commutative Elements in Monoids
snippet: These results are an extension of the results in Powers of Commutative Elements in Semigroups in which the domain of the indices is extended to include all integers. Let $\left ({S, \circ}\right)$ be a monoid whose identity is $e_S$. Let $a, b \in S$ be invertible elements for $\circ$ that also commute. Then the following results hold.

title: Powers of Commutative Elements in Semigroups
snippet: Let $\left ({S, \circ}\right)$ be a semigroup. Let $a, b \in S$ both be cancellable elements of $S$. Then the following results hold:

title: Powers of Commuting Elements of Monoid Commute
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \circ}$ be a monoid whose identity element is $e$. For $a \in S$, let $\circ^n a = a^n$ denote the $n$th power of $a$. Let $a, b \in S$ such that $a$ commutes with $b$: $a \circ b = b \circ a$ Then: $\forall m, n \in \N: \paren {\circ^m a} \circ \paren {\circ^n b} = \paren {\circ^n b} \circ \paren {\circ^m a}$ That is: $\forall m, n \in \N: a^m \circ b^n = b^n \circ a^m$

title: Powers of Commuting Elements of Semigroup Commute
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \circ}$ be a semigroup. For $a \in S$, let $\circ^n a = a^n$ denote the $n$th power of $a$. Let $a, b \in S$ such that $a$ commutes with $b$: $a \circ b = b \circ a$ Then: $\forall m, n \in \N_{>0}: \paren {\circ^m a} \circ \paren {\circ^n b} = \paren {\circ^n b} \circ \paren {\circ^m a}$ That is: $\forall m, n \in \N_{>0}: a^m \circ b^n = b^n \circ a^m$

title: Powers of Coprime Numbers are Coprime
snippet: Let $a, b$ be coprime integers: $a \perp b$ Then: $\forall n \in \N_{>0}: a^n \perp b^n$

title: Powers of Diagonalizable Matrix
snippet: Let $\mathbf A$ be a square matrix which is diagonalizable matrix. Let $\mathbf D$ be the diagonal matrix which is the result of the equation: $\mathbf D = \mathbf X^{-1} \mathbf A \mathbf X$ for some nonsingular matrix $\mathbf X$. Then for all $n \in \Z_{\ge 0}$: $\mathbf A^n = \mathbf X \mathbf D^n \mathbf X^{-1}$

title: Powers of Disjoint Permutations
snippet: Let $S_n$ denote the symmetric group on $n$ letters. Let $\rho, \sigma$ be disjoint permutations. Then: $\forall k \in \Z: \paren {\sigma \rho}^k = \sigma^k \rho^k$

title: Powers of Element form Subgroup
snippet: Let $\struct {G, \circ}$ be a group. Then: $\forall a \in G: H = \set {a^n: n \in \Z} \le G$ That is, the subset of $G$ comprising all elements possible as powers of $a \in G$ is a subgroup of $G$.

title: Powers of Elements in Group Direct Product
snippet: Let $\struct {G, \circ_1}$ and $\struct {H, \circ_2}$ be group whose identities are $e_G$ and $e_H$. Let $\struct {G \times H, \circ}$ be the group direct product of $G$ and $H$. Then: $\forall n \in \Z: \forall g \in G, h \in H: \tuple {g, h}^n = \tuple {g^n, h^n}$

title: Powers of Elements of Geometric Sequence are in Geometric Sequence
snippet: Let $P = \sequence {a_j}_{0 \mathop \le j \mathop \le n}$ be a geometric sequence of integers. Then the sequence $Q = \sequence {b_j}_{0 \mathop \le j \mathop \le n}$ defined as: $\forall j \in \set {0, 1, \ldots, n}: b_j = a_j^m$ where $m \in \Z_{>0}$, is a geometric sequence.

title: Powers of Field Elements Commute
snippet: Let $\struct {F, +, \circ}$ be a field with zero $0_F$ and unity $1_F$. Let $F^* = F \setminus {0_F}$ denote the set of elements of $F$ without the zero $0_F$. Then: $(a):\quad \forall a \in \F^* : \forall n, m \in \Z : a^m \circ a^n = a^n \circ a^m$ $(b):\quad \forall a \in F : \forall n, m \in \Z_{\ge 0} : a^m \circ a^n = a^n \circ a^m$

title: Powers of Group Element Commute
snippet: Let $\struct {G, \circ}$ be a group. Let $g \in G$. Let $m, n \in \N_{>0}$. Then: $\forall m, n \in \N_{>0}: g^n \circ g^m = g^m \circ g^n$

title: Powers of Group Elements
snippet: Let $\struct {G, \circ}$ be a group whose identity is $e$. Let $g \in G$. Then the following results hold:

title: Powers of Imaginary Unit
snippet: The (integer) powers of the imaginary unit $i$ are:

title: Powers of Infinite Order Element
snippet: Let $G$ be a group whose identity is $e$. Let $a \in G$ have infinite order in $G$. Then: $\forall m, n \in \Z: m \ne n \implies a^m \ne a^n$

title: Powers of Permutation Element
snippet: Let $S_n$ denote the symmetric group on $n$ letters. Let $\pi \in S_n$, and let $i \in \N^*_n$. Let $k \in \Z: k > 0$ be the smallest such that: $\map {\pi^k} i \in \set {i, \map \pi i, \map {\pi^2} i, \ldots, \map {\pi^{k - 1} } i}$ Then $\map {\pi^k} i = i$.

title: Powers of Primitive Complex Root of Unity form Complete Set
snippet: Let $n \in \Z_{>0}$ be a (strictly) positive integer. Let $U_n$ denote the complex $n$th roots of unity: $U_n = \set {z \in \C: z^n = 1}$ Let $\alpha_k = \exp \paren {\dfrac {2 k \pi i} n}$ denote the $k$th complex root of unity. Let $\alpha_k$ be a primitive complex root of unity. Let $V_k = \set { {\alpha_k}^r: r \in \set {0, 1, \ldots, n - 1} }$. Then: $V_k = U_n$ That is, $V_k = \set { {\alpha_k}^r: r \in \set {0, 1, \ldots, n - 1} }$ forms the complete set of complex $n$th roots of unity.

title: Powers of Semigroup Element Commute
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \odot}$ be a semigroup. Let $a \in S$. Let $m, n \in \Z_{>0}$. Then: $\forall m, n \in \Z_{>0}: a^n \odot a^m = a^m \odot a^n$

title: Powerset is not Subset of its Set
snippet: Let $A$ be a set. Then: $\powerset A \not \subseteq A$

title: Powerset of Subset is Closed under Intersection
snippet: Let $S$ be a set. Let $T \subseteq S$ be a subset of $S$. Let $\powerset S$ denote the power set of $S$. Then $\powerset T$ is a closed subset of $\powerset S$ under set intersection: $\forall A, B \in \powerset T: A \cap B \in \powerset T$

title: Powerset of Subset is Closed under Symmetric Difference
snippet: Let $S$ be a set. Let $T \subseteq S$ be a subset of $S$. Let $\powerset S$ denote the power set of $S$. Then $\powerset T$ is a closed subset of $\powerset S$ under set intersection: $\forall A, B \in \powerset T: A \symdif B \in \powerset T$ where $\symdif$ denotes symmetric difference.

title: Powerset of Subset is Closed under Union
snippet: Let $S$ be a set. Let $T \subseteq S$ be a subset of $S$. Let $\powerset S$ denote the power set of $S$. Then $\powerset T$ is a closed subset of $\powerset S$ under set union: $\forall A, B \in \powerset T: A \cup B \in \powerset T$

title: Praeclarum Theorema for Meet Semilattices
snippet: Let $(S, \wedge, \preceq)$ be a meet semilattice. Let $a, b, c, d \in S$. Let $a \preceq b$. Let $c \preceq d$. Then $(a \wedge c) \preceq (b \wedge d)$.

title: Pratt's Lemma
snippet: Let $\struct {X, \Sigma, \mu}$ be a measure space. Let: $\sequence {g_n}_{n \mathop \in \N}$ $\sequence {G_n}_{n \mathop \in \N}$ $\sequence {f_n}_{n \mathop \in \N}$ be sequences of $\mu$-integrable functions. Let the pointwise limits: $\ds f := \lim_{n \mathop \to \infty} f_n$ $\ds g := \lim_{n \mathop \to \infty} g_n$ $\ds G := \lim_{n \mathop \to \infty} G_n$ exist. Let $g$ and $G$ be $\mu$-integrable.

title: Pre-Image Sigma-Algebra of Generated Sigma-Algebra
snippet: Let $f: X \to Y$ be a mapping. Let $\GG \subseteq \powerset Y$ be a collection of subsets of $Y$. Then the following equality of $\sigma$-algebras on $X$ holds: $f^{-1} \sqbrk {\map \sigma \GG} = \map \sigma {f^{-1} \sqbrk \GG}$ where $\sigma$ denotes a generated $\sigma$-algebra $f^{-1} \sqbrk {\map \sigma \GG}$ denotes the pre-image $\sigma$-algebra $f^{-1} \sqbrk \GG$ is the preimage of $\GG$ under $f$

title: Pre-Image Sigma-Algebra on Codomain is Sigma-Algebra
snippet: Let $X, X'$ be sets, and let $f: X \to X'$ be a mapping. Let $\Sigma$ be a $\sigma$-algebra on $X$. Denote with $\Sigma'$ the pre-image $\sigma$-algebra on the domain of $f$. Then $\Sigma'$ is a $\sigma$-algebra on $X'$.

title: Pre-Image Sigma-Algebra on Domain is Generated by Mapping
snippet: Let $X, X'$ be sets, and let $f: X \to X'$ be a mapping. Let $\Sigma'$ be a $\sigma$-algebra on $X'$. Let $f: X \to X'$ be a mapping. Then: $\map \sigma f = \map {f^{-1} } {\Sigma'}$ where $\map \sigma f$ denotes the $\sigma$-algebra generated by $f$ $\map {f^{-1} } {\Sigma'}$ denotes the pre-image $\sigma$-algebra under $f$

title: Pre-Image Sigma-Algebra on Domain is Sigma-Algebra
snippet: Let $X, X'$ be sets, and let $f: X \to X'$ be a mapping. Let $\Sigma'$ be a $\sigma$-algebra on $X'$. Then $f^{-1} \sqbrk {\Sigma'}$, the pre-image $\sigma$-algebra on the domain of $f$, is a $\sigma$-algebra on $X$.

title: Pre-Measure of Finite Stieltjes Function Extends to Unique Measure
snippet: Let $\JJ_{ho}$ denote the collection of half-open intervals in $\R$. Let $f: \R \to \R$ be a finite Stieltjes function. Then the pre-measure of $f$, $\mu_f$, extends uniquely to a measure $\mu$ on $\map \BB \R$, the Borel $\sigma$-algebra on $\R$. This unique measure $\mu$ is the measure of $f$.

title: Pre-Measure of Finite Stieltjes Function is Pre-Measure
snippet: Let $\JJ_{ho}$ denote the collection of half-open intervals in $\R$. Let $f: \R \to \R$ be a finite Stieltjes function. Then the pre-measure of $f$, $\mu_f: \JJ_{ho} \to \overline \R_{\ge 0}$ is a pre-measure. Here, $\overline \R_{\ge 0}$ denotes the set of positive extended real numbers.

title: Preceding and Way Below implies Way Below
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \preceq}$ be an ordered set. Let $u, x, y, z \in S$ such that $u \preceq x \ll y \preceq z$ where $\ll$ denotes the way below relation. Then $u \ll z$

title: Preceding iff Join equals Larger Operand
snippet: Let $\left({S, \preceq}\right)$ be a join semilattice. Let $x, y \in S$. Then $x \preceq y$ $x \vee y = y$

title: Preceding iff Meet equals Less Operand
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \preceq}$ be a meet semilattice. Let $x, y \in S$. Then $x \preceq y$ $x \wedge y = x$

title: Preceding implies Image is Subset of Image
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \precsim}$ be a preordered set. Let $x, y \in S$ such that $x \precsim y$ Then $\map \precsim y \subseteq \mathord {\map \precsim x}$ where $\map \precsim y$ denotes the image of $y$ under $\precsim$.

title: Preceding implies Inclusion of Segments of Auxiliary Relation
snippet: Let $\left({S, \vee, \preceq}\right)$ be a bounded below join semilattice. Let $R$ be an auxiliary relation on $S$. Let $x, y \in S$ such that $x \preceq y$ Then $x^R \subseteq y^R$ where $x^R$ denotes the $R$-segment of $x$.

title: Preceding implies Way Below Closure is Subset of Way Below Closure
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \preceq}$ be an ordered set. Let $x, y \in S$ such that $x \preceq y$ Then $x^\ll \subseteq y^\ll$ where $x^\ll$ denotes the way below closure of $x$.

title: Preceding implies if Less Upper Bound then Greater Upper Bound
snippet: Let $L = \struct {S, \preceq}$ be an ordered set. Let $x, y \in S$ such that $x \preceq y$ Let $X \subseteq S$. Then $x$ is upper bound for $X \implies y$ is upper bound for $X$ and $y$ is lower bound for $X \implies x$ is lower bound for $X$.

title: Preceding is Approximating Relation
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \preceq}$ be an ordered set. Then $\preceq$ is an approximating relation on $S$.

title: Preceding is Auxiliary Relation
snippet: Let $\left({S, \vee, \preceq}\right)$ be a bounded below join semilattice. Then $\preceq$ is an auxiliary relation.

title: Preceding is Top in Ordered Set of Auxiliary Relations
snippet: Let $L = \struct {S, \vee, \preceq}$ be a bounded below join semilattice. Let $\map {\it Aux} L$ be the set of all auxiliary relations on $S$. Let $P = \struct {\map {\it Aux} L, \precsim}$ be an ordered set where $\precsim \mathop = \subseteq \restriction_{\map {\it Aux} L \times \map {\it Aux} L}$ Then $\preceq \mathop = \top_P$ where $\top_P$ denotes the greatest element in $P$.

Let $\map P {A, B, C}$ denote the precisely one function on the statements $A$, $B$ and $C$. Then: $\map P {A, B, C} \dashv \vdash \paren {A \land

eg$ denotes negation

title: Predecessor Function is Primitive Recursive
snippet: The predecessor function $\operatorname{pred}: \N \to \N$ defined as: $\map {\operatorname{pred} } n = \begin{cases} 0 & : n = 0 \\ n-1 & : n > 0 \end{cases}$ is primitive recursive.

title: Predecessor is Infimum
snippet: Let $\struct{S, \preceq}$ be an ordered set. Let $x, y \in S$. Then: $x \preceq y$ $x = \map \inf {x, y}$ where $\map \inf {x, y}$ is the infimum of $x$ and $y$

title: Prefix of Fibonacci String
snippet: Let $n \in \Z_{>1}$. Let $S_n$ denote the $n$th Fibonacci string. Let $m \in \Z$ such that $1 < m \le n$. Let $F_m$ denote the $m$th Fibonacci number. The prefix of $S_n$ of length $F_m$ is the Fibonacci string $S_m$.

title: Prefix of String is Substring
snippet: Let $S$ be a string. Let $T$ be a prefix of $S$. Then $T$ is a substring of $S$.

title: Prefix of WFF of Predicate Logic is not WFF
snippet: Let $\mathbf A$ be a WFF of predicate logic. Let $\mathbf S$ be a prefix of $\mathbf A$. Then $\mathbf S$ is not a WFF of predicate logic.

title: Prefix of WFF of PropLog is not WFF
snippet: Let $\mathbf A$ be a WFF of propositional logic. Let $\mathbf S$ be a prefix of $\mathbf A$. Then $\mathbf S$ is not a WFF of propositional logic.

title: Preimage Theorem
snippet: Let $y$ be a regular value of a smooth submersion $f: X \to Y$. Then the preimage $\map {f^{-1} } y$ is a smooth submanifold of $X$, with $\dim \map {f^{-1} } y = \dim X - \dim Y$.

title: Preimage is Subset Iff Subset of Complement of Image of Complement
snippet: Let $S, T$ be sets. Let $f: S \to T$ be a mapping. Then: $\forall A \subseteq S, B \subseteq T : f^{-1} \sqbrk B \subseteq A$ $B \subseteq T \setminus f \sqbrk {S \setminus A}$

title: Preimage of Composite Relation
snippet: Let $\RR_1 \subseteq S_1 \times T_1$ and $\RR_2 \subseteq S_2 \times T_2$ be relations. Let $\RR_2 \circ \RR_1 \subseteq S_1 \times T_2$ be the composition of $\RR_1$ and $\RR_2$. Then the preimage of $\RR_2 \circ \RR_1$ is given by: $\Preimg {\RR_2 \circ \RR_1} = \Preimg {\Img {\RR_1} \cap \Preimg {\RR_2} }$

title: Preimage of Cover is Cover
snippet: Let $\phi: S \to T$ be a mapping between the sets $S$ and $T$. Let $\UU$ be a cover of $T$. Then the set: $\set {\map {\phi^{-1} } U: U \in \UU}$ is a cover of $S$.

title: Preimage of Dilation of Set under Linear Transformation is Dilation of Preimage
snippet: Let $K$ be a field. Let $X$ and $Y$ be vector spaces over $K$. Let $T : X \to Y$ be a linear transformation. Let $E \subseteq X$ be a non-empty set. Let $\lambda \in K$. Then: $T^{-1} \sqbrk {\lambda E} = \lambda T^{-1} \sqbrk E$ where $\lambda E$ denotes the dilation of $E$ by $\lambda$.

title: Preimage of Element under Projection
snippet: Let $A$ and $B$ be sets. Let $A \times B$ be the cartesian product of $A$ and $B$. Let $\pr_1: A \times B \to A$ be the first projection of $A \times B$. Let $a \in A$. Then: $\pr_1^{-1} \sqbrk {\set a} = \set {\tuple {a, b}: b \in B}$ that is: $\pr_1^{-1} \sqbrk {\set a} = \set a \times B$

title: Preimage of Horizontal Section of Function is Horizontal Section of Preimage
snippet: Let $X$ and $Y$ be sets. Let $f : X \times Y \to \overline \R$ be an extended real-valued function. Let $y \in Y$. Let $D \subseteq \R$. Then: $\paren {f^y}^{-1} \sqbrk D = \paren {f^{-1} \sqbrk D}^y$ where: $f^y$ is the $y$-horizontal section of $f$ $\paren {f^{-1} \sqbrk D}^y$ is the $y$-horizontal section of $f^{-1} \sqbrk D$.

title: Preimage of Ideal under Ring Homomorphism is Ideal
snippet: Let $\phi: \struct {R_1, +_1, \circ_1} \to \struct {R_2, +_2, \circ_2}$ be a ring homomorphism. Let $S_2$ be an ideal of $R_2$. Then $S_1 = \phi^{-1} \sqbrk {S_2}$ is an ideal of $R_1$ such that $\map \ker \phi \subseteq S_1$.

title: Preimage of Image of Ideal under Ring Homomorphism
snippet: Let $\phi: \struct {R_1, +_1, \circ_1} \to \struct {R_2, +_2, \circ_2}$ be a ring homomorphism. Let $K = \map \ker \phi$, be the kernel of $\phi$. Let $J$ be an ideal of $R_1$. Then: $\phi^{-1} \sqbrk {\phi \sqbrk J} = J + K$

title: Preimage of Image of Linear Transformation
snippet: Let $K$ be a field. Let $X$ and $Y$ be vector spaces over $K$. Let $T : X \to Y$ be a linear transformation. Let $A \subseteq X$ be a non-empty set. Then $T^{-1} \sqbrk {T \sqbrk A} = \ker T + A$

title: Preimage of Image of Subgroup under Group Epimorphism
snippet: Let $\struct {G_1, \circ}$ and $\struct {G_2, *}$ be groups. Let $\phi: \struct {G_1, \circ} \to \struct {G_2, *}$ be a group epimorphism. Let $K = \map \ker \phi$ denote the kernel of $\phi$. Then: $\phi^{-1} \sqbrk {\phi \sqbrk H} = H \circ K$ where: $\phi \sqbrk H$ denotes the image of $H$ under $\phi$ $\phi^{-1} \sqbrk {\phi \sqbrk H}$ denotes the preimage of $\phi \sqbrk H$ under $\phi$ $H \circ K$ denotes the subset product of $H$ with $K$.

title: Preimage of Image of Subring under Ring Homomorphism
snippet: Let $\phi: \struct {R_1, +_1, \circ_1} \to \struct {R_2, +_2, \circ_2}$ be a ring homomorphism. Let $K = \map \ker \phi$ be the kernel of $\phi$. Let $J$ be a subring of $R_1$. Then: $\phi^{-1} \sqbrk {\phi \sqbrk J} = J + K$

title: Preimage of Image of Subset under Injection equals Subset
snippet: Let $f: S \to T$ be an injection. Then: $\forall A \subseteq S: A = \paren {f^{-1} \circ f} \sqbrk A$ where: $f \sqbrk A$ denotes the image of $A$ under $f$ $f^{-1}$ denotes the inverse of $f$ $f^{-1} \circ f$ denotes composition of $f^{-1}$ and $f$.

title: Preimage of Image under Left-Total Relation is Superset
snippet: Let $\RR \subseteq S \times T$ be a left-total relation. Then: $A \subseteq S \implies A \subseteq \paren {\RR^{-1} \circ \RR} \sqbrk A$ where: $\RR \sqbrk A$ denotes the image of $A$ under $\RR$ $\RR^{-1} \sqbrk A$ denotes the preimage of $A$ under $\RR$ $\RR^{-1} \circ \RR$ denotes composition of $\RR^{-1}$ and $\RR$. This can be expressed in the language and notation of direct image mappings and inverse image mappings as: $\forall A \in \powerset S: A \subseteq \map {\paren {\RR^\gets \circ \RR^\to} } A$

title: Preimage of Intersection under Mapping
snippet: Let $f: S \to T$ be a mapping. Let $T_1$ and $T_2$ be subsets of $T$. Then: $f^{-1} \sqbrk {T_1 \cap T_2} = f^{-1} \sqbrk {T_1} \cap f^{-1} \sqbrk {T_2}$ This can be expressed in the language and notation of inverse image mappings as: $\forall T_1, T_2 \in \powerset T: \map {f^\gets} {T_1 \cap T_2} = \map {f^\gets} {T_1} \cap \map {f^\gets} {T_2}$

title: Preimage of Intersection under Relation
snippet: Let $S$ and $T$ be sets. Let $\RR \subseteq S \times T$ be a relation. Let $C$ and $D$ be subsets of $T$. Then: $\RR^{-1} \sqbrk {C \cap D} \subseteq \RR^{-1} \sqbrk C \cap \RR^{-1} \sqbrk D$

title: Preimage of Lower Section under Increasing Mapping is Lower
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \preceq}$, $\struct {T, \precsim}$ be preordered sets. Let $f: S \to T$ be an increasing mapping. Let $X \subseteq T$ be a lower section of $T$. Then: $f^{-1} \sqbrk X$ is lower where $f^{-1} \sqbrk X$ denotes the preimage of $X$ under $f$.

title: Preimage of Mapping equals Domain
snippet: The preimage of a mapping is the same set as its domain: $\Preimg f = \Dom f$

title: Preimage of Maximal Ideal of Finitely Generated Algebra is Maximal
snippet: Let $k$ be a field. Let $A$ and $B$ be $k$-algebras. Let $f: A \to B$ be a $k$-algebra homomorphism. Let $B$ be finitely generated over $k$. Let $\mathfrak m$ be a maximal ideal of $B$. Then its preimage $\map {f^{-1} } {\mathfrak m}$ is a maximal ideal of $A$.

title: Preimage of Maximum of Real Part of Continuous Linear Functional on Extreme Set in Convex Compact Set is Extreme Set
snippet: Let $\GF \in \set {\R, \C}$. Let $\struct {X, \PP}$ be a locally convex space over $\GF$ with its standard topology. Let $X^\ast$ be the topological dual space of $X$. Let $K$ be a compact convex subset of $X$. Let $M \subseteq K$ be an extreme set in $K$. Let $f \in X^\ast$. Let: $\ds M^f = \set {x \in M : \map \Re {\map f x} = \max_{y \in M} \map \Re {\map f y} }$ Then $M^f$ is an extreme set in $K$.

title: Preimage of Normal Subgroup of Quotient Group under Quotient Epimorphism is Normal
snippet: Let $G$ be a group. Let $H \lhd G$ where $\lhd$ denotes that $H$ is a normal subgroup of $G$. Let $K \lhd G / H$. Let $L = q_H^{-1} \sqbrk K$, where: $q_H: G \to G / H$ is the quotient epimorphism from $G$ to the quotient group $G / H$ $q_H^{-1} \sqbrk K$ is the preimage of $K$ under $q_H$. Then: $L \lhd G$ and there exists a group isomorphism $\phi: \paren {G / H} / K \to G / L$ defined as: $\phi \circ q_K \circ q_H = q_L$

title: Preimage of Normal Subgroup under Epimorphism is Normal Subgroup
snippet: Let $\struct {G_1, \circ}$ and $\struct {G_2, *}$ be groups. Let $\phi: \struct {G_1, \circ} \to \struct {G_2, *}$ be a group epimorphism. Let $H$ be a normal subgroup of $\struct {G_2, *}$. Then: $\phi^{-1} \sqbrk H$ is a normal subgroup of $\struct {G_1, \circ}$ where $\phi^{-1} \sqbrk H$ denotes the preimage of $H$ under $\phi$.

title: Preimage of Open Sets forms Basis if Continuous Mappings Separate Points from Closed Sets
snippet: Let $X$ be a topological space. Let $\family {Y_i}_{i \mathop \in I}$ be an indexed family of topological spaces for some indexing set $I$. Let $\family {f_i : X \to Y_i}_{i \mathop \in I}$ be an indexed family of continuous mappings. Let $\family {f_i}_{i \mathop \in I}$ separate points from closed sets. Let $\BB = \set{f_i^{-1} \sqbrk V : i \in I, V \text{ is open in } Y_i}$. Then: $\BB$ is a basis for $X$

title: Preimage of Prime Ideal under Ring Homomorphism is Prime Ideal
snippet: Let $A$ and $B$ be commutative rings with unity. Let $f : A \to B$ be a ring homomorphism. Let $\mathfrak p \subseteq B$ be a prime ideal. Then its preimage $\map {f^{-1} } {\mathfrak p}$ is a prime ideal of $A$.

title: Preimage of Relation is Subset of Domain
snippet: Let $\RR \subseteq S \times T$ be a relation. Then the preimage of $\RR$ is a subset of its domain: $\Preimg \RR \subseteq S$

title: Preimage of Separation under Continuous Mapping is Separation
snippet: Let $T_1 = \struct {S_1, \tau_1}$ and $T_2 = \struct {S_2, \tau_2}$ be topological spaces. Let $f: T_1 \to T_2$ be a continuous mapping. Let $A, B \subseteq S_2$ such that $A \mid B$. That is, such that $A$ and $B$ separate $T_2$. Then their preimages $f^{-1} \sqbrk A$ and $f^{-1} \sqbrk B$ form a separation of $f^{-1} \sqbrk {T_2}$.

title: Preimage of Serial Relation is Domain
snippet: Let $\RR$ be a serial relation on $S$. Then the preimage of $\RR$ is $S$ (the domain of $\RR$).

title: Preimage of Set Difference under Mapping
snippet: Let $f: S \to T$ be a mapping. Let $T_1$ and $T_2$ be subsets of $T$. Then: $f^{-1} \sqbrk {T_1 \setminus T_2} = f^{-1} \sqbrk {T_1} \setminus f^{-1} \sqbrk {T_2}$ where: $\setminus$ denotes set difference $f^{-1} \sqbrk {T_1}$ denotes preimage.

title: Preimage of Set Difference under Relation
snippet: Let $\RR \subseteq S \times T$ be a relation. Let $C$ and $D$ be subsets of $T$. Then: $\RR^{-1} \sqbrk C \setminus \RR^{-1} \sqbrk D \subseteq \RR^{-1} \sqbrk {C \setminus D}$ where: $\setminus$ denotes set difference $\RR^{-1} \sqbrk C$ denotes the preimage of $C$ under $\RR$.

title: Preimage of Singleton
snippet: Let $\RR$ be a relation. Let $\map {\RR^{-1} } t$ denote the preimage of $t$ under $\RR$. Let $\RR^{-1} \sqbrk {\set t}$ denote the preimage of $\set t$ under $\RR$. Then: $\RR^{-1} \sqbrk {\set t} = \map {\RR^{-1} } t$

title: Preimage of Subgroup under Epimorphism is Subgroup
snippet: Let $\struct {G_1, \circ}$ and $\struct {G_2, *}$ be groups. Let $\phi: \struct {G_1, \circ} \to \struct {G_2, *}$ be a group epimorphism. Let $H$ be a subgroup of $\struct {G_2, *}$. Then: $\phi^{-1} \sqbrk H$ is a subgroup of $\struct {G_1, \circ}$ where $\phi^{-1} \sqbrk H$ denotes the preimage of $H$ under $\phi$.

title: Preimage of Submodule under Linear Transformation is Submodule
snippet: Let $\struct {R, +_R, \times_R}$ be a ring. Let $\struct {G, +_G, \circ_G}_R$ and $\struct {H, +_H, \circ_H}_R$ be $R$-modules. Let $\phi: G \to H$ be a linear transformation. Let $N$ be a submodule of $H$. Then $\phi^{-1} \sqbrk N$ is a submodule of $G$.

title: Preimage of Subring under Ring Homomorphism is Subring
snippet: Let $\phi: \struct {R_1, +_1, \circ_1} \to \struct {R_2, +_2, \circ_2}$ be a ring homomorphism. Let $S_2$ be a subring of $R_2$. Then $S_1 = \phi^{-1} \sqbrk {S_2}$ is a subring of $R_1$ such that $\map \ker \phi \subseteq S_1$.

title: Preimage of Subset is Subset of Preimage
snippet: == Corollary to Image of Subset under Relation is Subset of Image == Let $S$ and $T$ be sets. Let $f: S \to T$ be a mapping from $S$ to $T$. Let $C, D \subseteq T$. Then: $C \subseteq D \implies f^{-1} \sqbrk C \subseteq f^{-1} \sqbrk D$ This can be expressed in the language and notation of inverse image mappings as: $\forall C, D \in \powerset T: C \subseteq D \implies \map {f^\gets} C \subseteq \map {f^\gets} D$

title: Preimage of Subset of Cartesian Product under Injection from Factor
snippet: Let $S$ and $T$ be sets such that $T \ne \O$. Let $S \times T$ denote their cartesian product. Let $t \in T$ be given. Let $j_t: S \to S \times T$ be the injection from $S$ to $S \times T$ defined as: $\forall s \in S: \map {j_t} s = \tuple {s, t}$ Let $W \subseteq S \times T$. Let $V = {j_t}^{-1} \sqbrk W$ denote the preimage of $W$ under $j_t$. Then: $V = \set {s \in S : \tuple {s, t} \in W}$

title: Preimage of Subset under Composite Mapping
snippet: Let $S_1, S_2, S_3$ be sets. Let $f: S_1 \to S_2$ and $g: S_2 \to S_3$ be mappings. Denote with $g \circ f: S_1 \to S_3$ the composition of $g$ and $f$. Let $S_3' \subseteq S_3$ be a subset of $S_3$. Then: $\paren {g \circ f}^{-1} \sqbrk {S_3'} = \paren {f^{-1} \circ g^{-1} } \sqbrk {S_3'}$ where $g^{-1} \sqbrk {S_3'}$ denotes the preimage of $S_3'$ under $g$.

title: Preimage of Subset under Identity Mapping
snippet: Let $S$ be a set. Let $\iota_S: S \to S$ be the identity mapping on $S$. Let $T \subseteq S$. Then: $\iota_S^{-1} \sqbrk T = T$ where $\iota_S^{-1} \sqbrk T$ is the preimage of $T$ under $\iota_S$.

title: Preimage of Subset under Inclusion Mapping
snippet: Let $S$ be a set. Let $H \subseteq S$ be a subset of $S$. Let $i_H: H \to S$ be the inclusion mapping on $H$. Let $T \subseteq S$. Then: $i_H^{-1} \sqbrk T = T \cap H$ where $i_H^{-1} \sqbrk T$ is the preimage of $T$ under $i_H$.

title: Preimage of Subset under Mapping/Examples
snippet: == Examples of Preimage of Subset under Mapping ==

title: Preimage of Subset under Mapping equals Union of Preimages of Elements
snippet: Let $S$ and $T$ be sets. Let $f: S \to T$ be a mapping from $S$ to $T$. Let $f^{-1} \subseteq T \times S$ be the inverse of $f$, defined as: $f^{-1} = \set {\tuple {t, s}: \map f s = t}$ Let $Y \subseteq T$ be a subset of $T$. Then: $\ds f^{-1} \sqbrk Y = \bigcup_{y \mathop \in Y} \map {f^{-1} } y$ where: $f^{-1} \sqbrk Y$ is the preimage of the subset $Y$ under $f$ $\map {f^{-1} } y$ is the preimage of the element $y$ under $f$.

title: Preimage of Subset under Relation equals Union of Preimages of Elements
snippet: Let $S$ and $T$ be sets. Let $\RR \subseteq S \times T$ be a relation on $S \times T$. Let $\RR^{-1} \subseteq T \times S$ be the inverse relation to $\RR$ Let $Y \subseteq T$ be a subset of $T$. Then: $\RR^{-1} \sqbrk Y = \ds \bigcup_{y \mathop \in Y} \map {\RR^{-1} } y$ where: $\RR^{-1} \sqbrk Y$ is the preimage of the subset $Y$ under $\RR$ $\RR^{-1} \sqbrk Y$ is the preimage of the element $y$ under $\RR$.

title: Preimage of Union Mapping is Union of Preimages
snippet: Let $A$, $B$ and $Y$ be sets. Let $f: A \to Y$ and $g: B \to Y$ be mappings that agree on $A \cap B$. Let $f \cup g$ be the union of the mappings $f$ and $g$: $\forall x \in A \cup B: \map {f \cup g} x = \begin {cases} \map f x & : x \in A \\ \map g x & : x \in B \end {cases}$ Let $S \subseteq Y$ be a subset of $Y$. Then: $\paren {f \cup g}^{-1} \sqbrk S = f^{-1} \sqbrk S \cup g^{-1} \sqbrk S$

title: Preimage of Union under Mapping
snippet: Let $S$ and $T$ be sets. Let $f: S \to T$ be a mapping. Let $T_1$ and $T_2$ be subsets of $T$. Then: $f^{-1} \sqbrk {T_1 \cup T_2} = f^{-1} \sqbrk {T_1} \cup f^{-1} \sqbrk {T_2}$ This can be expressed in the language and notation of inverse image mappings as: $\forall T_1, T_2 \in \powerset T: \map {f^\gets} {T_1 \cup T_2} = \map {f^\gets} {T_1} \cup \map {f^\gets} {T_2}$

title: Preimage of Union under Relation
snippet: Let $S$ and $T$ be sets. Let $\RR \subseteq S \times T$ be a relation. Let $T_1$ and $T_2$ be subsets of $T$. Then: $\RR^{-1} \sqbrk {T_1 \cup T_2} = \RR^{-1} \sqbrk {T_1} \cup \RR^{-1} \sqbrk {T_2}$

title: Preimage of Upper Section under Increasing Mapping is Upper
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \preceq}$, $\struct {T, \precsim}$ be preordered sets. Let $f: S \to T$ be an increasing mapping. Let $X \subseteq T$ be a upper subset of $T$. Then $f^{-1} \sqbrk X$ is upper where $f^{-1} \sqbrk X$ denotes the preimage of $X$ under $f$.

title: Preimage of Vertical Section of Function is Vertical Section of Preimage
snippet: Let $X$ and $Y$ be sets. Let $f : X \times Y \to \overline \R$ be an extended real-valued function. Let $x \in X$. Let $D \subseteq \R$. Then: $\paren {f_x}^{-1} \sqbrk D = \paren {f^{-1} \sqbrk D}_x$ where: $f_x$ is the $x$-vertical section of $f$ $\paren {f^{-1} \sqbrk D}_x$ is the $x$-vertical section of $f^{-1} \sqbrk D$.

title: Preimage of Zero of Homomorphism is Submagma
snippet: Let $\struct {S, *}$ be a magma. Let $\struct {T, \circ}$ be a magma with a zero element $0$. Let $\phi: S \to T$ be a magma homomorphism. Then $\struct {\phi^{-1} \sqbrk 0, *}$ is a submagma of $\struct {S, *}$.

title: Preimages All Exist iff Surjection
snippet: Let $f: S \to T$ be a mapping. Let $f^{-1}$ be the inverse of $f$. Let $\map {f^{-1} } t$ be the preimage of $t \in T$. Then $\map {f^{-1} } t$ is empty for no $t \in T$ $f$ is a surjection.

title: Preorder Category is Category
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \precsim}$ be a preordered set. Let $\mathbf S$ be its associated preorder category. Then $\mathbf S$ is a category.

title: Preorder Induced by Preorder Category
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \precsim}$ be a preordered set. Let $\mathbf S$ be its associated preorder category. Let $\precsim'$ be the preorder induced by $\mathbf S$ as on Category Induces Preorder. Then $\precsim'$ is the same as $\precsim$.

title: Preordering/Examples
snippet: == Examples of Preorderings ==

title: Preordering induces Equivalence Relation
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \RR}$ be a relational structure such that $\RR$ is a preordering. Let $\sim$ be the relation induced by $\RR$: $x \sim y$ $x \precsim y$ and $y \precsim x$. Then $\sim$ is an equivalence relation.

title: Preordering induces Ordering
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \RR}$ be a relational structure such that $\RR$ is a preordering. Let $\sim_\RR$ denote the equivalence on $S$ induced by $\RR$: $x \sim_\RR y$ $x \mathrel \RR y$ and $y \mathrel \RR x$ Let $\preccurlyeq_\RR$ be the relation defined on the quotient set $S / {\sim_\RR}$ by: $\eqclass x {\sim_\RR} \preccurlyeq_\RR \eqclass y {\sim_\RR} \iff x \mathrel \RR y$ where $\eqclass x {\sim_\RR}$ denotes the equivalence class of $x$ under $\sim_\RR$. Then $\preccurlyeq_\RR$ is an ordering.

title: Preordering is not necessarily Ordering
snippet: Let $S$ be a set. Let $\RR$ be a preordering on $S$. Then it is not necessarily the case that $\RR$ is also an ordering on $S$.

title: Preordering of Products under Operation Compatible with Preordering
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \circ}$ be an algebraic structure. Let $\precsim$ be a preordering on $S$. Then $\precsim$ is compatible with $\circ$ : $\forall x_1, x_2, y_1, y_2 \in S: x_1 \precsim x_2 \land y_1 \precsim y_2 \implies \paren {x_1 \circ y_1} \precsim \paren {x_2 \circ y_2}$

title: Pressure at Point of Stationary Fluid
snippet: Let $A$ be a point in a body of fluid which is stationary. Then the pressure at $A$ is the same in all directions.

title: Pressure in Ideal Gas
snippet: Let $B$ be a body of an ideal gas $\GG$. Then the pressure in $B$ at a height $h$ is given by: $p_h = p_0 \map \exp {-\dfrac {\rho_0 g h} {p_0} }$ where: $p_0$ is the pressure at height $h = 0$ $\rho_0$ is the (mass) density of $\GG$ at height $h = 0$ $g$ is the acceleration due to gravity

title: Pressure in Static Body of Liquid
snippet: Let $B$ be a body of liquid $\LL$ which is stationary. Then the pressure in $B$ at a depth $h$ is given by: $p_h = \rho g h$ where: $\rho$ is the (mass) density of $\LL$ $g$ is the acceleration due to gravity.

title: Pressure of Gas for Density and Temperature
snippet: The pressure, density and temperature of a body of gas are linked by the equation: $p = k \rho \paren {1 + \alpha t}$ where: $p$ denotes the pressure of the gas $\rho$ denotes the density of the gas $t$ denotes the temperature of the gas $k$ and $\alpha$ are constants.

title: Prim's Algorithm
snippet: == Algorithm == The purpose of this algorithm is to produce a minimum spanning tree $T$ for any given weighted graph $G$. Step 1: Choose any vertex of $G$, and add it to $T$. Step 2: Add an edge of minimum weight $e$ to join a vertex in $T$ to one not in $T$. Step 3: If $T$ is a spanning tree $G$, stop. Otherwise, go to Step 2.

title: Prim's Algorithm produces Minimum Spanning Tree
snippet: Prim's Algorithm always produces a minimum spanning tree.

title: Primality of Euclid Numbers
snippet: == Open Question == Consider the sequence of Euclid numbers: It is not known whether there is an infinite number of: Euclid primes non-prime Euclid numbers.

title: Primary Decomposition Theorem
snippet: Let $K$ be a field. Let $V$ be a vector space over $K$. Let $T: V \to V$ be a linear operator on $V$. Let $\map p x \in K \sqbrk x$ be a polynomial such that: $\map \deg p \ge 1$ $\map p T = 0$ where $0$ is the zero operator on $V$. Let $\map {p_1} x, \map {p_2} x, \ldots, \map {p_r} x$ be distinct irreducible monic polynomials. Let $c \in K \setminus \set 0$ and $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_r, r \in \Z_{\ge 1}$ be constants.

title: Prime-Counting Function in terms of Eulerian Logarithmic Integral
snippet: Let $\map \pi x$ denote the prime-counting function of a number $x$. Let $\map \Li x$ denote the Eulerian logarithmic integral of $x$: $\map \Li x := \ds \int_2^x \dfrac {\d t} {\ln t}$ Then: $\map \pi x = \map \Li x + \map \OO {x \map \exp {-c \sqrt {\ln x} } }$ where: $\OO$ is the big-O notation $c$ is some constant.

title: Prime-Counting Function is Theta of x over Logarithm of x
snippet: We have: $\map \pi x = \map \Theta {\dfrac x {\ln x} }$ where: $\Theta$ is $\Theta$ notation $\pi$ is the prime counting function.

title: Prime-Generating Quadratic of form 2 x squared minus 1000 x minus 2609
snippet: The quadratic function: $2 x^2 - 1000 x - 2609$ has $602$ prime values among its first $1000$ values. Some of those prime numbers are negative.

title: Prime-Generating Quadratic of form x squared - 79 x + 1601
snippet: The quadratic function: $x^2 - 79 x + 1601$ gives prime values for integer $x$ such that $0 \le x \le 79$. The primes generated are repeated once each.

title: Prime-Generating Quadratics of form 2 a squared plus p
snippet: The quadratic form: $2 a^2 + p$ yields prime numbers for $a = 0, 1, \ldots, p - 1$ for values of $p$: $3, 5, 11, 29$

title: Prime Decomposition of Highly Composite Number
snippet: Let $n$ be a highly composite number. Let the prime decomposition of $n$ be expressed as: $n = \ds \prod_{k \mathop \in \N} {p_k}^{r_k}$ where $p_k$ denotes the $k$th prime. Then the sequence $\sequence {r_k}$ is decreasing. That is: $\forall k \in \N: r_k \ge r_{k + 1}$

title: Prime Decomposition of Integer is Unique
snippet: Let $n$ be an integer such that $n > 1$. Then the prime decomposition of $n$ is unique.

title: Prime Divides Power
snippet: Let $p$ be a prime number. Let $a, n \in \Z$ be integers. Then $p$ divides $a^n$ $p^n$ divides $a^n$.

title: Prime Divisors of Cyclotomic Polynomials
snippet: Let $n \ge 1$ be a positive integer. Let $\map {\Phi_n} x$ denote the $n$th cyclotomic polynomial. Let $a \in \Z$ be an integer such that $\map {\Phi_n} a \ne 0$. Let $p$ be a prime divisor of $\map {\Phi_n} a$. Then $p \equiv 1 \pmod n$ or $p \divides n$.

title: Prime Dudeney Number
snippet: The only prime Dudeney number is $17$:

title: Prime Element iff Complement of Lower Closure is Filter
snippet: Let $L = \struct {S, \vee, \wedge, \preceq}$ be a bounded above lattice. Let $p \in S$ such that $p \ne \top$ where $\top$ denotes the top of $L$. Then: $p$ is a prime element $\relcomp S {p^\preceq}$ is filter in $L$ where $p^\preceq$ denotes the lower closure of $p$ $\relcomp S {p^\preceq}$ denotes the relative complement of $p^\preceq$ relative to $S$.

title: Prime Element iff Element Greater is Top
snippet: Let $L = \struct {S, \vee, \wedge, \preceq}$ be a Boolean lattice. Let $p \in S$ such that: $p \ne \top$ Then: $p$ is prime element $\forall x \in S: \paren {p \prec x \implies x = \top}$

title: Prime Element iff Generates Principal Prime Ideal
Prime Element iff Meet Irreducible in Distributive Lattice
snippet: Let $L = \struct {S, \vee, \wedge, \preceq}$ be a distributive lattice. Let $p \in S$. Then $p$ is a prime element $p$ is meet irreducible.

title: Prime Element iff There Exists Way Below Open Filter which Complement has Maximum
snippet: Let $L = \struct {S, \vee, \wedge, \preceq}$ be a bounded below continuous distributive lattice. Let $p \in S$ such that: $p \ne \top$ where $\top$ denotes the top of $L$. Then $p$ is a prime element there exists a way below open filter $F$ in $L$: $p = \map \max {\relcomp S F}$

title: Prime Element is Meet Irreducible
snippet: Let $L = \struct {S, \vee, \wedge, \preceq}$ be a lattice. Let $p \in S$. Let $p$ be a prime element of $L$. Then $p$ is meet irreducible in $L$.

title: Prime Element of Integral Domain is Irreducible
snippet: Let $\struct {D, +, \circ}$ be an integral domain whose unity is $1_D$. Let $p$ be a prime element of $\struct {D, +, \circ}$. Then $p$ is an irreducible element of $\struct {D, +, \circ}$.

title: Prime Enumeration Function/Examples
snippet: == Examples of Prime Enumeration Function == Examples of the prime enumeration function are as follows: Category:Prime Enumeration Function

title: Prime Enumeration Function is Primitive Recursive
snippet: Let the function $p: \N \to \N$ be the prime enumeration function, defined as: $\map p n = \begin{cases} 1 & : n = 0 \\ \mbox{the } n \mbox{th prime number} & : n > 0 \end{cases}$ Then $p$ is primitive recursive.

title: Prime Exponent Function is Primitive Recursive
snippet: Let $n \in \N$ be a natural number. Let $\tuple {n, j}: \N^2 \to \N$ be defined as: $\tuple {n, j} = \paren n_j$ where $\paren n_j$ is the prime exponent function. Then $\tuple {n, j}$ is primitive recursive.

title: Prime Filter is Prime Ideal in Dual Ordered Set
snippet: Let $P = \struct {S, \preceq}$ be a lattice. Let $X$ be a subset of $S$. Then $X$ is a prime filter of $P$ $X$ is a prime ideal of $P^{-1}$ where $P^{-1} = \struct {S, \succeq}$ denotes the dual of $P$.

title: Prime Gap Size is Unbounded
snippet: Let $n \in \N$ be a natural number, arbitrarily large. Then there exist consecutive prime numbers $p_1$ and $p_2$ such that: $p_2 - p_1 > n$ That is, the size of prime gaps is unbounded. That is, there are blocks of consecutive composite numbers whose length exceeds any given $n \in \N$.

snippet: The following pairs of consecutive prime numbers are those whose difference is $10$: $\tuple {139, 149}, \tuple {181, 191}, \tuple {241, 251}, \tuple {283, 293}, \ldots$

snippet: The following pairs of consecutive prime numbers are those whose difference is $100$: $\tuple {396 \, 733, 396 \, 833}, \ldots$

snippet: The following pairs of consecutive prime numbers are those whose difference is $14$: $\tuple {113, 127}, \tuple {293, 307}, \tuple {317, 331}, \ldots$

title: Prime Group has no Proper Subgroups
snippet: A nontrivial group $G$ has no proper subgroups except the trivial group $G$ is finite and its order is prime.

title: Prime Group is Cyclic
snippet: Let $p$ be a prime number. Let $G$ be a group whose order is $p$. Then $G$ is cyclic.

title: Prime Group is Simple
snippet: Groups of prime order are simple.

title: Prime Groups of Same Order are Isomorphic
snippet: Two prime groups of the same order are isomorphic to each other.

title: Prime Ideal Including Ideal Includes Radical
snippet: Let $R$ be a commutative ring with unity. Let $\mathfrak p$ be a prime ideal. Let $\mathfrak a$ be an ideal of $R$ such that: $\mathfrak a \subseteq \mathfrak p$ Let $\map \Rad {\mathfrak a}$ be the radical of $\mathfrak a$. Then: $\map \Rad {\mathfrak a} \subseteq \mathfrak p$

title: Prime Ideal iff Quotient Ring is Integral Domain
snippet: Let $\struct {R, +, \circ}$ be a commutative ring with unity. Let $J$ be an ideal of $R$. Then $J$ is a prime ideal of $R$ the quotient ring $R / J$ is an integral domain.

title: Prime Ideal in Lattice
snippet: Let $\struct {L, \le}$ be a lattice. Let $I$ be an ideal in $L$. Then $I$ is a prime ideal : $\forall a, b \in L: a \wedge b \in I \implies a \in I \text{ or } b \in I$ where $a \wedge b$ denotes $\min \set {a, b}$, the meet of $a$ and $b$.

title: Prime Ideal is Primary Ideal
snippet: Let $R$ be a commutative ring with unity. Let $\mathfrak p$ be a prime ideal of $R$. Then $\mathfrak p$ is a primary ideal of $R$.

title: Prime Ideal is Prime Element
snippet: Let $L = \struct {S, \vee, \wedge, \preceq}$ be a lattice. Let $I$ be an ideal in $L$. Then: $I$ is a prime ideal $I$ is a prime element in $\struct {\map {\mathit {Ids} } L, \precsim}$ where: $\map {\mathit {Ids} } L$ denotes the set of all ideals in $L$ $\mathord \precsim := \mathord \subseteq \restriction_{\map {\mathit {Ids} } L \times \map {\mathit {Ids} } L}$

title: Prime Ideal is Prime Filter in Dual Ordered Set
snippet: Let $P = \struct {S, \preceq}$ be a ordered set. Let $X$ be a subset of $S$. Then $X$ is a prime ideal of $P$ $X$ is a prime filter of $P^{-1}$ where $P^{-1} = \struct {S, \succeq}$ denotes the dual of $P$.

title: Prime Ideal of Principal Ideal Domain is Maximal
snippet: Let $D$ be a principal ideal domain whose zero is $0_D$. Let $J \subseteq D$ be a nonzero prime ideal. Then $J$ is maximal.

title: Prime Ideals of Ring of Integers
snippet: Let $\struct {\Z, +, \times}$ denote the ring of integers. Let $J$ be a prime ideal of $\Z$. Then either: $J = \set 0$ or: $J = \ideal p$ where: $p$ is a prime number $\ideal p$ denotes the principal ideal of $\Z$ generated by $p$.

title: Prime Number Formed by Concatenating Consecutive Integers down to 1
snippet: Let $N$ be an integer whose decimal representation consists of the concatenation of all the integers from a given $n$ in descending order down to $1$. Let the $N$ that is so formed be prime. The only $n$ less than $100$ for which this is true is $82$. That is: $82 \, 818 \, 079 \, 787 \, 776 \ldots 121 \, 110 \, 987 \, 654 \, 321$ is the only prime number formed this way starting at $100$ or less.

title: Prime Number Theorem
snippet: The prime-counting function $\map \pi n$, that is, the number of primes less than $n$, satisfies: $\ds \lim_{n \mathop \to \infty} \map \pi n \frac {\map \ln n} n = 1$ or equivalently: $\map \pi n \sim \dfrac n {\map \ln n}$ where $\sim$ denotes asymptotic equivalence.

title: Prime Number Theorem in Eulerian Logarithmic Integral Form
snippet: The Prime Number Theorem is equivalent to: $\ds \lim_{x \mathop \to \infty} \frac {\map \pi x} {\map \Li x} = 1$ where: $\map \pi x$ is the prime-counting function $\map \Li x$ is the Eulerian logarithmic integral: $\ds \map \Li x := \int_2^x \dfrac {\d t} {\ln t}$

title: Prime Number divides Fibonacci Number
snippet: For $n \in \Z$, let $F_n$ denote the $n$th Fibonacci number. Let $p$ be a prime number. Then: $p \equiv \pm 1 \pmod 5 \implies p \divides F_{p - 1}$ $p \equiv \pm 2 \pmod 5 \implies p \divides F_{p + 1}$ where $\divides$ denotes divisibility. Thus in all cases, except where $p = 5$ itself: $p \divides F_{p \pm 1}$

title: Prime Number divides Infinite Number of Fibonacci Numbers
snippet: Let $p$ be a prime number. Then there exist an infinite number of Fibonacci numbers which are divisible by $p$.

title: Prime Number has 4 Integral Divisors
snippet: Let $p$ be an integer. Then $p$ is a prime number $p$ has exactly four integral divisors: $1, -1, p, -p$.

title: Prime Number iff Generates Principal Maximal Ideal
snippet: Let $\Z_{>0}$ be the set of strictly positive integers. Let $p \in \Z_{>0}$. Let $\ideal p$ be the principal ideal of $\Z$ generated by $p$. Then $p$ is prime $\ideal p$ is a maximal ideal of $\Z$.

title: Prime Number is Deficient
snippet: Let $p$ be a prime number. Then $p$ is deficient.

title: Prime Numbers Composed of Strings of Consecutive Ascending Digits
Prime Numbers Embedded in Digits of Pi
snippet: The sequence of prime numbers that can be found starting from the beginning of the decimal expansion of $\pi$ (pi) begins: $3, 31, 314 \, 159, 31 \, 415 \, 926 \, 535 \, 897 \, 932 \, 384 \, 626 \, 433 \, 832 \, 795 \, 028 \, 841, \ldots$

title: Prime Numbers which Divide Sum of All Lesser Primes
snippet: The following sequence of prime numbers has the property that each is a divisor of the sum of all primes equal to or smaller than them: $2$, $5$, $71$, $369 \, 119$, $415 \, 074 \, 643$, $55 \, 691 \, 042 \, 365 \, 834 \, 801$ As of the time of the last edit to this page (April $2025$), no others are known.

title: Prime Power Group has Non-Trivial Proper Normal Subgroup
snippet: Let $G$ be a group, whose identity is $e$, such that $\order G = p^n: n > 1, p \in \mathbb P$. Then $G$ has a proper normal subgroup which is non-trivial.

title: Prime Power Group is Solvable
snippet: Let $G$ be a group whose order is $p^n$ where $p$ is a prime number and $n$ is a positive integer. Then $G$ is solvable.

title: Prime Power Mapping on Galois Field is Automorphism
snippet: Let $\GF$ be a Galois field whose zero is $0_\GF$ and whose characteristic is $p$. Let $\sigma: \GF \to \GF$ be defined as: $\forall x \in \GF: \map \sigma x = x^p$ Then $\sigma$ is an automorphism of $\GF$.

title: Prime Power of Sum Modulo Prime
snippet: Let $p$ be a prime number. Then: $\forall n \in \N_{> 0}: \paren {a + b}^{p^n} \equiv a^{p^n} + b^{p^n} \pmod p$

title: Prime Powers Differing by One
snippet: $8$ and $9$ are the only powers of prime numbers which differ by exactly $1$: $2^3 + 1 = 3^2$

title: Prime Repdigit Number is Repunit
snippet: Let $b \in \Z_{>0}$ be an integer greater than $1$. Let $n \in \Z$ expressed in base $b$ be a repdigit number with more than $1$ digit. Let $n$ be prime. Then $n$ is a repunit (in base $b$).

title: Prime Sierpiński Numbers of the First Kind
snippet: == Open Question == The only known prime Sierpiński numbers of the first kind are: It is an open question as to whether there are any more.

title: Prime Sum of Squares of 3 Prime Numbers
snippet: Let $a$, $b$ and $c$ be prime numbers with the property that: $a^2 + b^2 + c^2 = p$ where $p$ is a prime number. Then either $1$ or $2$ of $a$, $b$ and $c$ is equal to $3$.

title: Prime Triplet Conjecture
snippet: == Conjecture == It is conjectured that there exist infinitely many prime triplets: that is, sets of three (positive) prime numbers either: $\set {n, n + 2, n + 6}$ or: $\set {n, n + 4, n + 6}$.

title: Prime Values of Double Factorial plus 1
snippet: Let $n!!$ denote the double factorial function. The sequence of positive integers $n$ such that $n!! + 1$ is prime begins: $0, 1, 2, 518, 33 \, 416, 37 \, 310, 52 \, 608, 123 \, 998, 220 \, 502, \ldots$

title: Prime between n and 9 n divided by 8
snippet: Let $n \in \Z$ be an integer such that $n \ge 48$. Then there exists a prime number $p$ such that $n < p < \dfrac {9 n} 8$.

title: Prime equals Plus or Minus One modulo 6
snippet: Let $p$ be a prime number greater than $3$. Then $p$ is either of the form: $p = 6 n + 1$ or: $p = 6 n - 1$ That is: $p = \pm 1 \pmod 6$

title: Prime iff Coprime to all Smaller Positive Integers
snippet: Let $p$ be a prime number. Then: $\forall x \in \Z, 0 < x < p: x \perp p$ That is, $p$ is relatively prime to all smaller (strictly) positive integers.

title: Prime iff Equal to Product
snippet: Let $p \in \Z$ be an integer such that $p \ne 0$ and $p \ne \pm 1$. Then $p$ is prime : $\forall a, b \in \Z: p = ab \implies p = \pm a \lor p = \pm b$

title: Prime is Pseudoprime (Order Theory)
snippet: Let $L = \left({S, \vee, \wedge, \preceq}\right)$ be an up-complete lattice. Let $p \in S$ be a prime element. Then $p$ is pseudoprime.

title: Prime not Divisor implies Coprime
snippet:
Let $p, a \in \Z$. If $p$ is a prime number then: $p 
mid a \implies p \perp a$ where: $p 
mid a$ denotes that $p$ does not divide $a$ $p \perp a$ denotes that $p$ and $a$ are coprime. It follows directly that if $p$ and $q$ are primes, then: $p \divides q \implies p = q$ $p 
e q \implies p \perp q$

title: Prime to Own Power minus 1 over Prime minus 1 being Prime
snippet: Let $n \in \Z_{>1}$ be an integer greater than $1$. Then $\dfrac {n^n - 1} {n - 1}$ is a prime for $n$ equal to: $2, 3, 19, 31$

title: Prime whose Divisor Sum is Square is 3
snippet: There is exactly $1$ prime number whose divisor sum is a square number, and that is $3$: $\map {\sigma_1} 3 = 4$

title: Primes Expressible as x^2 + n y^2 for all n from 1 to 10
snippet: == Sequence == The sequence of prime numbers which can be expressed in the form $x^2 + n y^2$ for all values of $n$ from $1$ to $10$ begins: $1009, 1129, 1201, 1801, \ldots$ This sequence appears not to be documented on .

title: Primes not Sum of or Difference between Powers of 2 and 3
snippet: The sequence of prime numbers which cannot be expressed as either sum of or the difference between a power of $2$ and a power of $3$ begins: $53, 71, 103, 107, 109, 149, 151, \ldots$

title: Primes of Form n^2 + 1
snippet: == Sequence == The sequence of prime numbers of the form $n^2 + 1$ begins: $2, 5, 17, 37, 101, 197, 257, 401, 577, 677, 1297, 1601, 2917, 3137, 4357, 5477, \ldots$ These correspond to values of $n$ beginning: $1, 2, 4, 6, 10, 14, 16, 20, 24, \ldots$

title: Primes of form Power Less One
snippet: Let $m, n \in \N_{>0}$ be natural numbers. Let $m^n - 1$ be prime. Then $m = 2$ and $n$ is prime.

title: Primes of form Power of Two plus One
snippet: Let $n \in \N$ be a natural number. Let $2^n + 1$ be prime. Then $n = 2^k$ for some natural number $k$.

title: Primes of form Power plus One
snippet: Let $q, n \in \Z_{>0}$ such that $q > 1$. Then $q^n + 1$ is prime only if: $(1): \quad q$ is even and $(2): \quad n$ is of the form $2^m$ for some positive integer $m$.

title: Primitive Root is Generator of Reduced Residue System
snippet: Let $a$ be a primitive root of $n$. Then: $\set {a, a^2, a^3, \ldots, a^{\map \phi n} }$ where $\map \phi n$ is the Euler phi function of $n$, is the reduced residue system of $n$. Thus the first $\map \phi n$ powers of $a$ "generates" the reduced residue system of $n$. We say that $a$ is a generator of the reduced residue system of $n$.

title: Primitive of Arccosine Function
snippet: $\ds \int \arccos x \rd x = x \arccos x - \sqrt {1 - x^2} + C$

title: Primitive of Arccosine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \arccos a x \rd x = x \arccos a x - \dfrac 1 a \sqrt {1 - a^2 x^2} + C$

title: Primitive of Arccosine of x over a
snippet: $\ds \int \arccos \frac x a \rd x = x \arccos \frac x a - \sqrt {a^2 - x^2} + C$

title: Primitive of Arccosine of x over a over x
snippet: $\ds \int \dfrac 1 x \arccos \frac x a \rd x = \frac \pi 2 \ln \size x - \int \frac {\arcsin \frac x a \rd x} x + C$

title: Primitive of Arccosine of x over a over x squared
snippet: $\ds \int \frac 1 {x^2} \arccos \frac x a \rd x = -\frac 1 x \arccos \frac x a + \frac 1 a \map \ln {\frac {a + \sqrt {a^2 - x^2} } x} + C$

title: Primitive of Arccotangent Function
snippet: $\ds \int \arccot x \rd x = x \arccot x + \frac {\map \ln {x^2 + 1} } 2 + C$

title: Primitive of Arccotangent of x over a
snippet: $\ds \int \arccot \frac x a \rd x = x \arccot \frac x a + \frac a 2 \map \ln {x^2 + a^2} + C$

title: Primitive of Arccotangent of x over a over x
snippet: $\ds \int \dfrac 1 x \arccot \frac x a \rd x = \frac \pi 2 \ln \size x - \int \dfrac 1 x \arctan \frac x a \rd x$

title: Primitive of Arccotangent of x over a over x squared
snippet: $\ds \int \frac 1 {x^2} \arccot \frac x a \rd x = -\frac 1 x \arccot \frac x a + \frac 1 {2 a} \map \ln {\frac {x^2 + a^2} {x^2} } + C$

title: Primitive of Arcsine Function

title: Primitive of Arcsine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \arcsin a x \rd x = x \arcsin a x + \dfrac 1 a \sqrt {1 - a^2 x^2} + C$

title: Primitive of Arcsine of x over a
snippet: $\ds \int \arcsin \frac x a \rd x = x \arcsin \frac x a + \sqrt {a^2 - x^2} + C$

title: Primitive of Arcsine of x over a over x

title: Primitive of Arcsine of x over a over x squared
snippet: $\ds \int \dfrac 1 {x^2} \arcsin \frac x a \rd x = -\frac 1 x \arcsin \frac x a - \frac 1 a \map \ln {\frac {a + \sqrt {a^2 - x^2} } x} + C$

title: Primitive of Arctangent Function
snippet: $\ds \int \arctan x \rd x = x \arctan x - \frac {\map \ln {x^2 + 1} } 2 + C$

title: Primitive of Arctangent of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \arctan a x \rd x = x \arctan a x - \dfrac 1 {2 a} \map \ln {1 + a^2 x^2} + C$

title: Primitive of Arctangent of x over a
snippet: $\ds \int \arctan \frac x a \rd x = x \arctan \frac x a - \frac a 2 \map \ln {x^2 + a^2} + C$

title: Primitive of Arctangent of x over a over x
snippet: {{eqn | l = \int \frac 1 x \map \arctan {\frac x a} \rd x | r = \sum_{k \mathop = 0}^\infty \paren {-1}^k \frac {x^{2 k + 1} } {\paren {2 k + 1}^2 a^{2 k + 1} } }} {{eqn | r = \frac x a - \frac {x^3} {3^2 a^3} + \frac {x^5} {5^2 a^5} - \frac {x^7} {7^2 a^7} + \cdots + C }}

title: Primitive of Arctangent of x over a over x squared
snippet: $\ds \int \frac 1 {x^2} \arctan \frac x a \rd x = -\frac 1 x \arctan \frac x a - \frac 1 {2 a} \map \ln {\frac {x^2 + a^2} {x^2} } + C$

title: Primitive of Composite Function
snippet: Let $f$ and $g$ be a real functions which are integrable. Let the composite function $g \circ f$ also be integrable. Then: {{eqn | l = \int \map {\paren {g \circ f} } x \rd x | r = \int \map g u \frac {\d x} {\d u} \rd u | c = }} {{eqn | r = \int \frac {\map g u} {\map {f'} x} \rd u | c = }} where $u = \map f x$.

title: Primitive of Constant
snippet: Let $c$ be a constant. $\ds \int c \rd x = c x + C$ where $C$ is an arbitrary constant.

title: Primitive of Constant Multiple of Function
snippet: Let $f$ be a real function which is integrable. Let $c$ be a constant. Then: $\ds \int c \map f x \rd x = c \int \map f x \rd x$

title: Primitive of Cosecant of a x
Primitive of Cosecant of a x over x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\csc a x} x \rd x = \frac {-1} {a x} + \frac {a x} 6 + \frac {7 \paren {a x}^3} {1080} + \cdots + \frac {\paren {-1}^{n - 1} 2 \paren {2^{2 n - 1} - 1} B_{2 n} \paren {a x}^{2 n - 1} } {\paren {2 n - 1} \paren {2 n}!} + \cdots + C$ where $B_n$ is the $n$th Bernoulli number.

title: Primitive of Cosine Function
snippet: $\ds \int \cos x \rd x = \sin x + C$ where $C$ is an arbitrary constant.

title: Primitive of Cosine Integral Function
snippet: $\ds \int \map \Ci x \rd x = x \map \Ci x + \sin x + C$ where: $\Ci$ denotes the cosine integral function $x$ is a strictly positive real number.

title: Primitive of Cosine of a x + b
snippet: == Corollary to Primitive of Cosine Function == $\ds \int \map \cos {a x + b} \rd x = \frac {\map \sin {a x + b} } a + C$ where $a$ is a non-zero constant.

title: Primitive of Cosine of a x by Cosine of b x
snippet: $\ds \int \cos a x \cos b x \rd x = \frac {\map \sin {\paren {a - b} x} } {2 \paren {a - b} } + \frac {\map \sin {\paren {a + b} x} } {2 \paren {a + b} } + C$

title: Primitive of Cosine of a x over Power of p plus q of Sine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\cos a x \rd x} {\paren {p + q \sin a x}^n} = \frac {-1} {a q \paren {n - 1} \paren {p + q \sin a x}^{n - 1} } + C$

title: Primitive of Cosine of a x over Power of x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\cos a x} {x^n} \rd x = \frac {-\cos a x} {\paren {n - 1} x^{n - 1} } - \frac a {n - 1} \int \frac {\sin a x} {x^{n - 1} } \rd x$

title: Primitive of Cosine of a x over Sine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \dfrac {\cos a x} {\sin a x} \rd x = \dfrac 1 a \ln \size {\sin a x} + C$

title: Primitive of Cosine of a x over Sine of a x minus Cosine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\cos a x \rd x} {\sin a x - \cos a x} = \frac {-x} 2 + \frac 1 {2 a} \ln \size {\sin a x - \cos a x} + C$

title: Primitive of Cosine of a x over Sine of a x plus Cosine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\cos a x \rd x} {\sin a x + \cos a x} = \frac x 2 + \frac 1 {2 a} \ln \size {\sin a x + \cos a x} + C$

title: Primitive of Cosine of a x over Sine of a x plus phi
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\cos a x \rd x} {\map \sin {a x + \phi} } = \frac {\ln \size {\map \sin {a x + \phi} } } {a \cos \phi} + \tan \phi \int \frac {\sin a x \rd x} {\map \sin {a x + \phi} } + C$

title: Primitive of Cosine of a x over p plus q of Sine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\cos a x \rd x} {p + q \sin a x} = \frac 1 {a q} \ln \size {p + q \sin a x} + C$

snippet: {{eqn | l = \int \frac {\cos a x \rd x} x | r = \ln \size x + \sum_{k \mathop \ge 1} \frac {\paren {-1}^k \paren {a x}^{2 k} } {\paren {2 k} \paren {2 k}!} + C }} {{eqn | r = \ln \size x - \frac {\paren {a x}^2} {2 \times 2!} + \frac {\paren {a x}^4} {4 \times 4!} - \frac {\paren {a x}^6} {6 \times 6!} - \cdots + C }}

title: Primitive of Cosine of a x over x squared
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\cos a x \rd x} {x^2} = \frac {-\cos a x} x - a \int \frac {\sin a x \rd x} x$

title: Primitive of Cotangent Function
snippet: $\ds \int \cot x \rd x = \ln \size {\sin x} + C$ where $\sin x \ne 0$.

title: Primitive of Cotangent of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \cot a x \rd x = \frac {\ln \size {\sin a x} } a + C$

title: Primitive of Cotangent of a x over x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\cot a x} x \rd x = \frac {-1} a x - \frac {a x} 3 - \frac {\paren {a x}^3} {135} - \cdots - \frac {\paren {-1}^{n - 1} 2^{2 n} B_{2 n} \paren {a x}^{2 n - 1} } {\paren {2 n - 1} \paren {2 n}!} - \cdots + C$ where $B_n$ denotes the $n$th Bernoulli number.

title: Primitive of Cube of Cosecant of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \csc^3 a x \rd x = \frac {-\csc a x \cot a x} {2 a} + \frac 1 {2 a} \ln \size {\tan \dfrac {a x} 2} + C$

title: Primitive of Cube of Cosine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \cos^3 a x \rd x = \frac {\sin a x} a - \frac {\sin^3 a x} {3 a} + C$

title: Primitive of Cube of Cotangent of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \cot^3 a x \rd x = \frac {-\cot^2 a x} {2 a} - \frac 1 a \ln \size {\sin a x} + C$

title: Primitive of Cube of Hyperbolic Cosecant of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \csch^3 a x \rd x = \frac {-\csch a x \coth a x} {2 a} - \frac 1 {2 a} \ln \size {\tanh a x} + C$

title: Primitive of Cube of Hyperbolic Cotangent of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \coth^3 a x \rd x = \frac {\ln \size {\sinh a x} } a - \frac {\coth^2 a x} {2 a} + C$

title: Primitive of Cube of Hyperbolic Secant of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \sech^3 a x \rd x = \frac {\sech a x \tanh a x} {2 a} + \frac 1 {2 a} \map \arctan {\sinh a x} + C$

title: Primitive of Cube of Hyperbolic Tangent of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \tanh^3 a x \rd x = \frac {\ln \size {\cosh a x} } a - \frac {\tanh^2 a x} {2 a} + C$

title: Primitive of Cube of Secant Function
snippet: $\ds \int \sec^3 x \rd x = \frac 1 2 \paren {\sec x \tan x + \ln \size {\sec x + \tan x} } + C$

title: Primitive of Cube of Secant of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \sec^3 a x \rd x = \frac 1 {2 a} \paren {\sec a x \tan a x + \ln \size {\sec a x + \tan a x} } + C$

title: Primitive of Cube of Sine Function
snippet: $\ds \int \sin^3 x \rd x = \frac {\cos^3 x} 3 - \cos x + C$

title: Primitive of Cube of Sine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \sin^3 a x \rd x = -\frac {\cos a x} a + \frac {\cos^3 a x} {3 a} + C$

title: Primitive of Cube of Tangent of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \tan^3 a x \rd x = \frac {\tan^2 a x} {2 a} + \frac 1 a \ln \size {\cos a x} + C$

title: Primitive of Cube of Tangent of x
snippet: {{eqn | l = \int \tan^3 x \rd x | r = \frac {\tan^2 x} 2 + \ln \size {\cos x} + C | c = }} {{eqn | r = \frac {\tan^2 x} 2 - \ln \size {\sec x} + C | c = }}

title: Primitive of Exponential Function
snippet: $\ds \int e^x \rd x = e^x + C$ where $C$ is an arbitrary constant.

title: Primitive of Exponential Integral Function
snippet: Let $\Ei: \R_{>0} \to \R$ denote the exponential integral function: $\map \Ei x = \ds \int_{t \mathop = x}^{t \mathop \to +\infty} \frac {e^{-t} } t \rd t$ Then: $\ds \int \map \Ei x \rd x = x \map \Ei x - e^{-x} + C$

title: Primitive of Exponential of a x
snippet: $\ds \int e^{a x} \rd x = \frac {e^{a x} } a + C$ where $a$ is a non-zero constant.

title: Primitive of Exponential of a x by Cosine of b x
snippet: $\ds \int e^{a x} \cos b x \rd x = \frac {e^{a x} \paren {a \cos b x + b \sin b x} } {a^2 + b^2} + C$

Primitive of Exponential of a x by Logarithm of x
snippet: $\ds \int e^{a x} \ln x \rd x = \frac {e^{a x} \ln x} a - \frac 1 a \int \frac {e^{a x} } x \rd x + C$

title: Primitive of Exponential of a x by Power of Cosine of b x
snippet: $\ds \int e^{a x} \cos^n b x \rd x = \frac {e^{a x} \cos^{n - 1} b x} {a^2 + n^2 b^2} \paren {a \cos b x + n b \sin b x} + \frac {n \paren {n - 1} b^2} {a^2 + n^2 b^2} \int e^{a x} \cos^{n - 2} b x \rd x + C$

title: Primitive of Exponential of a x by Power of Sine of b x
snippet: $\ds \int e^{a x} \sin^n b x \rd x = \frac {e^{a x} \sin^{n - 1} b x} {a^2 + n^2 b^2} \paren {a \sin b x - n b \cos b x} + \frac {n \paren {n - 1} b^2} {a^2 + n^2 b^2} \int e^{a x} \sin^{n - 2} b x \rd x + C$

title: Primitive of Exponential of a x by Sine of b x
snippet: $\ds \int e^{a x} \sin b x \rd x = \frac {e^{a x} \paren {a \sin b x - b \cos b x} } {a^2 + b^2} + C$

title: Primitive of Exponential of a x by Tangent of b x
snippet: {{eqn | l = \int e^{a x} \tan b x \rd x | r = \frac 1 a e^{a x} \sum_{n \mathop = 0}^\infty \paren {\dfrac {-1}a }^k \dfrac {\d^n} {\d x^n} \paren {\map \tan {b x} } + C | c = }} {{eqn | r = \paren {\frac 1 a e^{a x} \map \tan {b x} - \frac 1 {a^2} e^{a x} \dfrac {\d} {\d x} \paren {\map \tan {b x} } + \frac 1 {a^3} e^{a x} \dfrac {\d^2} {\d x^2} \paren {\map \tan {b x} } - \frac 1 {a^4} e^{a x} \dfrac {\d^3} {\d x^3} \paren {\map \tan {b x} } + \cdots } + C | c = }}

title: Primitive of Exponential of a x over Power of x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {e^{a x} \rd x} {x^n} = \frac {-e^{a x} } {\paren {n - 1} x^{n - 1} } + \frac a {n - 1} \int \frac {e^{a x} \rd x} {x^{n - 1} } + C$ where $n \ne 1$.

title: Primitive of Exponential of a x over x
snippet: For $x > 0$: {{eqn | l = \int \frac {e^{a x} \rd x} x | r = \ln x + \sum_{k \mathop \ge 1} \frac {\paren {a x}^k} {k \times k!} + C | c = }} {{eqn | r = \ln x + \dfrac {a x} {1 \times 1!} + \dfrac {\paren {a x}^2} {2 \times 2!} + \dfrac {\paren {a x}^3} {3 \times 3!} + \cdots + C | c = }}

title: Primitive of Fourth Power of Cosine Function
snippet: $\ds \int \cos^4 x \rd x = \frac {3 x} 8 + \frac {\sin 2 x} 4 + \frac {\sin 4 x} {32} + C$

title: Primitive of Fourth Power of Cosine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \cos^4 a x \rd x = \frac {3 x} 8 + \frac {\sin 2 a x} {4 a} + \frac {\sin 4 a x} {32 a} + C$

title: Primitive of Fourth Power of Sine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \sin^4 a x \rd x = \frac {3 x} 8 - \frac {\sin 2 a x} {4 a} + \frac {\sin 4 a x} {32 a} + C$

title: Primitive of Function of Arccosecant
snippet: $\ds \int \map F {\arccsc \frac x a} \rd x = -a \int \map F u \size {\csc u} \cot u \rd u$ where $u = \arccsc \dfrac x a$.

title: Primitive of Function of Arccosine
snippet: $\ds \int \map F {\arccos \frac x a} \rd x = -a \int \map F u \sin u \rd u$ where $u = \arccos \dfrac x a$.

title: Primitive of Function of Arccotangent
snippet: $\ds \int \map F {\arccot \frac x a} \rd x = -a \int \map F u \csc^2 u \rd u$ where $u = \arccot \dfrac x a$.

title: Primitive of Function of Arcsecant
snippet: $\ds \int \map F {\arcsec \frac x a} \rd x = a \int \map F u \sec u \tan u \rd u$ where $u = \arcsec \dfrac x a$.

title: Primitive of Function of Arcsine
snippet: $\ds \int \map F {\arcsin \frac x a} \rd x = a \int \map F u \cos u \rd u$ where $u = \arcsin \dfrac x a$.

title: Primitive of Function of Arctangent
snippet: $\ds \int \map F {\arctan \frac x a} \rd x = a \int \map F u \sec^2 u \rd u$ where $u = \arctan \dfrac x a$.

title: Primitive of Function of Constant Multiple
snippet: Let $f$ be a real function which is integrable. Let $c$ be a constant. Then: $\ds \int \map f {c x} \rd x = \frac 1 c \int \map f u \d u$ where $u = c x$.

title: Primitive of Function of Exponential Function
snippet: $\ds \int \map F {e^{a x} } \rd x = \frac 1 a \int \frac {\map F u} u \rd u$ where $u = e^{a x}$.

title: Primitive of Function of Natural Logarithm
snippet: $\ds \int \map F {\ln x} \rd x = \int \map F u e^u \rd u$ where $u = \ln x$.

title: Primitive of Function of Nth Root of a x + b
snippet: $\ds \int \map F {\sqrt [n] {a x + b} } \rd x = \frac n a \int u^{n - 1} \map F u \rd u$ where $u = \sqrt [n] {a x + b}$.

title: Primitive of Function of Root of a squared minus x squared
snippet: $\ds \int \map F {\sqrt {a^2 - x^2} } \rd x = a \int \map F {a \cos u} \cos u \rd u$ where $x = a \sin u$.

title: Primitive of Function of Root of a squared plus x squared
snippet: $\ds \int \map F {\sqrt {a^2 + x^2} } \rd x = a \int \map F {a \sec u} \sec^2 u \rd u$ where $x = a \tan u$.

title: Primitive of Function of Root of a x + b
snippet: $\ds \int \map F {\sqrt {a x + b} } \rd x = \frac 2 a \int u \map F u \rd u$ where $u = \sqrt {a x + b}$.

title: Primitive of Function of Root of x squared minus a squared
snippet: $\ds \int \map F {\sqrt {x^2 - a^2} } \rd x = a \int \map F {a \tan u} \sec u \tan u \rd u$ where $x = a \sec u$.

title: Primitive of Function of a x + b
snippet: $\ds \int \map F {a x + b} \rd x = \frac 1 a \int \map F u \rd u$ where $u = a x + b$.

title: Primitive of Function on Connected Domain
snippet: Let $f: D \to \C$ be a continuous complex function, where $D$ is a connected domain. {{item|(2):|For any two contours $C_1, C_2$ in $D$ with identical start points $z_1 \in D$ and end points $z_2 \in D$, we have: $\ds \int_{C_1} \map f z \rd z \int_{C_2} \map f z \rd z$ }} If the conditions hold, we can choose any $z_0 \in D$ and define a primitive $F: D \to \C$ of $f$ by: $\ds \map F w = \int_{C_w} \map f z \rd z$ where $C_w$ is any contour in $D$ with start point $z_0$ and end point $w$.

title: Primitive of Function under its Derivative
snippet: Let $f$ be a real function which is integrable. Then: $\ds \int \frac {\map {f'} x} {\map f x} \rd x = \ln \size {\map f x} + C$ where $C$ is an arbitrary constant.

title: Primitive of Periodic Real Function
snippet: Let $f: \R \to \R$ be a real function. Let $F$ be a primitive of $f$ that is bounded on all of $\R$. Let $f$ be periodic with period $L$. Then $F$ is also periodic with period $L$.

title: Primitive of Pointwise Sum of Functions

title: Primitive of Power

title: Primitive of Power of Root of a x + b

title: Primitive of Power of Root of a x + b over x

title: Primitive of Power of Root of a x + b over x squared

title: Primitive of Power of Root of x squared minus a squared

title: Primitive of Power of Secant of a x

Primitive of Power of Tangent of a x

snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {\paren {p + q \sinh a x}^2} = \frac {-q \cosh a x} {a \paren {p^2 + q^2} \paren {p + q \sinh a x} } + \frac p {p^2 + q^2} \int \frac {\d x} {p + q \sinh a x} + C$
