snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {\tan a x} = \frac 1 a \ln \size {\sin a x} + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of a squared minus x squared
snippet: $\color {blue} {\dfrac 1 {a^2 - x^2} } \qquad \color {red} {\dfrac 1 a \tanh^{-1} \dfrac x a} \qquad \color {green} {\dfrac 1 a \coth^{-1} \dfrac x a}$ Let $a \in \R_{>0}$ be a strictly positive real constant.

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of a squared minus x squared squared
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {\paren {a^2 - x^2}^2} = \frac x {2 a^2 \paren {a^2 - x^2} } + \frac 1 {4 a^3} \map \ln {\frac {a + x} {a - x} } + C$ for $x^2 < a^2$.

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of a x + b
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {a x + b} = \frac 1 a \ln \size {a x + b} + C$ where $a \ne 0$ and $x \ne - \dfrac b a$.

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of a x + b by p x + q
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {\paren {a x + b} \paren {p x + q} } = \frac 1 {b p - a q} \ln \size {\frac {p x + q} {a x + b} } + C$ where $b p \ne a q$.

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of a x + b cubed
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {\paren {a x + b}^3} = \frac {-1} {2 a \paren {a x + b}^2} + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of a x + b squared
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {\paren {a x + b}^2} = -\frac 1 {a \paren {a x + b} } + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of a x + b squared by p x + q
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {\paren {a x + b}^2 \paren {p x + q} } = \frac 1 {b p - a q} \paren {\frac 1 {a x + b} + \frac p {b p - a q} \ln \size {\frac {p x + q} {a x + b} } } + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of a x squared + b by Root of c x squared + d
snippet: Let $a, b, c, d \in \R$ be real numbers such that $a d \ne b c$. Then: $\ds \int \dfrac {\d x} {\paren {a x^2 + b} \sqrt {c x^2 + d} } = \begin {cases} \dfrac 1 {\sqrt {b \paren {a d - b c} } } \arctan \dfrac {x \sqrt {a d - b c} } {\sqrt {b \paren {c x^2 + d} } } + C & : a d > b c \\ \dfrac 1 {2 \sqrt {b \paren {a d - b c} } } \ln \size {\dfrac {\sqrt {b \paren {c x^2 + d} } + x \sqrt {b c - a d} } {\sqrt {b \paren {c x^2 + d} } - x \sqrt {b c - a d} } } + C & : b c > a d \end {cases}$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of a x squared plus b x plus c
snippet: Let $a \in \R_{\ne 0}$. Then: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {a x^2 + b x + c} = \begin {cases} \dfrac 2 {\sqrt {4 a c - b^2} } \map \arctan {\dfrac {2 a x + b} {\sqrt {4 a c - b^2} } } + C & : b^2 - 4 a c 0 \\ \\ \dfrac {-2} {2 a x + b} + C & : b^2 = 4 a c \end {cases}$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of p by Exponential of a x plus q by Exponential of -a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {p e^{a x} + q e^{-a x} } = \begin{cases} \dfrac 1 {a \sqrt {p q} } \map \arctan {\sqrt {\dfrac p q} e^{a x} } & : \sqrt {p q} > 0 \\ \dfrac 1 {2 a \sqrt {-p q} } \ln \size {\dfrac {e^{a x} - \sqrt {-\dfrac q p} } {e^{a x} + \sqrt {-\dfrac q p} } } & : \sqrt {p q} < 0 \\ \end{cases}$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of p by Sine of a x plus q by 1 plus Cosine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\rd x} {p \sin a x + q \paren {1 + \cos a x} } = \frac 1 {a p} \ln \size {q + p \tan \frac {a x} 2} + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of p by Sine of a x plus q by Cosine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {p \sin a x + q \cos a x} = \frac 1 {a \sqrt {p^2 + q^2} } \ln \tan \size {\frac {a x + \arctan \dfrac q p} 2} + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of p by Sine of a x plus q by Cosine of a x minus Root of p squared plus q squared
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {p \sin a x + q \cos a x - \sqrt {p^2 + q^2} } = \frac {-1} {a \sqrt {p^2 + q^2} } \map \tan {\frac \pi 4 + \frac {a x + \arctan \frac q p} 2} + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of p by Sine of a x plus q by Cosine of a x plus Root of p squared plus q squared
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {p \sin a x + q \cos a x + \sqrt {p^2 + q^2} } = \frac {-1} {a \sqrt {p^2 + q^2} } \map \tan {\frac \pi 4 - \frac {a x + \arctan \frac q p} 2} + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of p by Sine of a x plus q by Cosine of a x plus or minus Root of p squared plus q squared
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {p \sin a x + q \cos a x \pm \sqrt {p^2 + q^2} } = \frac {-1} {a \sqrt {p^2 + q^2} } \map \tan {\frac \pi 4 \mp \frac {a x + \arctan \frac q p} 2} + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of p by Sine of a x plus q by Cosine of a x plus r
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {p \sin a x + q \cos a x + r} = \begin{cases} \ds \frac 2 {a \sqrt {r^2 - p^2 - q^2} } \map \arctan {\frac {p + \paren {r - q} \tan \dfrac {a x} 2} {\sqrt {r^2 - p^2 - q^2} } } + C & : p^2 + q^2 r^2 \end{cases}$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of p plus q by Cosine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\rd x} {p + q \cos a x} = \begin {cases} \dfrac 2 {a \sqrt {p^2 - q^2} } \map \arctan {\sqrt {\dfrac {p - q} {p + q} } \tan \dfrac {a x} 2} + C & : p^2 > q^2 \\ \\ \dfrac 1 {a \sqrt {q^2 - p^2} } \ln \size {\dfrac {\tan \dfrac {a x} 2 + \sqrt {\dfrac {q + p} {q - p} } } {\tan \dfrac {a x} 2 - \sqrt {\dfrac {q + p} {q - p} } } } + C & : p^2 for $p \ne q$.

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of p plus q by Cotangent of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {p + q \cot a x} = \frac {p x} {p^2 + q^2} - \frac q {a \paren {p^2 + q^2} } \ln \size {p \sin a x + q \cos a x} + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of p plus q by Exponential of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {p + q e^{a x} } = \frac x p - \frac 1 {a p} \ln \size {p + q e^{a x} } + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of p plus q by Hyperbolic Cosine of a x
snippet: For $p \ne q$: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {p + q \cosh a x} = \begin {cases} \dfrac 2 {a \sqrt {q^2 - p^2} } \arctan \dfrac {q e^{a x} + p} {\sqrt {q^2 - p^2} } + C & : p^2 q^2 \end {cases}$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of p plus q by Hyperbolic Cotangent of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {p + q \coth a x} = \frac {p x} {p^2 - q^2} - \frac q {a \paren {p^2 - q^2} } \ln \size {p \sinh a x + q \cosh a x} + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of p plus q by Hyperbolic Sine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {p + q \sinh a x} = \frac 1 {a \sqrt{p^2 + q^2} } \ln \size {\frac {q e^{a x} + p - \sqrt {p^2 + q^2} } {q e^{a x} + p + \sqrt {p^2 + q^2} } } + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of p plus q by Hyperbolic Tangent of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {p + q \tanh a x} = \frac {p x} {p^2 - q^2} - \frac q {a \paren {p^2 - q^2} } \ln \size {q \sinh a x + p \cosh a x} + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of p plus q by Sine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {p + q \sin a x} = \begin{cases} \ds \frac 2 {a \sqrt {p^2 - q^2} } \map \arctan {\frac {p \tan \dfrac {a x} 2 + q} {\sqrt {p^2 - q^2} } } + C & : q^2 - p^2 0 \\ \end{cases}$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of p plus q by Tangent of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {p + q \tan a x} = \frac {p x} {p^2 + q^2} + \frac q {a \paren {p^2 + q^2} } \ln \size {q \sin a x + p \cos a x} + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of p squared by square of Sine of a x minus q squared by square of Cosine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {p^2 \sin^2 a x - q^2 \cos^2 a x} = \frac 1 {2 a p q} \ln \size {\frac {p \tan a x - q} {p \tan a x + q} } + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of p squared by square of Sine of a x plus q squared by square of Cosine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {p^2 \sin^2 a x + q^2 \cos^2 a x} = \frac 1 {a p q} \map \arctan {\frac {p \tan a x} q} + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of p squared minus Square of q by Hyperbolic Cosine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {p^2 - q^2 \cosh^2 a x} = \begin {cases} \dfrac 1 {2 a p \sqrt {p^2 - q^2} } \ln \size {\dfrac {p \tanh a x + \sqrt {p^2 - q^2} } {p \tanh a x - \sqrt {p^2 - q^2} } } + C & : p^2 > q^2 \\ \dfrac 1 {a p \sqrt {q^2 - p^2} } \arctan \dfrac {p \tanh a x} {\sqrt {q^2 - p^2} } + C & : p^2 < q^2 \\ \end {cases}$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of p squared minus Square of q by Hyperbolic Sine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {p^2 - q^2 \sinh^2 a x} = \frac 1 {2 a p \sqrt {p^2 + q^2} } \ln \size {\frac {p + \sqrt {p^2 + q^2} \tanh a x} {p - \sqrt {p^2 + q^2} \tanh a x} } + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of p squared minus square of q by Cosine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\rd x} {p^2 - q^2 \cos^2 a x} = \begin {cases} \dfrac 1 {a p \sqrt {p^2 - q^2} } \arctan \dfrac {p \tan a x} {\sqrt {p^2 - q^2} } & : p^2 > q^2 \\ \dfrac 1 {2 a p \sqrt {q^2 - p^2} } \ln \size {\dfrac {p \tan a x - \sqrt {q^2 - p^2} } {p \tan a x + \sqrt {q^2 - p^2} } } & : p^2 < q^2 \end {cases}$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of p squared minus square of q by Sine of a x
snippet: $\quad \ds \int \frac {\d x} {p^2 - q^2 \sin^2 a x} = \begin {cases} \dfrac 1 {a p \sqrt {p^2 - q^2} } \arctan \dfrac {\sqrt {p^2 - q^2} \tan a x} p & : p^2 > q^2 \\ \dfrac 1 {2 a p \sqrt {q^2 - p^2} } \ln \size {\dfrac {\sqrt {q^2 - p^2} \tan a x + p} {\sqrt {q^2 - p^2} \tan a x - p} } & : p^2 < q^2 \end {cases}$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of p squared plus Square of q by Hyperbolic Cosine of a x
Primitive of Reciprocal of p squared plus Square of q by Hyperbolic Sine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {p^2 + q^2 \sinh^2 a x} = \begin {cases} \dfrac 1 {a p \sqrt{q^2 - p^2} } \arctan \dfrac {\sqrt {q^2 - p^2} \tanh a x} p + C & : p^2 q^2 \\ \end {cases}$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of p squared plus square of q by Cosine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {p^2 + q^2 \cos^2 a x} = \frac 1 {a p \sqrt{p^2 + q^2} } \arctan \frac {p \tan a x} {\sqrt {p^2 + q^2} } + C$ where $C$ is an arbitrary constant.

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of p squared plus square of q by Sine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {p^2 + q^2 \sin^2 a x} = \frac 1 {a p \sqrt {p^2 + q^2} } \arctan \frac {\sqrt {p^2 + q^2} \tan a x} p + C$ where $C$ is an arbitrary constant.

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of p x + q by Root of a x + b
snippet: Let $a, b, p, q \in \R$ such that $a p \ne b q$ and such that $p \ne 0$. Then: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {\paren {p x + q} \sqrt {a x + b} } = \begin {cases} \dfrac 1 {\sqrt {p \paren {b p - a q} } } \ln \size {\dfrac {\sqrt {p \paren {a x + b} } - \sqrt {b p - a q} } {\sqrt {p \paren {a x + b} } + \sqrt {b p - a q} } } + C & : p \paren {b p - a q} > 0 \\ \\ \dfrac 2 {\sqrt {p \paren {a q - b p} } } \arctan \sqrt {\dfrac {p \paren {a x + b} } {a q - b p} } + C & : p \paren {b p - a q}

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of p x + q by Root of a x + b by Root of p x + q
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {\paren {p x + q} \sqrt {\paren {a x + b} \paren {p x + q} } } = \frac {2 \sqrt {a x + b} } {\paren {a q - b p} \sqrt {p x + q} } + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of q plus p by Cosecant of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {q + p \csc a x} = \frac x q - \frac p q \int \frac {\d x} {p + q \sin a x} + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of q plus p by Hyperbolic Cosecant of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {q + p \csch a x} = \frac x q - \frac p q \int \frac {\d x} {p + q \sinh a x} + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of q plus p by Hyperbolic Secant of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {q + p \sech a x} = \frac x q - \frac p q \int \frac {\d x} {p + q \cosh a x} + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of q plus p by Secant of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {q + p \sec a x} = \frac x q - \frac p q \int \frac {\d x} {p + q \cos a x} + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of square of a x squared plus b x plus c
snippet: Let $a \in \R_{\ne 0}$. Then: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {\paren {a x^2 + b x + c}^2} = \frac {2 a x + b} {\paren {4 a c - b^2} \paren {a x^2 + b x + c} } + \frac {2 a} {4 a c - b^2} \int \frac {\d x} {a x^2 + b x + c}$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of square of p plus q by Cosine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {\paren {p + q \cos a x}^2} = \frac {q \sin a x} {a \paren {q^2 - p^2} \paren {p + q \cos a x} } - \frac p {q^2 - p^2} \int \frac {\d x} {p + q \cos a x}$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of square of p plus q by Sine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {\paren {p + q \sin a x}^2} = \frac {q \cos a x} {a \paren {p^2 - q^2} \paren {p + q \sin a x} } + \frac p {p^2 - q^2} \int \frac {\d x} {p + q \sin a x}$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of x by Cube of Root of a x squared plus b x plus c
snippet: Let $a \in \R_{\ne 0}$. Then: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {x \paren {\sqrt {a x^2 + b x + c} }^3} = \frac 1 {c \sqrt {a x^2 + b x + c} } + \frac 1 c \int \frac {\d x} {x \sqrt {a x^2 + b x + c} } - \frac b {2 c} \int \frac {\d x} {\paren {\sqrt {a x^2 + b x + c} }^3}$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of x by Half Integer Power of a x squared plus b x plus c
snippet: Let $a \in \R_{\ne 0}$. Then: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {x \paren {a x^2 + b x + c}^{n + \frac 1 2} } = \frac 1 {\paren {2 n - 1} c \paren {a x^2 + b x + c}^{n - \frac 1 2} } + \frac 1 c \int \frac {\d x} {x \paren {a x^2 + b x + c}^{n - \frac 1 2} } - \frac b {2 c} \int \frac {\d x} {\paren {a x^2 + b x + c}^{n + \frac 1 2} }$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of x by Logarithm of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {x \ln a x} = \ln \size {\ln a x} + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of x by Logarithm of x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {x \ln x} = \ln \size {\ln x} + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of x by Power of Root of a x + b
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {x \paren {\sqrt {a x + b} }^m} = \frac 2 {\paren {m - 2} b \paren {\sqrt {a x + b} }^{m - 2} } + \frac 1 b \int \frac {\d x} {x \paren {\sqrt {a x + b} }^{m - 2} }$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of x by Power of a squared minus x squared
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {x \paren {a^2 - x^2}^n} = \frac 1 {2 \paren {n - 1} a^2 \paren {a^2 - x^2}^{n - 1} } + \frac 1 {a^2} \int \frac {\d x} {x \paren {a^2 - x^2}^{n - 1} }$ for $x^2 < a^2$.

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of x by Power of x minus Power of a
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {x \paren {x^n - a^n} } = \frac 1 {n a^n} \ln \size {\frac {x^n - a^n} {x^n} } + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of x by Power of x plus Power of a
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {x \paren {x^n + a^n} } = \frac 1 {n a^n} \ln \size {\frac {x^n} {x^n + a^n} } + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of x by Power of x squared minus a squared
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {x \paren {x^2 - a^2}^n} = \frac {-1} {2 \paren {n - 1} a^2 \paren {x^2 - a^2}^{n - 1} } - \frac 1 {a^2} \int \frac {\d x} {x \paren {x^2 - a^2}^{n - 1} }$ for $x^2 > a^2$.

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of x by Power of x squared plus a squared
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {x \paren {x^2 + a^2}^n} = \frac 1 {2 \paren {n - 1} a^2 \paren {x^2 + a^2}^{n - 1} } + \frac 1 {a^2} \int \frac {\d x} {x \paren {x^2 + a^2}^{n - 1} }$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of x by Root of 2 a x minus x squared
snippet: $\ds \int \dfrac 1 {x \sqrt {2 a x - x^2} } \rd x = -\dfrac 1 a \sqrt {\dfrac {2 a - x} x} + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of x by Root of Power of x minus Power of a
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {x \sqrt {x^n - a^n} } = \frac 2 {n \sqrt {a^n} } \arccos \sqrt {\frac {a^n} {x^n} } + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of x by Root of Power of x plus Power of a
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\d x} {x \sqrt {x^n + a^n} } = \frac 1 {n \sqrt {a^n} } \ln \size {\frac {\sqrt {x^n + a^n} - \sqrt {a^n} } {\sqrt {x^n + a^n} + \sqrt {a^n} } } + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of x by a x + b
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {\rd x} {x \paren {a x + b} } = \frac 1 b \ln \size {\frac x {a x + b} } + C$

snippet: $\ds\int \frac {\d x} {x \paren {a x + b}^3} = \frac {a^2 x^2} {2 b^3 \paren {a x + b}^2} - \frac {2 a x} {b^3 \paren {a x + b} } + \frac 1 {b^3} \ln \size {\frac x {a x + b} } + C$

title: Primitive of Reciprocal of x by a x + b squared

snippet: $\ds \int x e^{a x} \cos b x \rd x = \frac {x e^{a x} \paren {a \cos b x + b \sin b x} } {a^2 + b^2} - \frac {e^{a x} \paren {\paren {a^2 - b^2} \cos b x - 2 a b \sin b x} } {\paren {a^2 + b^2}^2} + C$

title: Primitive of x by Exponential of a x by Sine of b x
snippet: $\ds \int x e^{a x} \sin b x \rd x = \frac {x e^{a x} \paren {a \sin b x - b \cos b x} } {a^2 + b^2} - \frac {e^{a x} \paren {\paren {a^2 - b^2} \sin b x - 2 a b \cos b x} } {\paren {a^2 + b^2}^2} + C$

title: Primitive of x by Half Integer Power of a x squared plus b x plus c
snippet: Let $a \in \R_{\ne 0}$. Then: $\ds \int x \paren {a x^2 + b x + c}^{n + \frac 1 2} \rd x = \frac {\paren {a x^2 + b x + c}^{n + \frac 3 2} } {a \paren {2 n + 3} } - \frac b {2 a} \int \paren {a x^2 + b x + c}^{n + \frac 1 2} \rd x$

title: Primitive of x by Hyperbolic Cosecant of a x
snippet: {{eqn | l = \int x \csch a x \rd x | r = \frac 1 {a^2} \sum_{n \mathop = 0}^\infty \frac {2 \paren {1 - 2^{2 n - 1} } B_{2 n} \paren {a x}^{2 n + 1} } {\paren {2 n + 1}!} + C }} {{eqn | r = \dfrac 1 {a^2} \paren {a x - \dfrac {\paren {a x}^3} {18} + \dfrac {7 \paren {a x}^5} {1800} - \cdots} + C }} where $B_{2 n}$ denotes the $2 n$th Bernoulli number.

title: Primitive of x by Hyperbolic Cosine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int x \cosh a x \rd x = \frac {x \sinh a x} a - \frac {\cosh a x} {a^2} + C$ where $C$ is an arbitrary constant.

title: Primitive of x by Hyperbolic Cotangent of a x
snippet: $\ds \int x \coth a x \rd x = \frac 1 {a^2} \paren {a x + \frac {\paren {a x}^3} 9 - \frac {\paren {a x}^5} {225} + \cdots + \frac {2^{2 n} B_{2 n} \paren {a x}^{2 n + 1} } {\paren {2 n + 1}!} + \cdots} + C$ where $B_{2 n}$ denotes the $2 n$th Bernoulli number.

title: Primitive of x by Hyperbolic Secant of a x
snippet: {{eqn | l = \int x \sech a x \rd x | r = \frac 1 {a^2} \sum_{n \mathop = 0}^\infty \frac {E_{2 n} \paren {a x}^{2 n + 2} } {\paren {2 n + 2} \paren {2 n}!} + C }} {{eqn | r = \frac 1 {a^2} \paren {\frac {\paren {a x}^2} 2 - \frac {\paren {a x}^4} 8 + \frac {5 \paren {a x}^6} {144} - \cdots } + C }} where $E_{2 n}$ denotes the $2 n$th Euler number.

title: Primitive of x by Hyperbolic Sine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int x \sinh a x \rd x = \frac {x \cosh a x} a - \frac {\sinh a x} {a^2} + C$

title: Primitive of x by Hyperbolic Tangent of a x
snippet: $\ds \int x \tanh a x \rd x = \frac 1 {a^2} \paren {\frac {\paren {a x}^3} 3 - \frac {\paren {a x}^5} {15} + \frac {2 \paren {a x}^7} {105} + \cdots + \frac { 2^{2 n} \paren {2^{2 n} - 1} B_{2 n} \paren {a x}^{2 n + 1} } {\paren {2 n + 1}!} + \cdots} + C$ where $B_{2 n}$ denotes the $2 n$th Bernoulli number.

title: Primitive of x by Inverse Hyperbolic Cosecant of x over a
snippet: $\ds \int x \arcsch \frac x a \rd x = \begin {cases} \dfrac {x^2} 2 \arcsch \dfrac x a + \dfrac {a \sqrt {x^2 + a^2} } 2 + C & : x > 0 \\ \\ \dfrac {x^2} 2 \arcsch \dfrac x a - \dfrac {a \sqrt {x^2 + a^2} } 2 + C & : x

title: Primitive of x by Inverse Hyperbolic Cosine of x over a
snippet: $\ds \int x \arcosh \frac x a \rd x = \paren {\dfrac {x^2} 2 - \dfrac {a^2} 4} \arcosh \dfrac x a - \dfrac {x \sqrt {x^2 - a^2} } 4 + C$ where $\arcosh$ denotes the real area hyperbolic cosine.

title: Primitive of x by Inverse Hyperbolic Cotangent of x over a
snippet: $\ds \int x \arcoth \frac x a \rd x = \frac {a x} 2 + \frac {x^2 - a^2} 2 \arcoth \frac x a + C$

title: Primitive of x by Inverse Hyperbolic Secant of x over a
snippet: $\ds \int x \arsech \frac x a \rd x = \dfrac {x^2} 2 \arsech \dfrac x a - \dfrac {a \sqrt {a^2 - x^2} } 2 + C$ where $\arsech$ denotes the real area hyperbolic secant.

title: Primitive of x by Inverse Hyperbolic Sine of x over a
snippet: $\ds \int x \arsinh \frac x a \rd x = \paren {\frac {x^2} 2 + \frac {a^2} 4} \arsinh \frac x a - \frac {x \sqrt {x^2 + a^2} } 4 + C$

title: Primitive of x by Inverse Hyperbolic Tangent of x over a
snippet: $\ds \int x \artanh \frac x a \rd x = \frac {a x} 2 + \frac {x^2 - a^2} 2 \artanh \frac x a + C$

title: Primitive of x by Logarithm of x
snippet: $\ds \int x \ln x \rd x = \frac {x^2} 2 \paren {\ln x - \frac 1 2} + C$

title: Primitive of x by Logarithm of x squared plus a squared
snippet: $\ds \int x \map \ln {x^2 + a^2} \rd x = \frac {\paren {x^2 + a^2} \map \ln {x^2 + a^2} - x^2} 2 + C$

title: Primitive of x by Power of Root of a x + b
snippet: $\ds \int x \paren {\sqrt {a x + b} }^m \rd x = \frac {2 \paren {\sqrt {a x + b} }^{m + 4} } {a^2 \paren {m + 4} } - \frac {2 b \paren {\sqrt {a x + b} }^{m + 2} } {a^2 \paren {m + 2} } + C$

title: Primitive of x by Power of Root of x squared minus a squared
snippet: $\ds \int x \paren {\sqrt {x^2 - a^2} }^n \rd x = \dfrac {\paren {\sqrt {x^2 - a^2} }^{n + 2} } {n + 2} + C$ for $n \ne -2$.

title: Primitive of x by Power of a x + b
snippet: $\ds \int x \paren {a x + b}^n \rd x = \frac {\paren {a x + b}^{n + 2} } {\paren {n + 2} a^2} - \frac {b \paren {a x + b}^{n + 1} } {\paren {n + 1} a^2} + C$ where $n \ne - 1$ and $n \ne - 2$.

title: Primitive of x by Root of 2 a x minus x squared
snippet: $\ds \int x \sqrt {2 a x - x^2} \rd x = \frac {\paren {x + a} \paren {2 x - 3 a} \sqrt {2 a x - x^2} } 6 + \frac {a^3} 2 \arcsin \dfrac {x - a} a + C$

title: Primitive of x by Root of a squared minus x squared
snippet: $\ds \int x \sqrt {a^2 - x^2} \rd x = \frac {-\paren {\sqrt {a^2 - x^2} }^3} 3 + C$

title: Primitive of x by Root of a squared minus x squared cubed
snippet: $\ds \int x \paren {\sqrt {a^2 - x^2} }^3 \rd x = \frac {-\paren {\sqrt {a^2 - x^2} }^5} 5 + C$

title: Primitive of x by Root of a x + b
snippet: $\ds \int x \sqrt {a x + b} \rd x = \frac {2 \paren {3 a x - 2 b} } {15 a^2} \sqrt {\paren {a x + b}^3}$

title: Primitive of x by Root of a x squared plus b x plus c
snippet: Let $a \in \R_{\ne 0}$. Then: $\ds \int x \sqrt {a x^2 + b x + c} \rd x = \frac {\paren {\sqrt {a x^2 + b x + c} }^3} {3 a} - \frac {b \paren {2 a x + b} \sqrt {a x^2 + b x + c} } {8 a^2} - \frac {b \paren {4 a c - b^2} } {16 a^2} \int \frac {\d x} {\sqrt {a x^2 + b x + c} }$

title: Primitive of x by Root of x squared minus a squared
snippet: $\ds \int x \sqrt {x^2 - a^2} \rd x = \frac {\paren {\sqrt {x^2 - a^2} }^3} 3 + C$ for $\size x \ge a$.

title: Primitive of x by Root of x squared minus a squared cubed
snippet: $\ds \int x \paren {\sqrt {x^2 - a^2} }^3 \rd x = \frac {\paren {\sqrt {x^2 - a^2} }^5} 5 + C$ for $\size x \ge a$.

title: Primitive of x by Root of x squared plus a squared
snippet: $\ds \int x \sqrt {x^2 + a^2} \rd x = \frac {\paren {\sqrt {x^2 + a^2} }^3} 3 + C$

title: Primitive of x by Root of x squared plus a squared cubed
snippet: $\ds \int x \paren {\sqrt {x^2 + a^2} }^3 \rd x = \frac {\paren {\sqrt {x^2 + a^2} }^5} 5 + C$

title: Primitive of x by Secant of a x
snippet: {{eqn | l = \int x \sec a x \rd x | r = \frac 1 {a^2} \paren {\frac {\paren {a x}^2} 2 - \frac {\paren {a x}^4} 8 + \frac {5 \paren {a x}^6} {144} - \cdots + \frac {\paren {-1}^n E_{2 n} \paren {a x}^{2 n + 2} } {\paren {2 n + 2} \paren {2 n}!} + \cdots} + C | c = }} {{eqn | r = \frac 1 {a^2} \sum_{n \mathop = 0}^\infty \frac {\paren {-1}^n E_{2 n} \paren {a x}^{2 n + 2} } {\paren {2 n + 2} \paren {2 n}!} + C | c = }} where $E_{2 n}$ is the $2 n$th Euler number.

title: Primitive of x by Sine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int x \sin a x \rd x = \frac {\sin a x} {a^2} - \frac {x \cos a x} a + C$ where $C$ is an arbitrary constant.

title: Primitive of x by Square of Cosecant of a x
snippet: $\ds \int x \csc^2 a x \rd x = \frac {-x \cot a x} a + \frac 1 {a^2} \ln \size {\sin a x} + C$

title: Primitive of x by Square of Cosine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int x \cos^2 a x \rd x = \frac {x^2} 4 + \frac {x \sin 2 a x} {4 a} + \frac {\cos 2 a x} {8 a^2} + C$

title: Primitive of x by Square of Cotangent of a x
snippet: $\ds \int x \cot^2 a x \rd x = \frac {-x \cot a x} a + \frac 1 {a^2} \ln \size {\sin a x} - \frac {x^2} 2 + C$

title: Primitive of x by Square of Hyperbolic Cosecant of a x
snippet: $\ds \int x \csch^2 a x \rd x = \frac {-x \coth a x} a + \frac 1 {a^2} \ln \size {\sinh a x} + C$

title: Primitive of x by Square of Hyperbolic Cosine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int x \cosh^2 a x \rd x = \frac {x \sinh 2 a x} {4 a} - \frac {\cosh 2 a x} {8 a^2} + \frac {x^2} 4 + C$

title: Primitive of x by Square of Hyperbolic Cotangent of a x
snippet: $\ds \int x \coth^2 a x \rd x = \frac {x^2} 2 - \frac {x \coth a x} a + \frac 1 {a^2} \ln \size {\sinh a x} + C$

title: Primitive of x by Square of Hyperbolic Secant of a x
snippet: $\ds \int x \sech^2 a x \rd x = \frac {x \tanh a x} a - \frac 1 {a^2} \ln \size {\cosh a x} + C$

title: Primitive of x by Square of Hyperbolic Sine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int x \sinh^2 a x \rd x = \dfrac {x \sinh 2 a x} {4 a} - \frac {\cosh 2 a x} {8 a^2} - \frac {x^2} 4 + C$

title: Primitive of x by Square of Hyperbolic Tangent of a x
snippet: $\ds \int x \tanh^2 a x \rd x = \frac {x^2} 2 - \frac {x \tanh a x} a + \frac 1 {a^2} \ln \size {\cosh a x} + C$

title: Primitive of x by Square of Logarithm of x
snippet: $\ds \int x \ln^2 x \rd x = \dfrac {x^2 \ln^2 x} 2 - \dfrac {x^2 \ln x} 2 + \dfrac {x^2} 4 + C$

title: Primitive of x by Square of Secant of a x
snippet: $\ds \int x \sec^2 a x \rd x = \frac {x \tan a x} a + \frac 1 {a^2} \ln \size {\cos a x} + C$

title: Primitive of x by Square of Sine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int x \sin^2 a x \rd x = \frac {x^2} 4 - \frac {x \sin 2 a x} {4 a} - \frac {\cos 2 a x} {8 a^2} + C$

title: Primitive of x by Square of Tangent of a x
snippet: $\ds \int x \tan^2 a x \rd x = \frac {x \tan a x} a + \frac 1 {a^2} \ln \size {\cos a x} - \frac {x^2} 2 + C$

title: Primitive of x by Tangent of a x
snippet: $\ds \int x \tan a x \rd x = \frac 1 {a^2} \paren {\frac {\paren {a x} ^ 3} 3 + \frac {\paren {a x}^5} {15} + \frac {2 \paren {a x}^7} {105} + \cdots + \frac {\paren {-1}^{n - 1} 2^{2 n} \paren {2^{2 n} - 1} B_{2 n} \paren {a x}^{2 n + 1} } {\paren {2 n + 1}!} + \cdots} + C$ where $B_{2 n}$ denotes the $2 n$th Bernoulli number.

title: Primitive of x cubed by Cosine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int x^3 \map \cos {a x} \rd x = \paren {\frac {3 x^2} {a^2} - \frac 6 {a^4} } \cos a x + \paren {\frac {x^3} a - \frac {6 x} {a^3} } \sin a x + C$ where $C$ is an arbitrary constant.

title: Primitive of x cubed by Root of a squared minus x squared
snippet: $\ds \int x^3 \sqrt {a^2 - x^2} \rd x = \frac {\paren {\sqrt {a^2 - x^2} }^5} 5 - \frac {a^2 \paren {\sqrt {a^2 - x^2} }^3} 3 + C$

title: Primitive of x cubed by Root of a squared minus x squared cubed
snippet: $\ds \int x^3 \paren {\sqrt {a^2 - x^2} }^3 \rd x = \frac {\paren {\sqrt {a^2 - x^2} }^7} 7 - \frac {a^2 \paren {\sqrt {a^2 - x^2} }^5} 5 + C$

title: Primitive of x cubed by Root of x squared minus a squared
snippet: $\ds \int x^3 \sqrt {x^2 - a^2} \rd x = \frac {\paren {\sqrt {x^2 - a^2} }^5} 5 + \frac {a^2 \paren {\sqrt {x^2 - a^2} }^3} 3 + C$ for $\size x \ge a$.

title: Primitive of x cubed by Root of x squared minus a squared cubed
snippet: $\ds \int x^3 \paren {\sqrt {x^2 - a^2} }^3 \rd x = \frac {\paren {\sqrt {x^2 - a^2} }^7} 7 + \frac {a^2 \paren {\sqrt {x^2 - a^2} }^5} 5 + C$ for $\size x \ge a$.

title: Primitive of x cubed by Root of x squared plus a squared
snippet: $\ds \int x^3 \sqrt {x^2 + a^2} \rd x = \frac {\paren {\sqrt {x^2 + a^2} }^5} 5 - \frac {a^2 \paren {\sqrt {x^2 + a^2} }^3} 3 + C$

title: Primitive of x cubed by Root of x squared plus a squared cubed
snippet: $\ds \int x^3 \paren {\sqrt {x^2 + a^2} }^3 \rd x = \frac {\paren {\sqrt {x^2 + a^2} }^7} 7 - \frac {a^2 \paren {\sqrt {x^2 + a^2} }^5} 5 + C$

title: Primitive of x cubed by Sine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int x^3 \sin a x \rd x = \paren {\frac {3 x^2} {a^2} - \frac 6 {a^4} } \sin a x + \paren {\frac {6 x} {a^3} - \frac {x^3} a} \cos a x + C$ where $C$ is an arbitrary constant.

title: Primitive of x cubed over Root of a squared minus x squared
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {x^3 \rd x} {\sqrt {a^2 - x^2} } = \frac {\paren {\sqrt {a^2 - x^2} }^3} 3 - a^2 \sqrt {a^2 - x^2} + C$

title: Primitive of x cubed over Root of a squared minus x squared cubed
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {x^3 \rd x} {\paren {\sqrt {a^2 - x^2} }^3} = \sqrt {a^2 - x^2} + \frac {a^2} {\sqrt {a^2 - x^2} } + C$

title: Primitive of x cubed over Root of x squared minus a squared
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {x^3 \rd x} {\sqrt {x^2 - a^2} } = \frac {\paren {\sqrt {x^2 - a^2} }^3} 3 + a^2 \sqrt {x^2 - a^2} + C$ for $\size x > a$.

title: Primitive of x cubed over Root of x squared minus a squared cubed
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {x^3 \rd x} {\paren {\sqrt {x^2 - a^2} }^3} = \sqrt {x^2 - a^2} - \frac {a^2} {\sqrt {x^2 - a^2} } + C$ for $\size x > a$.

title: Primitive of x cubed over Root of x squared plus a squared
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {x^3 \rd x} {\sqrt {x^2 + a^2} } = \frac {\paren {\sqrt {x^2 + a^2} }^3} 3 - a^2 \sqrt {x^2 + a^2} + C$

title: Primitive of x cubed over Root of x squared plus a squared cubed
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {x^3 \rd x} {\paren {\sqrt {x^2 + a^2} }^3} = \sqrt {x^2 + a^2} + \frac {a^2} {\sqrt {x^2 + a^2} } + C$

title: Primitive of x cubed over a squared minus x squared
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {x^3 \rd x} {a^2 - x^2} = -\frac {x^2} 2 - \frac {a^2} 2 \map \ln {a^2 - x^2} + C$ for $x^2 < a^2$.

title: Primitive of x cubed over a squared minus x squared squared
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {x^3 \rd x} {\paren {a^2 - x^2}^2} = \frac {a^2} {2 \paren {a^2 - x^2} } + \frac 1 2 \map \ln {a^2 - x^2} + C$ for $x^2 < a^2$.

title: Primitive of x cubed over a x + b
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {x^3 \rd x} {a x + b} = \frac {\paren {a x + b}^3} {3 a^4} - \frac {3 b \paren {a x + b}^2} {2 a^4} - \frac {3 b^2 \paren {a x + b} } {a^4} + \frac {b^3} {a^4} \ln \size {a x + b} + C$

title: Primitive of x cubed over a x + b cubed
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {x^3 \rd x} {\paren {a x + b}^3} = \frac x {a^3} - \frac {3 b^2} {a^4 \paren {a x + b} } + \frac {b^3} {2 a^4 \paren {a x + b}^2} - \frac {3 b} {a^4} \ln \size {a x + b} + C$

title: Primitive of x cubed over a x + b squared
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {x^3 \rd x} {\paren {a x + b}^2} = \frac {\paren {a x + b}^2} {2 a^4} - \frac {3 b \paren {a x + b} } {a^4} + \frac {b^3} {a^4 \paren {a x + b} } + \frac {3 b^2} {a^4} \ln \size {a x + b} + C$

title: Primitive of x cubed over x fourth minus a fourth
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {x^3 \rd x} {x^4 - a^4} = \frac {\ln \size {x^4 - a^4} } 4 + C$

title: Primitive of x cubed over x fourth plus a fourth
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {x^3 \rd x} {x^4 + a^4} = \frac {\map \ln {x^4 + a^4} } 4 + C$

title: Primitive of x cubed over x squared minus a squared
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {x^3 \rd x} {x^2 - a^2} = \frac {x^2} 2 + \frac {a^2} 2 \map \ln {x^2 - a^2} + C$ for $x^2 > a^2$.

title: Primitive of x cubed over x squared minus a squared squared
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {x^3 \rd x} {\paren {x^2 - a^2}^2} = \frac {-a^2} {2 \paren {x^2 - a^2} } + \frac 1 2 \map \ln {x^2 - a^2} + C$ for $x^2 > a^2$.

title: Primitive of x cubed over x squared plus a squared
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {x^3 \rd x} {x^2 + a^2} = \frac {x^2} 2 - \frac {a^2} 2 \map \ln {x^2 + a^2} + C$

title: Primitive of x cubed over x squared plus a squared squared
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {x^3 \rd x} {\paren {x^2 + a^2}^2} = \frac {a^2} {2 \paren {x^2 + a^2} } + \frac 1 2 \map \ln {x^2 + a^2} + C$

title: Primitive of x fourth by Cosine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int x^4 \cos a x \rd x = \frac {\sin a x} a x^4 + \frac {4 \cos a x} {a^2} x^3 - \frac {12 \sin a x} {a^3} x^2 - \frac {24 \cos a x} {a^4} x + \frac {24 \sin a x} {a^5} + C$ where $C$ is an arbitrary constant.

title: Primitive of x over 1 minus Cosine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {x \rd x} {1 - \cos a x} = \frac {-x} a \cot \frac {a x} 2 + \frac 2 {a^2} \ln \size {\sin \frac {a x} 2} + C$

title: Primitive of x over 1 minus Sine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {x \rd x} {1 - \sin a x} = \frac x a \map \tan {\frac \pi 4 + \frac {a x} 2} + \frac 2 {a^2} \ln \size {\map \sin {\frac \pi 4 - \frac {a x} 2} } + C$

title: Primitive of x over 1 plus Cosine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {x \rd x} {1 + \cos a x} = \frac x a \tan \frac {a x} 2 + \frac 2 {a^2} \ln \size {\cos \frac {a x} 2} + C$

title: Primitive of x over 1 plus Sine of a x
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {x \rd x} {1 + \sin a x} = -\frac x a \map \tan {\frac \pi 4 - \frac {a x} 2} + \frac 2 {a^2} \ln \size {\map \sin {\frac \pi 4 + \frac {a x} 2} } + C$

title: Primitive of x over Cosine of a x
snippet: {{eqn | l = \int \frac {x \rd x} {\cos a x} | r = \frac 1 {a^2} \sum_{n \mathop = 0}^\infty \frac {E_n \paren {a x}^{2 n + 2} } {\paren {2 n + 2} \paren {2 n}!} + C | c = }} {{eqn | r = \dfrac 1 {a^2} \paren {\frac {\paren {a x}^2} 2 + \frac {\paren {a x}^4} 8 + \frac {5 \paren {a x}^6} {144} + \cdots} + C | c = }} where $E_n$ denotes the $n$th Euler number.

title: Primitive of x over Cube of Root of a x squared plus b x plus c
snippet: Let $a \in \R_{\ne 0}$. Then: $\ds \int \frac {x \rd x} {\paren {\sqrt {a x^2 + b x + c} }^3} = \frac {2 \paren {b x + 2 c} } {\paren {b^2 - 4 a c} \sqrt {a x^2 + b x + c} } + C$

title: Primitive of x over Hyperbolic Cosine of a x
snippet: {{eqn | l = \int \frac {x \rd x} {\cosh a x} | r = \frac 1 {a^2} \sum_{n \mathop = 0}^\infty \frac {E_{2 n} \paren {a x}^{2 n + 2} } {\paren {2 n + 2} \paren {2 n}!} + C }} {{eqn | r = \frac 1 {a^2} \paren {\frac {\paren {a x}^2} 2 - \frac {\paren {a x}^4} 8 + \frac {5 \paren {a x}^6} {144} - \cdots } + C }} where $E_{2 n}$ denotes the $2 n$th Euler number.

title: Primitive of x over Hyperbolic Cosine of a x minus 1
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {x \rd x} {\cosh a x - 1} = -\frac x a \coth \frac {a x} 2 + \frac 2 {a^2} \ln \size {\sinh \frac {a x} 2} + C$

title: Primitive of x over Hyperbolic Cosine of a x plus 1

title: Primitive of x over a x squared plus b x plus c

title: Primitive of x squared by Arccosine of x over a

title: Primitive of x squared by Arcsecant of x over a

snippet: $\ds \int \frac {x^2 \rd x} {\paren {a x + b}^2 \paren {p x + q} } = \frac {b^2} {\paren {b p - a q} a^2 \paren {a x + b} } + \frac 1 {\paren {b p - a q}^2} \paren {\frac {q^2} p \ln \size {p x + q} + \frac {b \paren {b p - 2 a q} } {a^2} \ln \size {a x + b} } + C$

title: Primitive of x squared over a x squared plus b x plus c
snippet: Let $a \in \R_{\ne 0}$. Then: $\ds \int \frac {x^2 \rd x} {a x^2 + b x + c} = \frac x a - \frac b {2 a^2} \ln \size {a x^2 + b x + c} + \frac {b^2 - 2 a c} {2 a^2} \int \frac {\d x} {a x^2 + b x + c}$

title: Primitive of x squared over square of a x squared plus b x plus c
snippet: Let $a \in \R_{\ne 0}$. Then: $\ds \int \frac {x^2 \rd x} {\paren {a x^2 + b x + c}^2} = \frac {\paren {b^2 - 2 a c} x + b c} {a \paren {4 a c - b^2} \paren {a x^2 + b x + c} } + \frac {2 c} {4 a c - b^2} \int \frac {\d x} {a x^2 + b x + c}$

title: Primitive of x squared over x cubed plus a cubed
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {x^2 \rd x} {x^3 + a^3} = \frac 1 3 \ln \size {x^3 + a^3} + C$

title: Primitive of x squared over x cubed plus a cubed squared
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {x^2 \rd x} {\paren {x^3 + a^3}^2} = \frac {-1} {3 \paren {x^3 + a^3} } + C$

title: Primitive of x squared over x fourth minus a fourth
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {x^2 \rd x} {x^4 - a^4} = \frac 1 {4 a} \ln \size {\frac {x - a} {x + a} } + \frac 1 {2 a} \arctan \frac x a + C$

title: Primitive of x squared over x fourth plus a fourth
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {x^2 \rd x} {x^4 + a^4} = \frac 1 {4 a \sqrt 2} \map \ln {\frac {x^2 - a x \sqrt 2 + a^2} {x^2 + a x \sqrt 2 + a^2} } - \frac 1 {2 a \sqrt 2} \paren {\map \arctan {1 - \frac {x \sqrt 2} a} - \map \arctan {1 + \frac {x \sqrt 2} a} }$

Primitive of x squared over x squared minus a squared squared
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {x^2 \rd x} {\paren {x^2 - a^2}^2} = \frac {-x} {2 \paren {x^2 - a^2} } + \frac 1 {4 a} \map \ln {\frac {x - a} {x + a} } + C$ for $x^2 > a^2$.

title: Primitive of x squared over x squared plus a squared
snippet: $\ds \int \frac {x^2 \rd x} {x^2 + a^2} = x - a \arctan {\frac x a} + C$ where $a$ is a non-zero constant.

title: Primitives which Differ by Constant
snippet: Let $F$ be a primitive for a real function $f$ on the closed interval $\closedint a b$. Let $G$ be a real function defined on $\closedint a b$. Then $G$ is a primitive for $f$ on $\closedint a b$ : $\exists c \in \R: \forall x \in \closedint a b: \map G x = \map F x + c$ That is, $F$ and $G$ differ by a constant on the whole interval.

title: Prince Rupert's Cube
snippet: == Prince Rupert's Cube == Let $C$ be a unit cube. The largest square tunnel that can be made in $C$ through which a larger cube may be passed has sides of length: $\dfrac {3 \sqrt 2} 4 = 1 \cdotp 06066 \, 0$

title: Principal Ideal Domain/Examples
snippet: == Examples of Principal Ideal Domain ==

title: Principal Ideal Domain cannot have Infinite Strictly Increasing Sequence of Ideals
snippet: Let $\struct {D, +, \circ}$ be a principal ideal domain. Then $D$ cannot have an infinite sequence of ideals $\sequence {j_n}_{n \mathop \in \N}$ such that: $\forall n \in \N: J_n \subsetneq j_{n + 1}$

title: Principal Ideal Domain fulfills Ascending Chain Condition
snippet: Let $R$ be a principal ideal domain. Then $R$ fulfils the ascending chain condition.

title: Principal Ideal Domain is Bézout Domain
snippet: Let $D$ be a principal ideal domain. Then $D$ is a Bézout domain.

title: Principal Ideal Domain is Dedekind Domain
snippet: Let $D$ be a principal ideal domain which is specifically not a field. Then $D$ is a Dedekind domain.

title: Principal Ideal Domain is Integrally Closed
snippet: Let $A$ be a principal ideal domain. Then $A$ is integrally closed.

title: Principal Ideal Domain is Unique Factorization Domain
snippet: Every principal ideal domain is a unique factorization domain.

title: Principal Ideal from Element in Center of Ring
snippet: Let $\struct {R, +, \circ}$ be a ring with unity whose zero is $0_R$ and whose unity is $1_R$. Let $b \in R$ be in the center of $R$. Then: $\ideal b = R \circ b = \set {x \circ b: x \in R}$ where $\ideal b$ is the principal ideal generated by $b$.

title: Principal Ideal in Integral Domain generated by Power Plus One is Subset of Principal Ideal generated by Power
snippet: Let $\struct {D, +, \circ}$ be an integral domain whose unity is $1_D$. Let $a \in D$ be a proper element of $D$. Then: $\forall n \in \Z_{\ge 0}: \ideal {a^{n + 1} } \subsetneq \ideal {a_n}$ where $\ideal x$ denotes the principal ideal of $D$ generated by $x$.

title: Principal Ideal is Ideal
snippet: Let $\struct {R, +, \circ}$ be a ring with unity. Let $a \in R$. Let $\ideal a$ be the principal ideal of $R$ generated by $a$. Then $\ideal a$ is an ideal of $R$.

title: Principal Ideal is Smallest Ideal
snippet: Let $\struct {R, +, \circ}$ be a ring with unity. Let $a \in R$. Let $\ideal a$ be the principal ideal of $R$ generated by $a$. Let $J$ be an ideal of $R$ such that $a \in J$. Then $\ideal a \subseteq J$. That is, $\ideal a$ is the smallest ideal of $R$ to which $a$ belongs.

title: Principal Ideal of Characteristic of Ring is Subset of Kernel of Multiple Function
snippet: Let $\struct {R, +, \circ}$ be a ring with unity whose zero is $0_R$ and whose unity is $1_R$. Let the characteristic of $R$ be $p$. For any $a \in R$, we define the mapping $g_a: \Z \to R$ from the integers into $R$ as: $\forall n \in \Z: \map {g_a} n = n \cdot a$ Then: $\ideal p \subseteq \map \ker {g_a}$ where: $\map \ker {g_a}$ is the kernel of $g_a$ $\ideal p$ is the principal ideal of $\Z$ generated by $p$.

title: Principal Ideal of Commutative Ring
snippet: Let $\struct {R, +, \circ}$ be a commutative ring with unity. Let $a \in R$. Let $Ra$ be the principal left ideal of $R$ generated by $a$. Let $aR$ be the principal right ideal of $R$ generated by $a$. Let $\ideal a$ be the principal ideal of $R$ generated by $a$. Then $Ra = \ideal a = aR$.

title: Principal Ideal of Principal Ideal Domain is of Irreducible Element iff Maximal
snippet: Let $\struct {D, +, \circ}$ be a principal ideal domain. Let $\ideal p$ be the principal ideal of $D$ generated by $p$. Then $p$ is irreducible $\ideal p$ is a maximal ideal of $D$.

title: Principal Ideals of Integers
snippet: Let $J$ be a non-zero ideal of $\Z$. Then $J = \ideal b$ where $b$ is the smallest strictly positive integer belonging to $J$.

title: Principal Left Ideal is Left Ideal
snippet: Let $\struct {R, +, \circ}$ be a ring with unity. Let $a \in R$. Let $Ra$ be the principal left ideal of $R$ generated by $a$. Then $Ra$ is an left ideal of $R$.

title: Principal Normal on Geodesic Coincides with Normal to Surface
snippet: Let $S$ be a surface. Let $G$ be a geodesic on $S$. Let $P$ be a point on $G$. Then the principal normal to $G$ at $P$ coincides with the normal to $S$.

title: Principal Right Ideal is Right Ideal
snippet: Let $\struct {R, +, \circ}$ be a ring with unity. Let $a \in R$. Let $aR$ be the principal right ideal of $R$ generated by $a$. Then $aR$ is an right ideal of $R$.

title: Principal Ultrafilter is All Sets Containing Cluster Point
snippet: Let $S$ be a set. Let $\powerset S$ denote the power set of $S$. Let $\FF \subset \powerset S$ be a principal ultrafilter on $S$. Let its cluster point be $x$. Then $\FF$ is the set of all subsets $T$ of $S$ such that $x \in T$.

title: Principal Value of One over x is Distribution
snippet: Let $\phi \in \map \DD \R$ be a test function. Let $T : \map \DD \R \to \C$ be a mapping such that: $\forall \phi \in \map \DD \R : \map T \phi = \PV \frac {\map \phi x} x \rd x : = \lim_{\epsilon \mathop \to 0} \int_{\size x \mathop > \epsilon} \frac {\map \phi x} x \rd x$ where $\PV$ denotes the Cauchy principal value. Then $T$ is a Schwartz distribution.

title: Principle E
snippet: Let $S$ be a set of sets. Let $S$ be closed under chain unions. Then every element $b$ of $S$ is a subset of some element of $S$ that has no immediate extension in $S$.

title: Principle E is Equivalent to Kuratowski's Lemma
snippet: Kuratowski's Lemma is equivalent to Principle E.

title: Principle of Condensation of Singularities
Principle of Conservation of Angular Momentum
snippet: Newton's Laws of Motion imply the conservation of angular momentum in systems of masses in which no external force is acting.

title: Principle of Conservation of Energy
snippet: == Physical Law == Let $B$ be a body in a conservative force field. Let $B$ be subject only to forces within that force field. Let $P$ be the potential energy of $B$. Let $K$ be the kinetic energy of $B$. Then: $P + K = \text{constant}$

title: Principle of Conservation of Linear Momentum
snippet: Let $P$ be a physical system. Let it have the action $S$: $\ds S = \int_{t_0}^{t_1} L \rd t$ where $L$ is the standard Lagrangian, and $t$ is time. Suppose $L$ does not depend on one of the coordinates explicitly: $\dfrac {\partial L} {\partial x_j} = 0$ Then the total momentum of $P$ along the axis $x_j$ is conserved.

title: Principle of Counting
snippet: Let $T$ be a set such that $T \sim \N_n$. Then: $\forall m \in \N: n \ne m \implies T \nsim \N_m$

title: Principle of Definition by Structural Induction
snippet: Let $\LL$ be a formal language. Let the formal grammar of $\LL$ be a bottom-up grammar with unique parsability. A definition $\map D \phi$ (in the metalanguage of $\LL$) for all well-formed formulas $\phi$ of $\LL$ is uniquely specified by: $(1): \quad$ A definition $\map D a$ for each letter $a$ of $\LL$ $(2): \quad$ For each rule of formation for $\LL$, a definition $\map D \phi$ of the resultant WFF $\phi$ in terms of the constituent WFFs' definitions $\map D {\phi_1}, \ldots, \map D {\phi_n}$.

title: Principle of Duality in Space
snippet: Let $P$ be a theorem of projective geometry proven using the propositions of incidence. Let $Q$ be the statement created from $P$ by interchanging: $(1) \quad$ the terms point and plane $(2) \quad$ the terms lie on and intersect at and so on. Then $Q$ is also a theorem of projective geometry.

title: Principle of Duality in the Plane
snippet: Let $P$ be a theorem of projective geometry proven using the propositions of incidence. Let $Q$ be the statement created from $P$ by interchanging: $(1): \quad$ the terms point and (straight) line $(2): \quad$ the terms collinear (of points) and concurrent (of lines) $(3): \quad$ the terms lie on and intersect at and so on. Then $Q$ is also a theorem of projective geometry.

title: Principle of Finite Choice
snippet: Let $I$ be a non-empty finite indexing set. Let $\family {S_i}_{i \mathop \in I}$ be an $I$-indexed family of non-empty sets. Then there exists an $I$-indexed family $\family {x_i}_{i \mathop \in I}$ such that: $\forall i \in I: x_i \in S_i$ That is, there exists a mapping: $\ds f: I \to \bigcup_{i \mathop \in I} S_i$ such that: $\forall i \in I: \map f i \in S_i$

title: Principle of Finite Induction
snippet: Let $n_0 \in \Z$ be given. Let $\Z_{\ge n_0}$ denote the set: $\Z_{\ge n_0} = \set {n \in \Z: n \ge n_0}$ Let $S \subseteq \Z_{\ge n_0}$ be a subset of $\Z_{\ge n_0}$. Suppose that: $(1): \quad n_0 \in S$ $(2): \quad \forall n \ge n_0: n \in S \implies n + 1 \in S$ Then: $\forall n \ge n_0: n \in S$ That is: $S = \Z_{\ge n_0}$ The principle of finite induction is usually stated and demonstrated for $n_0$ being either $0$ or $1$. This is often dependent upon whether the analysis of the fundamentals of mathematical logic are zero-based or one-based.

title: Principle of General Induction
snippet: Let $M$ be a class. Let $g: M \to M$ be a mapping on $M$. Let $M$ be minimally inductive under $g$. Let $P: M \to \set {\T, \F}$ be a propositional function on $M$. Suppose that: {{axiom | n = 2 | q = \forall x \in M | ml= \map P x | mo= = | mr= \T \implies \map P {\map g x} = \T }} Then: $\forall x \in M: \map P x = \T$

title: Principle of Induction applied to Interval of Naturally Ordered Semigroup
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \circ, \preceq}$ be a naturally ordered semigroup. Let $\closedint p q$ be a closed interval of $\struct {S, \circ, \preceq}$. Let $T \subseteq \closedint p q$ such that the minimal element of $\closedint p q$ is in $T$. Let: $x \in T: x \prec q \implies x \circ 1 \in T$ Then: $T = \closedint p q$

title: Principle of Least Action
snippet: == Physical Law == The Principle of Least Action is a physical law which states the following: Let $S$ be a dynamical system moving under conservative forces from point $A$ to point $B$. The motion of $S$ takes place in such a way that the action has a stationary value all other possible trajectories from $A$ to $B$ with the same kinetic plus potential energy.

title: Principle of Least Counterexample
snippet: Let $\map P n$ be a condition on $n \in \set {x \in \Z: x \ge m \in \Z}$. Suppose that: $\neg \paren {\forall n \ge m: \map P n}$ (That is, not all $n \ge m$ satisfy $\map P n$.) Then there exists a least counterexample, that is a smallest integral value of $n$ for which $\neg \map P n$.

title: Principle of Lever
snippet: == Physical Law == Let $M$ be a lever in a state of equilibrium. The mechanical advantage $\mathrm {MA}$ of $M$ is given by: $\mathrm {MA} = \dfrac b a$ where: $L$ is the load applied to the lever at point $A$ $E$ is the effort applied to the lever at point $B$ $a$ and $b$ are the distances from the fulcrum to points $A$ and $B$ respectively.

title: Principle of Mathematical Induction
snippet: Let $\map P n$ be a propositional function depending on $n \in \Z$. Let $n_0 \in \Z$ be given. Suppose that: $(1): \quad \map P {n_0}$ is true $(2): \quad \forall k \in \Z: k \ge n_0 : \map P k \implies \map P {k + 1}$ Then: $\map P n$ is true for all $n \in \Z$ such that $n \ge n_0$. The Principle of Mathematical Induction is usually stated and demonstrated for $n_0$ being either $0$ or $1$. This is often dependent upon whether the analysis of the fundamentals of mathematical logic are zero-based or one-based.

title: Principle of Mathematical Induction for Minimally Inductive Set
snippet: Let $\omega$ be the minimally inductive set. Let $S \subseteq \omega$. Suppose that: $(1): \quad \O \in S$ $(2): \quad \forall x: x \in S \implies x^+ \in S$ where $x^+$ is the successor set of $x$. Then: $S = \omega$

title: Principle of Mathematical Induction for Natural Numbers in Real Numbers
snippet: Let $\struct {\R, +, \times, \le}$ be the field of real numbers. Let $\N$ be the natural numbers in $\R$. Suppose that $A \subseteq \N$ is an inductive set. Then $A = \N$.

title: Principle of Moments
snippet: == Physical Principle == Let $B$ be a body in equilibrium under the action of a system of coplanar forces. The sum of the moments of the forces about any point in that plane is zero.

title: Principle of Non-Contradiction
snippet: The Principle of Non-Contradiction is a valid argument in types of logic dealing with negation $\neg$ and contradiction $\bot$. This includes classical propositional logic and predicate logic, and in particular natural deduction.

title: Principle of Open Induction for Real Numbers
snippet: Let $a < b$ be real numbers. Let $S$ be an open set of real numbers. Suppose that, for every $x \in \closedint a b$ such that: $\hointr a x \subseteq S$ it also holds that: $x \in S$ Then, $\closedint a b \subseteq S$.

title: Principle of Parsimony
snippet: == Mathematical Principle == Let $P$ be a stochastic process which is being modelled by means of a stochastic model $M$. $M$ will necessarily use a number of constants and parameters whose values are to be determined by estimation from the data. The principle of parsimony dictates that $M$ employs the smallest possible number of parameters such that $M$ will adequately represent the behaviour of $P$.

title: Principle of Recursive Definition
snippet: Let $\N$ be the natural numbers. Let $T$ be a class (which may be a set). Let $a \in T$. Let $g: T \to T$ be a mapping. Then there exists exactly one mapping $f: \N \to T$ such that: $\forall x \in \N: \map f x = \begin{cases} a & : x = 0 \\ \map g {\map f n} & : x = n + 1 \end{cases}$

title: Principle of Recursive Definition for Minimally Inductive Set
snippet: Let $\omega$ be the minimally inductive set. Let $T$ be a set. Let $a \in T$. Let $g: T \to T$ be a mapping. Then there exists exactly one mapping $f: \omega \to T$ such that: $\forall x \in \omega: \map f x = \begin {cases} a & : x = \O \\ \map g {\map f n} & : x = n^+ \end {cases}$ where $n^+$ is the successor set of $n$.

title: Principle of Recursive Definition for Peano Structure
snippet: Let $\struct {P, 0, s}$ be a Peano structure. Let $T$ be a set. Let $a \in T$. Let $g: T \to T$ be a mapping. Then there exists exactly one mapping $f: P \to T$ such that: $\forall x \in P: \map f x = \begin{cases} a & : x = 0 \\ \map g {\map f n} & : x = \map s n \end{cases}$

title: Principle of Recursive Definition for Well-Ordered Sets
snippet: Let $J$ be a well-ordered set. Let $C$ be any set. Let $\FF$ be the set of all functions that map initial segments $S_a$ of $J$ into $C$. Then for any function of the form: $\rho: \FF \to C$ there exists a unique function: $h: J \to C$ satisfying: $\forall \alpha \in J: \map h \alpha = \map \rho {h \restriction_{S_\alpha} }$ where $\restriction$ denotes the restriction of a mapping.

title: Principle of Small Perturbations
Principle of Stationary Action
snippet: == Physical Law == The principle of stationary actions states that the equations of motion of a physical system can be acquired by finding a stationary point of the action. In other words, the first variation of the action has to vanish.

title: Principle of Stationary Action with Standard Lagrangian implies Newton's Laws of Motion
snippet: Let $\MM$ be an $n$-dimensional Euclidean manifold. Let $P$ be a physical system composed of a countable number of classical particles with inertial masses $m_i$ with $i \in \N$. Let $\mathbf x = \map {\mathbf x} t$ be twice-differentiable vector-valued function embedded in $\MM$. Suppose ${\mathbf x}_i$ represents the position of the $i$th particle of $P$. Suppose the action of $P$ is of the following form: $\ds S = \int_{t_0}^{t_1} L \rd t$ where $L$ is the standard Lagrangian.

title: Principle of Structural Induction
snippet: Let $\LL$ be a formal language. Let the formal grammar of $\LL$ be a bottom-up grammar. Let $\map P \phi$ be a statement (in the metalanguage of $\LL$) about well-formed formulas $\phi$ of $\LL$. Then $P$ is true for all WFFs of $\LL$ both: $\map P a$ is true for all letters $a$ of $\LL$, and, for each rule of formation of $\LL$, if $\phi$ is a WFF resulting from WFFs $\phi_1, \ldots, \phi_n$ by applying that rule, then: $\map P \phi$ is true only if $\map P {\phi_1}, \ldots, \map P {\phi_n}$ are all true.

title: Principle of Sufficient Reason
snippet: == Philosophical Position == The Principle of Sufficient Reason is a philosophical position that asserts that everything that is true is true for a reason.

title: Principle of Superinduction
snippet: Let $A$ be a class. Let $g: A \to A$ be a mapping on $A$. Let $A$ be minimally superinductive under $g$. Let $P: A \to \set {\T, \F}$ be a propositional function on $A$. Suppose that: {{axiom | n = 2 | q = \forall x \in A | m = \map P x = \T \implies \map P {\map g x} = \T }} {{axiom | n = 3 | q = \forall C: \forall x \in C | m = \map P x = \T \implies \map P {\bigcup C} = \T | rc= where $C$ is a chain of elements of $A$ }} Then: $\forall x \in A: \map P x = \T$

title: Principle of Uniformity of Nature
snippet: == Philosophical Position == The principle of uniformity of nature is the philosophical position that the physical laws are the same throughout the universe. While generally believed by physicists to apply throughout space, it is an open question as to whether it applies throughout time as well. Category:Philosophical Positions

title: Pringsheim's Theorem
snippet: Let $f$ be a holomorphic function defined on a unit disc centered at the origin of the complex plane and is denoted by its Taylor series: $\map f z = \ds \sum_{n \mathop = 0}^{\infty} c_n z^n$ Let: $(1): \quad \forall n \ge 0: c_n \ge 0$ $(2): \quad$ the radius of convergence of the Taylor series of function $f$ is $1$. Then $z = 1$ is an isolated singularity of $f$.

Probability Density Function of Chi-Squared Distribution
snippet: Let $X$ be a continuous random variable on a probability space $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$. Let $\Img X = \hointr 0 \infty$. Let $r$ be a strictly positive integer. Let $X$ have a $\chi$-squared distribution with $r$ degrees of freedom. Then the probability density function of $X$ is given by: $\map {f_X} x = \dfrac 1 {2^{r / 2} \map \Gamma {r / 2} } x^{\paren {r / 2} - 1} e^{-x / 2}$ where $\Gamma$ denotes the gamma function.

title: Probability Density Function of Continuous Triangular Distribution
snippet: Let $X$ be a continuous random variable on a probability space $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$. Let $X$ have a triangular distribution over the interval $\closedint a b$. The probability density function of $X$ is: $\map {f_X} x = \begin {cases} 0 & : x \le 2 a \\ \\ \dfrac {x - 2 a} {\paren {b - a}^2} & : 2 a 2 b \end {cases}$

title: Probability Density Function of Convolution of Probability Distributions
snippet: Let $X$ and $Y$ be continuous independent random variables. Let $Z = X + Y$. Let $f_X$ be a probability density function for $X$. Let $f_Y$ be a probability density function for $Y$. Then a probability density function $f_Z$ for $Z$ is given by: {{eqn | l = \map {f_Z} z | r = \map {f_X} z * \map {f_Y} z | c = that is, the convolution of $\map {f_X} z$ and $\map {f_Y} z$ }} {{eqn | r = \int_{-\infty}^\infty \map {f_X} x \map {f_Y} {z - x} \rd x | c = }}

title: Probability Density Function of Exponential Distribution
snippet: Let $X$ be a continuous random variable with the exponential distribution with parameter $\beta$. Then the probability density function of $X$ is given by: $\map {f_X} x = \begin{cases} \dfrac 1 \beta e^{-\frac x \beta} & : x \ge 0 \\ 0 & : \text{otherwise} \end{cases}$

title: Probability Density Function of Snedecor's F-Distribution
snippet: Let $X$ be a continuous random variable on a probability space $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$. Let $\Img X = \hointr 0 \infty$. Let $n, m$ be strictly positive integers. Let $X$ have Snedecor's $F$-distribution with $\tuple {n, m}$ degrees of freedom.

title: Probability Density Function of Student's t-Distribution
snippet: Let $X$ be a continuous random variable on a probability space $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$. Let $X$ have a Student's $t$-distribution with $k$ degrees of freedom. Then the probability density function of $X$ is given by: $\map {f_X} x = \dfrac {\map \Gamma {\frac {k + 1} 2} } {\sqrt {\pi k} \map \Gamma {\frac k 2} } \paren {1 + \dfrac {x^2} k}^{-\frac {k + 1} 2}$ where $\Gamma$ denotes the gamma function.

title: Probability Distribution is Probability Measure
snippet: Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a probability space. Let $\struct {S, \Sigma'}$ be a measurable space. Let $X$ be a random variable on $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ taking values in $\struct {S, \Sigma'}$. Let $P_X$ be the probability distribution of $X$. Then: $P_X$ is a probability measure on $\struct {S, \Sigma'}$.

title: Probability Generating Function as Expectation
snippet: Let $X$ be a discrete random variable whose codomain, $\Omega_X$, is a subset of the natural numbers $\N$. Let $p_X$ be the probability mass function for $X$. Let $\map {\Pi_X} s$ be the probability generating function for $X$. Then: $\map {\Pi_X} s = \expect {s^X}$ where $\expect {s^X}$ denotes the expectation of $s^X$.

title: Probability Generating Function defines Probability Distribution
snippet: Let $X$ and $Y$ be discrete random variables whose codomain, $\Omega_X$, is a subset of the natural numbers $\N$. Let the probability generating functions of $X$ and $Y$ be $\map {\Pi_X} s$ and $\map {\Pi_Y} s$ respectively. Then: $\forall s \in \closedint {-1} 1: \map {\Pi_X} s = \map {\Pi_Y} s$ $\forall k \in \N: \Pr \left({X = k}\right) = \map \Pr {Y = k}$ That is, discrete random variables which are integer-valued have the same PGFs they have the same PMF.

title: Probability Generating Function of Bernoulli Distribution
snippet: Let $X$ be a discrete random variable with the Bernoulli distribution with parameter $p$. Then the p.g.f. of $X$ is: $\map {\Pi_X} s = q + p s$ where $q = 1 - p$.

title: Probability Generating Function of Binomial Distribution
snippet: Let $X$ be a discrete random variable with the binomial distribution with parameters $n$ and $p$. Then the p.g.f. of $X$ is: $\map {\Pi_X} s = \paren {q + p s}^n$ where $q = 1 - p$.

title: Probability Generating Function of Degenerate Distribution
snippet: Let $X$ be the degenerate distribution: $\forall x \in \N: \map {p_X} x = \begin{cases} 1 & : x = k \\ 0 & : x \ne k \end{cases}$ where $k \in \N$. Then the p.g.f. of $X$ is: $\map {\Pi_X} x = s^k$

title: Probability Generating Function of Discrete Uniform Distribution
snippet: Let $X$ be a discrete random variable with the discrete uniform distribution with parameter $n$. Then the p.g.f. of $X$ is: $\map {\Pi_X} s = \dfrac {s \paren {1 - s^n} } {n \paren {1 - s} }$

title: Probability Generating Function of Geometric Distribution
snippet: Let $X$ be a discrete random variable with the geometric distribution with parameter $p$. Then the p.g.f. of $X$ is: $\map {\Pi_X} s = \dfrac q {1 - p s}$ where $q = 1 - p$.

title: Probability Generating Function of Negative Binomial Distribution
Probability Generating Function of One
snippet: Let $X$ be a discrete random variable whose codomain, $\Omega_X$, is a subset of the natural numbers $\N$. Let $p_X$ be the probability mass function for $X$. Let $\map {\Pi_X} s$ be the probability generating function for $X$. Then: $\map {\Pi_X} 1 = 1$

title: Probability Generating Function of Poisson Distribution
snippet: Let $X$ be a discrete random variable with the Poisson distribution with parameter $\lambda$. Then the p.g.f. of $X$ is: $\map {\Pi_X} s = e^{-\lambda \paren {1 - s} }$

title: Probability Generating Function of Scalar Multiple of Random Variable
snippet: Let $X$ be a discrete random variable whose probability generating function is $\map {\Pi_X} s$. Let $k \in \Z_{\ge 0}$ be a positive integer. Let $Y$ be a discrete random variable such that $Y = m X$. Then $\map {\Pi_Y} s = \map {\Pi_X} {s^m}$ where $\map {\Pi_Y} s$ is the probability generating function of $Y$.

title: Probability Generating Function of Shifted Geometric Distribution
snippet: Let $X$ be a discrete random variable with the shifted geometric distribution with parameter $p$. Then the p.g.f. of $X$ is: $\map {\Pi_X} s = \dfrac {p s} {1 - q s}$ where $q = 1 - p$.

title: Probability Generating Function of Shifted Random Variable
snippet: Let $X$ be a discrete random variable whose probability generating function is $\map {\Pi_X} s$. Let $k \in \Z_{\ge 0}$ be a positive integer. Let $Y$ be a discrete random variable such that $Y = X + m$. Then $\map {\Pi_Y} s = s^m \map {\Pi_X} s$ where $\map {\Pi_Y} s$ is the probability generating function of $Y$.

title: Probability Generating Function of Zero
snippet: Let $X$ be a discrete random variable whose codomain, $\Omega_X$, is a subset of the natural numbers $\N$. Let $p_X$ be the probability mass function for $X$. Let $\map {\Pi_X} s$ be the probability generating function for $X$. Then: $\map {\Pi_X} 0 = \map {p_X} 0$

title: Probability Mass Function/Examples
snippet: == Examples of Probability Mass Functions ==

title: Probability Mass Function of Binomial Distribution
snippet: The probability mass function (pmf) of a binomially distributed random variable $X$ is equal to: $\map \Pr {X = x} = \dbinom n x p^x \paren {1 - p}^{n - x}$ where $n$ is the number of trials and $p$ is the probability of success.

title: Probability Mass Function of Function of Discrete Random Variable
snippet: Let $X$ be a discrete random variable. Let $Y = \map g X$, where $g: \R \to \R$ is a real function. Then the probability mass function of $Y$ is given by: $\ds \map {p_Y} y = \sum_{x \mathop \in \inv g y} \map \Pr {X = x}$

title: Probability Mass Function of Hypergeometric Distribution
snippet: The probability mass function of a hypergeometric distribution on a discrete random variable $X$ is given by: $\map \Pr {X = r} = \dfrac {\dbinom M r \dbinom N {n - r} } {\dbinom {M + N} r}$ where: $n$ is the number of trials $M + N$ is the total population, consisting of $M$ satisfactory units and $N$ unsatisfactory units $r$ is the number of satisfactory units drawn from the population without replacement.

title: Probability Mass Function of Negative Binomial Distribution
Probability Mass Function of Negative Binomial Distribution (Type 1)/Also defined as
snippet: Let $X$ be a discrete random variable on a probability space $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$. Let $X$ have the type $1$ negative binomial distribution with parameters $r$ and $p$, defined as number of number of Bernoulli trials before the $r$th failure has occurred. Then the probability mass function of $X$ is given by: $\map \Pr {X = k} = \dbinom {k + r - 1} {r - 1} p^r \paren {1 - p}^k$ where: $\Img X = \set {0, 1, 2, \ldots}$ $0 < p < 1$.

title: Probability Mass Function of Negative Binomial Distribution (Type 1)/Also presented as
snippet: == Probability Mass Function of Negative Binomial Distribution (Type 1): Also presented as == The probability mass function of the type $1$ negative binomial distribution with parameters $r$ and $p$ can also be presented as: $\map \Pr {X = k} = \dbinom {k - 1} {k - r} p^k \paren {1 - p}^r$ It can also be seen in the form: $\map \Pr {X = k} = \dbinom {k - 1} {r - 1} p^r q^{k - r}$ or: $\map \Pr {X = k} = \dbinom {k - 1} {k - r} p^r q^{k - r}$ where $q = 1 - p$.

title: Probability Mass Function of Negative Binomial Distribution (Type 2)/Also defined as
snippet: Let $X$ be a discrete random variable on a probability space $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$. Let $X$ have the type $2$ negative binomial distribution with parameters $r$ and $p$, defined as the number of failures before $r$ successes have occurred. Then the probability mass function of $X$ is given by: $\map \Pr {X = k} = \dbinom {k + r - 1} {r - 1} p^r \paren {1 - p}^k$ where: $\Img X = \set {0, 1, 2, \ldots}$ $0 < p < 1$.

title: Probability Mass Function of Negative Binomial Distribution (Type 2)/Also presented as
snippet: == Probability Mass Function of Negative Binomial Distribution (Type 2): Also presented as == The probability mass function of the type $2$ negative binomial distribution with parameters $r$ and $p$ can also be presented as: $\map \Pr {X = k} = \dbinom {k + r - 1} k p^k \paren {1 - p}^r$ It can also be seen in the form: $\map \Pr {X = k} = \dbinom {k + r - 1} {r - 1} p^k q^r$ or: $\map \Pr {X = k} = \dbinom {k + r - 1} k p^k q^r$ where $q = 1 - p$.

title: Probability Measure is Monotone
snippet: Let $\EE$ be an experiment with probability space $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$. Let $A, B \in \Sigma$ such that $A \subseteq B$. Then: $\map \Pr A \le \map \Pr B$ where $\map \Pr A$ denotes the probability of event $A$ occurring.

title: Probability Measure is Subadditive
snippet: Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a probability space. Then $\Pr$ is a subadditive function.

title: Probability Measure on Equiprobable Outcomes
snippet: Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be an equiprobability space. Let $\card \Omega = n$. Then: $\forall \omega \in \Omega: \map \Pr \omega = \dfrac 1 n$ $\forall A \subseteq \Omega: \map \Pr A = \dfrac {\card A} n$.

title: Probability Measure on Finite Sample Space
snippet: Let $\Omega = \set {\omega_1, \omega_2, \ldots, \omega_n}$ be a finite set. Let $\Sigma$ be a $\sigma$-algebra on $\Omega$. Let $p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$ be non-negative real numbers such that: $p_1 + p_2 + \cdots + p_n = 1$ Let $Q: \Sigma \to \R$ be the mapping defined as: $\forall A \in \Sigma: \map Q A = \ds \sum_{i: \omega_i \in A} p_i$ Then $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, Q}$ constitutes a probability space. That is, $Q$ is a probability measure on $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma}$.

title: Probability Measure on Single-Subset Event Space
snippet: Let $\EE$ be an experiment whose sample space is $\Omega$. Let $\O \subsetneqq A \subsetneqq \Omega$. Let $\Sigma := \set {\O, A, \Omega \setminus A, \Omega}$ be the event space of $\EE$. Let $\Pr: \Sigma \to \R$ be a probability measure on $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma}$. Then $\Pr$ has the form: {{eqn | n = Pr 3 | l = \map \Pr {\Omega \setminus A} | r = 1 - p }} for some $p \in \R$ satisfying $0 \le p \le 1$.

title: Probability of All Players receiving Complete Suit at Bridge
snippet: The probability of all $4$ players in a game of Bridge being dealt a complete suit is $1$ in $2 \, 235 \, 197 \, 406 \, 895 \, 366 \, 368 \, 301 \, 560 \, 000$.

title: Probability of Continuous Random Variable Lying in Singleton Set is Zero
snippet: Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a probability space. Let $X$ be a continuous real variable on $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$. Then, for each $x \in \R$, we have: $\map \Pr {X \le x} = \map \Pr {X < x}$ In particular: $\map \Pr {X = x} = 0$

title: Probability of Empty Event is Zero
snippet: Let $\EE$ be an experiment with probability space $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$. The probability measure $\Pr$ of $\EE$ has the following property: $\map \Pr \O = 0$

title: Probability of Event not Occurring
snippet: Let $\EE$ be an experiment with probability space $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$. Let $\map \Pr A$ be the probability of event $A$ occurring. Then: $\forall A \in \Sigma: \map \Pr {\Omega \setminus A} = 1 - \map \Pr A$ That is, the probability of event $A$ not occurring is $1$ minus the probability of event $A$ occurring. Another way of stating this is: $\map \Pr A + \map \Pr {\Omega \setminus A} = 1$

title: Probability of Independent Events Not Happening
snippet: Let $\EE = \struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a probability space. Let $A_1, A_2, \ldots, A_m \in \Sigma$ be independent events in the event space of $\EE$. Then the probability of none of $A_1$ to $A_m$ occurring is: $\ds \prod_{i \mathop = 1}^m \paren {1 - \map \Pr {A_i} }$

title: Probability of Limit of Sequence of Events
snippet: Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a probability space.

title: Probability of Occurrence of At Least One Independent Event
snippet: Let $\EE = \struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a probability space. Let $A_1, A_2, \ldots, A_m \in \Sigma$ be independent events in the event space of $\EE$. Then the probability of at least one of $A_1$ to $A_m$ occurring is: $\ds 1 - \prod_{i \mathop = 1}^m \paren {1 - \map \Pr {A_i} }$

title: Probability of Occurrence of Complementary Event
snippet: Let $\Pr$ be a probability measure on an event space $\Sigma$. Let $A \in \Sigma$. The probability of the occurrence of the complementary event to $A$ can be evaluated as: $\map \Pr {\overline A} = 1 - \map \Pr A$ where $\overline A$ denotes the complementary event to $A$.

title: Probability of Random Error under Normal Distribution occurring within Interval
snippet: Let $X$ be a random variable with a normal distribution. Let: the expectation of $X$ be $0$ the standard deviation of $X$ be $\sigma$. Let $x \in \R$ be a real number. Then the probability that a random error from $X$ lies in the interval $\openint {-x} x$ is given by: $p = \map \erf {\dfrac x {\sigma \sqrt 2} }$ where $\erf$ denotes the Gauss error function.

title: Probability of Random Integer being Square-Free
snippet: Let $a$ be an integer chosen at random. The probability that $a$ is square-free is given by: $\map \Pr {\neg \exists b \in \Z: b^2 \divides a} = \dfrac 1 {\map \zeta 2} = \dfrac 6 {\pi^2}$ where $\zeta$ denotes the zeta function. The decimal expansion of $\dfrac 1 {\map \zeta 2}$ starts: $\dfrac 1 {\map \zeta 2} = 0 \cdotp 60792 \, 71018 \, 54026 \, 6 \ldots$

title: Probability of Receiving Complete Suit as Hand at Bridge
snippet: The probability of being dealt a complete suit in a deal at Bridge is $1$ in $158 \, 753 \, 389 \, 900$.

title: Probability of Set Difference of Events
snippet: Let $\EE$ be an experiment with probability space $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$. Let $A, B \in \Sigma$ be events of $\EE$. Let $\map \Pr A$ denote the probability of event $A$ occurring. Then: $\map \Pr {A \setminus B} = \map \Pr A - \map \Pr {A \cap B}$

title: Probability of Three Random Integers having no Common Divisor
snippet: Let $a, b$ and $c$ be integers chosen at random. The probability that $a, b$ and $c$ have no common divisor: $\map \Pr {\map \perp {a, b, c} } = \dfrac 1 {\map \zeta 3}$ where $\zeta$ denotes the zeta function: $\map \zeta 3 = \dfrac 1 {1^3} + \dfrac 1 {2^3} + \dfrac 1 {3^3} + \dfrac 1 {4^3} + \cdots$ The decimal expansion of $\dfrac 1 {\map \zeta 3}$ starts: $\dfrac 1 {\map \zeta 3} = 0 \cdotp 83190 \, 73725 \, 80707 \ldots$

title: Probability of Two Random Integers having no Common Divisor
snippet: Let $a$ and $b$ be integers chosen at random. The probability that $a$ and $b$ are coprime is given by: $\map \Pr {a \perp b} = \dfrac 1 {\map \zeta 2} = \dfrac 6 {\pi^2}$ where $\zeta$ denotes the zeta function. The decimal expansion of $\dfrac 1 {\map \zeta 2}$ starts: $\dfrac 1 {\map \zeta 2} = 0 \cdotp 60792 \, 71018 \, 54026 \, 6 \ldots$

title: Probability of Type I Error equals Significance Level of Test
snippet: The probability of a type $\text I$ error in a hypothesis test is equal to the significance level.

title: Probability of Union of Disjoint Events is Sum of Individual Probabilities
snippet: Let $\EE$ be an experiment. Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a probability measure on $\EE$. Then: $\forall A, B \in \Sigma: A \cap B = \O \implies \map \Pr {A \cup B} = \map \Pr A + \map \Pr B$ where $A \cap B$ denotes the union of $A$ and $B$.

title: Probability of no 2 People out of 53 Sharing the Same Birthday
snippet: Let there be $53$ people in a room. The probability that no $2$ of them have the same birthday is approximately $\dfrac 1 {53}$.

title: Probability that Three Dice are Rolled in Strictly Increasing Order
snippet: Roll three fair six-sided dice one by one, recording the upwards face each time. The probability that the dice were rolled with upwards face in strictly increasing order is $5/54$.

title: Probability that Uniformly Selected Subset contains Particular Element
snippet: Let $X$ be a finite set. Let $\powerset X$ be the power set of $X$. Give $\powerset X$ the discrete uniform distribution, so that: $\ds \map \Pr {\set A} = 2^{-n}$ for each $A \in \powerset X$. Let $x \in X$. Then: $\ds \map \Pr {\set {A \in \powerset X : x \in A} } = \frac 1 2$

title: Problem of Apollonius
snippet: == Classic Problem == Let three points, straight lines or circles, or any combination of $3$ such objects. The problem is to construct a circle which passes through the points, or is tangent to the straight lines or circles.

title: Problem of Pappus
snippet: == Classic Problem == The Problem of Pappus is a generalization of the Four-Line Locus problem, where the number of lines is greater than $4$.

title: Product (Category Theory) is Unique
snippet: Let $\mathbf C$ be a metacategory. Let $A$ and $B$ be objects of $\mathbf C$. Let $A \times B$ and $A \times' B$ both be products of $A$ and $B$. Then there is a unique isomorphism $u: A \times B \to A \times' B$. That is, products are unique up to unique isomorphism.

title: Product Category is Category
snippet: Let $\mathbf C$ and $\mathbf D$ be metacategories. Then the product category $\mathbf C \times \mathbf D$ is a metacategory.

title: Product Category is Product in Category of Categories
snippet: Let $\mathbf{Cat}$ be the category of categories. Let $\mathbf C$ and $\mathbf D$ be small categories, and let $\mathbf C \times \mathbf D$ be their product category. Then $\mathbf C \times \mathbf D$ is a binary product of $\mathbf C$ and $\mathbf D$ in $\mathbf{Cat}$.

title: Product Distributes over Modulo Operation
snippet: Let $x, y, z \in \R$ be real numbers. Let $x \bmod y$ denote the modulo operation. Then: $z \paren {x \bmod y} = \paren {z x} \bmod \paren {z y}$

title: Product Equation for Riemann Zeta Function
snippet: There exists a constant $B$ such that: $\ds \frac {\map {\zeta'} s} {\map \zeta s} = B - \frac 1 {s - 1} + \frac 1 2 \ln \pi - \frac 1 2 \frac {\map {\Gamma'} {s / 2 + 1} } {\map \Gamma {s / 2 + 1} } + \sum_\rho \paren {\frac 1 {s - \rho} + \frac 1 \rho}$ where: $\zeta$ is the Riemann zeta function $\rho$ runs over the nontrivial zeros of $\zeta$ $\Gamma$ is the gamma function.

title: Product Form of Sum on Completely Multiplicative Function
snippet: Let $f$ be a completely multiplicative arithmetic function. Let the series $\ds \sum_{n \mathop = 1}^\infty \map f n$ be absolutely convergent. Then: $\ds \sum_{n \mathop = 1}^\infty \map f n = \prod_p \frac 1 {1 - \map f p}$ where the infinite product ranges over the primes.

title: Product Formula for Cosine
snippet: $\ds \map \cos {n z} = \paren {-1}^{\floor {n/2} } 2^{n - 1} \prod_{k \mathop = 0}^{n - 1} \map \cos {z + \frac {\paren {\map {\cos^2} {\frac {n \pi} 2} + 2 k} \pi} {2 n} }$

title: Product Formula for Norms on Non-zero Rationals
Product Formula for Sine
snippet: $\ds \map \sin {n z} = 2^{n - 1} \prod_{k \mathop = 0}^{n - 1} \map \sin {z + \frac {k \pi} n}$

title: Product Formula for Tangent
snippet: $\ds \map \tan {n z} = \begin{cases} \paren {-1}^r \ds \prod_{k \mathop = 0}^{n - 1} \dfrac {\map \sin {z + \dfrac {k \pi} n} } {\map \cos {z + \dfrac {\paren {2 k + 1 } \pi} {2 n} } } & : n = 2 r & r \in \N \\ \\ \paren {-1}^r \ds \prod_{k \mathop = 0}^{n - 1} \map \tan {z + \dfrac {k \pi} n} & : n = 2 r + 1 & r \in \N \end{cases}$

title: Product Functor is Functor
snippet: Let $\mathbf C$ be a metacategory with binary products. Let $\mathbf C \times \mathbf C$ be the product category of $\mathbf C$ with itself. Let $\times: \mathbf C \times \mathbf C \to \mathbf C$ be the product functor. Then $\times$ is a functor.

snippet: Let $\struct {G, \oplus}$ be a closed algebraic structure on which the following properties hold: Let $\circ$ be the operation on $G$ defined as: $\forall x, y \in G: x \circ y = x \oplus \paren {e \oplus y}$ The following lemmata hold:

title: Product Inverse Operation Properties induce Group
snippet: Let $\struct {G, \oplus}$ be a closed algebraic structure on which the following properties hold: Let $\circ$ be the operation on $G$ defined as: $\forall x, y \in G: x \circ y = x \oplus \paren {e \oplus y}$ Then $\struct {G, \circ}$ is a group.

title: Product Inverse Operation is Self-Inverse
snippet: Let $\struct {G, \circ}$ be a group whose identity is $e$. Let $\oplus: G \times G \to G$ be the product inverse of $\circ$ on $G$. Then $\oplus$ is self inverse in the sense that: $\forall x \in G: x \oplus x = e$

title: Product Inverse in Ring is Unique
snippet: Let $\struct {R, +, \circ}$ be a ring with unity. Let $x \in R$ be a unit of $R$. Then the product inverse $x^{-1}$ of $x$ is unique.

title: Product Law of Independent Events
snippet: Let $\EE$ be an experiment with probability space $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$. Let $A, B \in \Sigma$ be events of $\EE$ such that $\map \Pr A > 0$ and $\map \Pr B > 0$. Let $A$ and $B$ be independent of each other. Then: $\map \Pr {A \cap B} = \map \Pr A \map \Pr B$

title: Product Manifold of Pseudo-Riemannian Manifolds is Pseudo-Riemannian Manifold
snippet: Let $\struct {M_1, g_1}$ and $\struct {M_2, g_2}$ be pseudo-Riemannian manifolds of signatures $\tuple {r_1, s_1}$ and $\tuple {r_2, s_2}$ respectively. Then $\struct {M_1 \times M_2, g_1 \oplus g_2}$ is a pseudo-Riemannian manifold of signature $\tuple {r_1 + r_2, s_1 + s_2}$, where $\times$ denotes the cartesian product and $\oplus$ stands for the direct sum.
